strings.jp: 模試の結果は、予定から１日も遅れることなく郵送されてきた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 大きめの紙に、自分が記入した志望校の合否判定がプリントされていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: すべて”Ｅ”判定で、短いコメントがついていた。どれも同じ文章で、志望校の再検討をうながしていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 科目別の判定を読んでみた。国語に関しては、自分でも意外なほど点が高かった。しかし、英語と世界史は目を覆うばかりだった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 受験勉強を始めてから１週間の時点で受けた模試だということを考えれば、この結果もしかたがないものだろう。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 受験勉強をやってこなかった人間の学力は、この程度だということだ。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 実際の入学試験までの約１カ月の間に、合格できる学力を身につけることができれば問題はない。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 可能かもしれない。・・・奇跡さえ起これば。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: おそらく失敗するだろう。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 入試に失敗しても、自分にとっては驚くような結果ではないし、さほどショックは受けないだろう。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: しかし、理恵は、・・・彼女はショックを受けるはずだ。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: キャンパスを理恵と歩いた時のことを思い出した。彼女は、自分と一緒に芝生の上で弁当を食べることを夢見ていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 彼女が自分のためにしてくれたことについて考えた。自分のために模試を申し込み、募集要項を買い、勉強を手伝うために時間をさいてくれる。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 入試に失敗した時の、彼女の失望と悲しみについて考えた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 自分は、彼女の失望する姿に耐えられるだろうか、と考えた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: その自信はなかった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 気分を切り替えようと、机に向かったが、参考書の内容はまったく頭に入らなかった。落ち着きなく部屋の中を歩き回った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 一刻も早く不安を追い払い、勉強を始めなければいけないことはわかっている。それなのに、脳が勉強することを拒んだ。思考が混乱し、恐怖感にさいなまれた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: どうしても怯えを頭から振り払うことができなかった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: １２時から理恵がやってくることになっている。おれの家庭教師をしに。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 彼女は、模試の結果が今日出るということも知っている。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 彼女に、模試の結果を見せなければならない。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 今の精神状態で彼女に普通に接することは無理だ、と思った。いつもと変わらない彼女の明るい顔を見ることは、とてもできない。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: どこに行くあてもなかったが、外に出ることにした。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵に電話で用事ができたと伝えようかと考えたが、電話で話せば、いやおうなく模試の成績のことを聞かれてしまう。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵には悪いが、黙って外出することにした。来て留守だとわかったら、彼女もまっすぐ帰るだろう。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 半日、歩き回ったが何も解決できなかった。無意味に貴重な時間を無駄にしてしまっただけだった。当然だ。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 逃げ出してみたところで、事態は悪くなるばかりだ。そんなことはわかっている。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: あきらめて家に帰ることにしたが、足取りはきわめて遅かった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 無気力に駅前を歩いていると、中野を見つけた。女の子と一緒だった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA5}「あらまっ。どうしたのよ、{X92}？ひとり？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: ぶらぶらしていた、と答えた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA5}「おれってば、今日、専学の説明会だったかんよ、行ってきたのよ、新宿まで。デザイナースクールというやつに」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA5}「あそこに決めんよ。立地もいいしね。いいクラブが近くに３件からある」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 中野と一緒にいる女の子を見た。会ったことのない子だった。にこにこしてガムを噛んでいた。おれの視線に気がついて、中野が言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA5}「あ、こいつ？知り合ったばっかりなのよ。マーコっていってさ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 女の子が微笑んだ。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA5}「説明会の時、隣だったのよ、おれの。そんで、ちょっと世間話してたらさ、これが、まー、怖いくらい趣味がベストマッチつーの？なにからなにまで」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XBC}「そう。特に缶ジュースの好みとか」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA5}「音楽の趣味も」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XBC}「そうそう」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA5}「おれよかデジロックに詳しい奴がいるとは、考えたこともなかったしよ。ホント」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 女の子は、おかしそうに笑った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA5}「しかも最寄り駅ここだっていうじゃんよ。即、遊びに行こうってなったのよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: ２人で楽しそうに笑った。今日会ったばかりとは思えないくらい、うちとけていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA5}「そういや、田村から聞いたけど、大学受験するんだってな。{X92}、よく受験勉強なんてする気になんなぁ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 自分がやりたくてやっているわけではない、と心の中で呟いた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA5}「受験勉強みたく堪え忍ぶばかりのもんは、おれは性にあわん。・・・おれ、残り少ない高校生活を遊び倒す構えよ。卒業まで暇だかんね」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA5}「なんでまた大学に行く気になったの？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 答えあぐねていると、中野が言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA5}「モラトリアムってか？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「まぁ、そんな感じだ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA5}「ん、おれも同じか。４年か２年かの違いだな」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「中野は、専門学校を出たら、なにをやるの？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA5}「んー？なんか」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA5}「そん時、考えんよ。いま決める必要ないかんね。そん時になって、一番やりてぇことをやんよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: できることなら自分もそうしたい、と思った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA5}「ほんじゃ、これにて。これからクラブに行く」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「じゃあ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 会釈をして、歩きだした。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 呼び止められて、振り向いた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA5}「んー、なんつーか、まぁ、・・・がんばれ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: うなずくと、ゆっくり家へ向かって歩きだした。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: まっすぐ家には戻らなかった。公園のベンチで、また時間を無駄に浪費した。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 公園はがらんとしていた。冬の夕方に公園でくつろごうとする人は少ない。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 日が落ちていくのを眺めながら、これからのことを考えた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 専日大に進学することについては、異存はない。現役で入ろうとするから無理が出てくるのだ。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: もし１カ月と少しの間の勉強で合格できるなら、予備校はこの世に存在しないはずだ。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵は、なぜ浪人というアイディアを持たないのだろう。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: １年間、おれは予備校、理恵は大学に通う。どうしてそれではだめなのだろう。結局は、そうなるしかないように思える。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: そうだ。理恵に１年待ってもらおう。そう決心したものの、理恵にそれを言うことを考えると、気が重かった。どうしたら、理恵は納得してくれるだろうか。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「あら」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 佐倉だった。本を抱えていた。図書館の帰りということだった。おれの顔を眺めて、言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「情けない顔にいちだんと磨きがかかった感じだわ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 反発する気が起きなかった。彼女の言うとおりなのだろう、と思った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「専日大、Ｅ判定だったんだ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「それは、あなたにとって驚くようなことなの？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「いや・・・。ただ、これから勉強しても無理なんじゃないかと思ったんだ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「そうね。ほとんど望みはないわね」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「それで？あきらめるの？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: そうしたほうがいいと思う、と返事した。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「模試からまだ１週間しか経ってないわ。ずいぶん早かったわね、挫折するの」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: なるほど、彼女の言うとおりだな、と思った。しかし、そもそも合格できると本気で考えたことは一度もなかった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: それでも、浪人を覚悟すれば、もっと現実的に進学を考えることができる。見通しもたつ。理恵さえ納得してくれれば、それで問題はない。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵は、なぜおれが受験に合格できると思っているのだろうか、と考えた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: どうしたら、彼女の考えを変えさせることができるだろうか。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「なによ。いきなり黙りこんで」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 佐倉を見た。眼鏡の奥にある黒い知性的な目を見た。彼女は、いつでも冷静沈着で動じることがない。研ぎ澄まされた頭脳の持ち主。理恵の親友。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 待てよ、と思った。佐倉なら、おれがどれだけ合格する望みが薄いか知っているし、それを理恵に説明することもできる。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵も親友の佐倉から言われれば、しかたのないことだと納得するかもしれない。思い切って聞いてみた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「その・・・、佐倉さんから理恵に言ってもらえないかな。おれには無理だって」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「理恵に、あなたが専日大に受かるのは無理だ、と言うの？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 不思議そうに言った。おれは、うなずいた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「どうして？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 専日大学を受験することになった経緯を説明した。佐倉は黙って聞いていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「理恵は、おれが受かると思いこんでいる。このままだと、彼女はショックを受けることになる。そうなってほしくないんだ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「おれが説明しても理恵は信じないだろうと思う。でも、佐倉さんの言うことなら、理恵も納得するはずだ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 佐倉は、まっすぐおれの目を見た。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「この前、今年に入ってから勉強を始めたって言ったわよね？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「ということは、正味２週間勉強したのね？たったそれだけで挫折したの？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 答えなかった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「あなたは、どんなことでも２週間であきらめるの？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「それは違う。そういうことじゃない」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「違わないわ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「なぜ、受験勉強なんだ？なぜ、ほかの事ではいけないんだ？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「おれは、受験勉強には向いていないというだけのことだ。別のことなら、簡単にあきらめたりはしない」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 佐倉は、疑わしそうな目で聞いていた。おれは、少しイライラして言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「自分に向いていないことに打ちこんだりするのは間違ってる。無意味だよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「そんなことをするくらいなら、その時間を使って、もっと価値のあることができる。自分にむいていることが」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「大学に行く以外にも選択肢はいくらでもある」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 中野のことを思い出して、言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「受かるはずもない入試のために、必死に勉強する。失敗するために努力する。そんなことは滑稽だと思わないか？何の価値もないと思わないか？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 彼女は眉ひとつ動かさないで、言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「じゃあ、やめたら。自分に向いていないことをしないあなたは、さぞかし価値があるんでしょうから」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: くそっ、と思った。どうして彼女の言うことが、こんなにも自分を傷つけるのだろう。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「どう考えても、いまさら勉強しても手遅れだよ。・・・もし、あと半年前から始めていれば、なんとかなったかもしれないけど」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: そんなつもりはなかったのだが、声が少しうわずっていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「そんな仮定には意味がないわ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「”もしやっていたら”と言ったわね。そんな仮定は、自分の無力さを忘れるための詭弁だわ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「今の自分のみじめさを弁護したいのよ。本当は自分はもっと価値がある、って妄想してるだけだわ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「自分で自分をごまかしているんだわ。みっともないことよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「とにかく、おれは、もっと自分に向いていることをやりたいんだ。受験勉強なんかじゃなく。もっと価値のあることをやる」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「きっと理恵もわかってくれると思う」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「自分に向いていることをやって、理恵を喜ばせる？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: そうは言ってみたものの、具体的なプランがあるわけではなかった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「・・・ひとつ聞くけど、もし理恵が目の前で、プロレスラーに襲われようとしていたら、あなたはどうする？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 奇妙な質問に戸惑った。佐倉は、おれが理恵を大事にする気持ちを推し量っているのだな、と考えた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「助ける」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「でも、そこは山奥で、助けを呼ぼうにも人がいるところまでは半日かかるようなところ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「携帯電話も通じない。それに、まわりには武器になるようなものは何もないの」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「しかも、理恵を襲っている男は、全身が筋肉の鎧に覆われていて、体重もあなたの２倍はある」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「戦っても、あなたに勝ち目はないの。それでも助ける？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「それでも理恵を助ける」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 迷うことなく答えた。もし、そんな事態が実際に起こったとしても、自分は、間違いなく理恵を守るに違いない。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「どうして？あなたに勝ち目のない相手なのよ？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「そんなことは関係ない」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「あら、それはおかしいわね」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: くっくっと笑った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「あなたの理屈ではこうなる筈だわ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「格闘では相手に勝ち目がない。自分に格闘はむいていない」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「だから、戦っても無意味だ。もし自分が小さい頃から空手の特訓でもしていれば、勝てたかもしれないが」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「自分は、その男と戦うより、もっと別の自分にむいている努力する価値があることをやって、理恵を喜ばせる。だから、その男とは戦わない」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: なんとか否定しようとしたが、うまく言葉が出てこなかった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「どうして？さっきあなたが自分で言った理屈よ？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: ベンチから立ち上がった。こんなことには耐えられない、と思った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 黙ったまま１人で歩きだした。佐倉はその場に立ったまま、言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「あなた何歳なの？いつまで甘えたこと言ってるの？現実は、あなたの都合なんて考えてくれないのよ？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 何もかも、くそくらえだ、と思った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 自宅に戻ると、理恵が入り口の前で座っていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 走り寄った。彼女の頬に触れた。冷えきっていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「おかえり。{X92}くん」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 立ちあがり、微笑んで言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「理恵、いつから？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 待っていたのだ。６時間もの間。この寒い中を。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: うろたえて聞いた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「うん。{X92}くんが留守だったから、どこか買い物に行ったのかなって思って、待ってたの」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: それでも、６時間は長すぎる。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「ちょっと用事ができて・・・、電話しようと思ったんだけど・・・。まさか、ここで待ってるとは・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「あ、気にしないで。私が勝手に待ってただけだから」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: おれが途方にくれているのを見て、言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「あのね、昨日の夜に、すごくいい参考書を見つけたの」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「アメリカ史中心なんだけど、すごくわかりやすいの。それで、{X92}くんに早く渡さなきゃって思って・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「図書館かどこかで勉強してるのかな、って思ったんだけど、すれ違いになったら嫌だし、それに入試まであんまり時間がないから」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 彼女がここで待っている間、自分は無気力にぶらぶらして、時間を無駄にしていたのだ。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「もしかして事故にあったんじゃないかって心配しちゃった。へへ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「理恵・・・。とにかく中に入って」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: ドアを開けて、彼女を中に入れると、すぐに暖房のスイッチを入れ、お茶をいれた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: お茶を飲むと、理恵の頬に赤みがさしたような気がした。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「あったかい。ふふっ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵は、いつものように微笑んだ。両手で湯のみを包むように持っていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 彼女を見ながら、自分はとても受験をあきらめるなどと彼女に言うことはできない、と感じた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 入試の日まで全力で勉強するしかない。そうすることでしか、理恵に報いてやることはできない。たとえ、その結果がどうなろうとも。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「どうしたの？ふふっ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵の買ってきた参考書を見せてもらった。彼女の言うとおり、わかりやすく優秀なものだった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「ありがとう。理恵・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「よかった。役にたって。・・・あ、そうだ。{X92}くん、模試どうだった？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 恐る恐る彼女に結果の紙を渡した。理恵は手に取ると、しばらく真剣に見入っていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 長い無言の間をおいて、顔をあげた。笑顔で言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「これなら国語は、心配ないね」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「そう。問題は英語と世界史なんだ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「まだ１カ月あるし、大丈夫。がんばれば、絶対できるようになるから」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵は、模試の結果に失望しなかった。まだ１カ月ある。自分とはなんと考え方が違うことだろう、と思った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「１カ月だよ。がんばって」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「わかった」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「じゃ、世界史始めよっか」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 参考書を開いて言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 彼女に勉強を教わりながら、不思議なものだな、と思った。彼女と一緒なら、乗り切れるような気がしてくる。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「わかった？じゃ、ちょっと復習するよ。大統領の名前を順番に言って」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: やれるだけやってみよう。だめだったら、その時考えればいい。いまの自分にはそれ以外何もできることはないのだ、と思った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《脇谷は”傘島火”で食事をしていた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《評判のラーメン屋で、客はみな行列を覚悟して食べに来る。来店した客のほとんどは、またやってくる。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《常に満席で、客同士の間隔はきわめて狭い。それでも文句を言う客はいなかった。脇谷も常連の１人だった。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}（ちくしょう。やっぱり隠し味はわからねぇな。ここでバイトに入る以外ねぇみてぇだ）
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《脇谷の隣の客が席を立ち、次の客が呼ばれた。脇谷は、隣に座った客をなにげなく見た。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《田代美紀だった。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9B}「な？なんで、あんたの横で食べなきゃいけないわけぇ！？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X83}【店員】{X82}「お客さん、静かにお願いします！」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《店員が鋭く注意した。人気店特有のルールだ。時に、店員のほうが客よりも偉い。声のトーンを落として、脇谷が言った。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「座ってきたのは、そっちじゃねぇか」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9B}「別に好きで座ったわけじゃないわよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《２人は、お互いを無視してラーメンを食べた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《美紀はブラックペパーをかけたくなった。彼女にとって習慣となっていることだ。ペパーの缶は客３人に１つの割合でカウンターに置かれている。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《缶は、美紀から見て脇谷のななめ向こうにあった。脇谷に取ってもらえばよかったのだが、頼むのが嫌なので、手を伸ばして自分で取ろうとした。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《美紀の伸ばした腕が、脇谷の水の入ったコップに当たってしまった。コップが倒れ、こぼれた水が、脇谷のズボンを濡らした。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9B}「あ、ごめん・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「くっ、くっくっく」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《脇谷はコップを立てながら、笑った。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9B}「な、なにがおかしいのよ・・・？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「いや、おまえでも、いちおう謝ったりできるんだなって思ってな」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《美紀は憎々しげに、脇谷を見た。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「・・・おまえ、まだやってるのかよ？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9B}「何をよ？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「あんな連中とつきあったり、援助とかよ・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9B}「よけいなお世話。お説教はやめて。あんたに関係ないでしょ？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《スープを飲みながら、脇谷は言った。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「そりゃ、関係ねぇよ。ただよ、どうしてかなって思ったからよ・・・。おまえ、何のためにやってんだ？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9B}「お金のためよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「ふつうのバイトじゃだめなのかよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9B}「時給８００円とかの？そんなのかったるくて、やってられないよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「おまえの彼氏は知ってるのか？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9B}「うるさいわねー。私の勝手でしょ？誰にも迷惑かけてないでしょ？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9B}「だいたい、あんた何様？偉そうに説教してさー。あんた人に意見できるほどのことしてるわけ？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「べつに説教するつもりはねぇよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9B}「だって、お金がなかったら、なんにもできないじゃん。ここでラーメンも食べられないじゃん」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9B}「結局、あんただってお金欲しいんでしょ？おんなじでしょ？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「おまえと一緒にしないでくれ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9B}「じゃあ、なにが違うの？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「おれは、まともに働いてる」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9B}「安い金で人に使われて働いて、それがそんなに偉いことなの？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9B}「まじめに働いて、ちょっとしかお金もらえないのが、そんなにいいことなの？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「・・・おまえ、そんなに稼いで、なんに遣うんだよ？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9B}「いろいろよ。すぐなくなっちゃうし」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《脇谷は、呆れたように美紀を見た。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9B}「そりゃ、私だって、おこずかいが月に１００万あったら、援助もしないわよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「おまえのやりたいことってのは、金を遣うことしかねぇのか？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9B}「なによ、悪い？そんなこと言って、あんたには何があるのよ？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「おれには・・・、目標がある」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9B}「なによ、目標って？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「・・・おれはよ、学校卒業したら、調理師の免許をとる」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「おれの親父、寿司職人なんだけどよ、親父よりいい職人になりてぇんだ。おれの場合は寿司じゃねぇけどな」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「だから、自分の金で評判のいい店でめし食ってよ、勉強してんだ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「親父が言ってたよ。いい職人になるには、うまい職人から技術を盗めって。だから、そうしてる」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9B}「あんたの目標って、その程度？だめすぎない？笑っちゃうわ。そんなんで、よく人に偉そうに説教できるわね」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《脇谷は、ため息をつくと、空になったラーメンの器をカウンターの上に置いた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「・・・おまえには、わかんねぇかもしれねぇな」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「おれは、自分のやりてぇことをやるだけだ。別に人がそれをどう思おうと、そんなのは知ったことじゃねぇよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「人にどうこう思ってもらうために生きてるわけじゃねぇからな」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《代金を払って、脇谷は席を立った。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《美紀は、なぜか脇谷のことが気になって、後を追うように席を立った。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《店から出て、通りに脇谷の姿を探した。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《２０メートルほど先に、脇谷が立っていた。４人の男に囲まれていた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《３人は美紀の知っている男たちだった。そのうち２人は、美紀を襲った連中だった。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9B}（やだ。どうしよう・・・）
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《その場に立ちすくんで、美紀は事態を見守った。近くに行く気にはなれなかった。彼女自身、あれ以来、連中から逃げていたのだ。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《言い争う声が、激しさを増していき、脇谷の背後に立っていた男が、突然襲いかかった。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9B}（危ない！）
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《脇谷は背後からの攻撃をかわし、反撃をくらわせた。しかし、そこまでだった。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《黒い棒状のもので頭を殴られ、脇谷はよろけた。後は、４人がかりで一方的に殴りつけられ、その場に崩れ落ちた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《４人はかわるがわる脇谷を蹴りつけた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《美紀は夢中で駆け出して、ありったけの声で叫んだ。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9B}「お巡りさーん、こっちです！早く！」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《脇谷を蹴っていた連中が、はっとして顔を向けた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9B}「早く！ここです！早く来て！」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《なおも美紀は叫んだ。連中の死角になっている路地から警官がやってきているように見せようと、手を振って、演技を続けた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9B}「お巡りさん！！早くっ！！」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《脇谷を襲っていた連中は顔を見合わせ、その場から逃げ出した。美紀は、脇谷のそばに駆け寄った。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9B}「だから・・・、言ったのに・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《美紀は、緊張から解放されて、その場にへたりこんでしまった。脇谷が苦痛にうめいた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《脇谷が、朦朧として顔をあげた。なんとか上体を起こすと、道端の植え込みに体を預けた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「叫んでたのは、おまえか・・・？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《美紀がうなずくと、脇谷が微笑した。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「へへ・・・。あいつら、まんまと騙されたな。まったく馬鹿な連中だぜ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《そう言って笑ったが、すぐに苦しそうに咳こんだ。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9B}「だから言ったでしょ？私のことなんか、ほっとけばよかったって。人のことにかかわってもいいことなんかないでしょ！？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《美紀の声は震えていた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《脇谷は、微笑して美紀を見た。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「おれは、自分の目の前で女の子が襲われていたら、助けるよ。それのどこがおかしいんだ？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《美紀は、あっけにとられて脇谷を見た。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「助けないで、ほっとけばいいって、おまえは言うけどよ・・・、おれにはそのほうがよっぽどおかしいことに見えるぜ・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《美紀の目から涙が溢れた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9B}「何それ・・・。全然わかんないよぉ・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《美紀は涙を止めることができなかった。どうして自分が泣いてしまったのか、彼女にはわからなかった。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵が帰ってから、だいぶ時間が経ったように思える。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: おれは、彼女が持ってきてくれた参考書で、世界史の勉強を続けていた。問題を解き、解答を見、教科書を参照する。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 参考書の字が、ぼやけて見えた。目をマッサージし、深呼吸した。時計の針は３時半ばを指していた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 参考書のページを見て、もう３０分も同じページのままだったことに気がついた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 頭を振り、眠気を追い払おうとした。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 集中するのが困難になっているのを感じた。眠気ざまし用のガムを噛んでみたが、効果は得られなかった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: まだ眠るわけにはいかない。入試が終わるまで、睡眠時間は４時間と決めている。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 台所に行って顔を水で洗った。冷蔵庫から氷を取り出し、口に放りこんだ。わずかだが、効果があった。机に戻った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 机の上に置いた理恵の写真を眺めた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 写真の中の彼女は、いつも微笑んでいる。現実の彼女も、そうであってほしい。そのためには、これくらいで音を上げるわけにはいかない。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 勉強が苦にならないことが受験勉強の才能だ、と佐倉は言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: ということは、自分には才能がないのだ。才能がないなら、努力で補うしかない。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 参考書を開いて、アメリカ独立戦争についての勉強を続けた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《脇谷は家の手伝いをしていた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《店は、ランチが終わる昼の２時から夕方６時まで閉められる。その間、彼は、主に店の掃除や倉庫から飲みものを運んだりする仕事をこなす。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《脇谷がビールのケースを店に運んでいると、入り口が開いた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《店の営業時間を知らない客が、間違えて入ってくることがしばしばある。脇谷は入り口のほうに向かって、言った。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「すいません、お客さん。６時からなんすよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9B}「脇谷」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《間違えて入ってきた客ではなかった。田代美紀だった。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「なんだ、おまえ、・・・うちに食いに来たのか？今は休み時間なんだよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9B}「店の手伝い？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「ん？ああ。見りゃわかるだろう」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《美紀は店の中へと入った。店内を見回した。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「だから、店は６時からだって言ってるだろうが」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9B}「べつに、食べに来たんじゃないもん」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《美紀は脇谷の顔を見た。小さな絆創膏が貼ってあった。顔の腫れは、ほとんど引いていた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9B}「脇谷、顔腫れてた時のほうが、ハンサムだったじゃん」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《美紀は、そう言って笑った。脇谷が顔をしかめた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「うるせぇ。何しに来たんだよ、おまえ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9B}「べつに」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「なにが”べつに”だよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《美紀はカウンターの席に座った。彼女の表情は、心なしか以前より明るかった。脇谷は、運んでいたビールのケースを置いた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9B}「ね、脇谷」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「ああ？なんだよ？」

strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「理恵さんのことを考えるだけで、この世に理恵さんって人がいるって思うだけで、幸せな気分になるんだ」

strings.jp: {X96}「理恵さんの笑顔を思い浮かべるだけで、嫌なことも忘れちまう」

strings.jp: {X96}「ほんと不思議なもんだぜ。人を好きになるってのはよ。その人のことを考えるだけで、まわりの景色まで違って見える」

strings.jp: 《そう言うと、脇谷は美紀を見て微笑んだ。美紀は、脇谷から視線をそらし、小さくうなずいた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 昨日、雪が降った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: ２月に入って初めてのことで、かなりの積雪だったらしい。らしい、というのは見ていないからだ。見ていないのは、まったく外出していないからだった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: あと１０日あまりで入学試験が始まる。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 時間は容赦なく過ぎていき、不安が日々増していく。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: あと１０日ちょっとで何ができるだろう、と考えた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 普通の受験生であれば、今ごろは、勉強したことを確認し、記憶のほころびを見つけようとして、何度も解いた参考書を見直しているはずだ。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: おれは復習という段階にたどりついていない。理恵からもらった参考書類は、まだ解き終わってすらいない。試験当日までかかるかもしれない。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 自分のしていることは、ただの悪あがきでしかないのではないだろうか。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: もっと早くから勉強を始めていれば、と思い、首を振る。できることをやる以外ない、という結論に落ち着く。毎日考えることだ。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 不安から逃れようと、英語の単語集を開くと、電話が鳴った。脇谷だった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「よぉ、{X92}。どうだ、元気でやってるか？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「なんとかやってるよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: いつもと変わらない親しみのこもった彼の声を聞いて、自分がリラックスするのを感じた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: しばらく、とりとめのないことを話した。脇谷が、思い出したように用件を切り出した。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「そのな、親父からサッカーの試合のチケットもらったんだよ。友だちと観に行ってこいってよ」

strings.jp: {X94}「親善試合に近いけど、ワールドカップ予選の前哨戦的な意味あいがある」

strings.jp: {X96}「ふうん」

strings.jp: 行きたかった。今年のショウナスティはベルギーが参加する。ミッドフィールダーのビーフォは、おれにとって最も好きな選手の１人だった。

strings.jp: 理恵に電話でそのことを話すと、彼女は、１日のうち何時間かは日光を浴びないと、健康を害する確率が高くなる、と言って、心配していた。

strings.jp: 勉強をするには、自分の部屋が最も都合がいい場所なのだが、体調を崩すことは、もっとも望ましくないことだ。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: そういうわけで、気分転換をかねて、外へ出て、公園で勉強することにした。

strings.jp: 昼間に外出したのは久しぶりで、少し寒いことをのぞけば、外の空気が気持ちよかった。

strings.jp: ベンチで単語の暗記に励んでいると、脇谷に会った。女の子と一緒に歩いていた。

strings.jp: {X96}「ん・・・？おお。こいつは、{X92}っていってよ、同じクラスの友だちなんだ。ま、親友ってやつだ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9B}「よろしくー」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: はにかんだように笑った。かわいい子だな、と思った。

strings.jp: {X96}「こいつは、美紀っていってよ、まぁ、なんだ、おれのライバルみてぇなもんだ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 脇谷は、愉快そうに隣にいる女の子を紹介した。

strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「はははははっ。実は、ちょっとした勝負をしててよぉ・・・」

strings.jp: {X9B}「やめて、脇谷。それは２人の秘密にして」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 女の子は、恥ずかしそうに笑った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「ん？そうか。そんなら、そういうことにしとくか。はははっ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 笑っている女の子を見ていて、あることに気がついた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 元日に伝言ダイヤルで呼び出した女の子にそっくりだったのだ。脇谷にそのことを言ってみた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「おう。そうなんだよ。それが、どういうわけか、いまじゃ同じ勝負で競う仲だよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9B}「もう。あの時の話はやめてー」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 恥ずかしくて、たまらないといった感じだった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 女の子は、脇谷に好意をよせているのではないか、と感じた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: そこまでいかなくても、いい友人という関係であることは間違いない。不思議なものだな、と考えた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: しばらくの間、脇谷たちと、楽しい時間を過ごした。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: ふと、脇谷が、女の子が黙っているのに気がついて、言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「どうしたよ？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9B}「ん。・・・親友っていいなって。ちょっとうらやましいって思って」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「おまえだって、友だちはいるだろう？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9B}「でも、私、親友って呼べるような友だちはいないから・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「そうか」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 脇谷がこんなに女の子と打ち解けているのは、見たことがなかったな、と思った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 脇谷に意味ありげな表情で、聞いた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「この子と、つきあってるのか？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「おいおい。よしてくれよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 笑って否定した。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9B}「そ、そ、そうよ。変なこと言わないでよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 脇谷はいつもと変わらない表情で笑っていたが、女の子のほうは、うろたえていたように見えた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「こいつには、ちゃんと好きな人がいるんだよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 女の子を見て、言った。女の子が小さくうなずいた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 脇谷と女の子の仲良く話す様子を見て、おれは心が軽くなったような、安堵感を感じていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: いずれ、脇谷とこの子はつきあうようになるかもしれない。いつまでも進展しない理恵との関係を諦めて。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: そうなれば、また昔のように、脇谷と心から笑いあえるようになるはずだ。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: やっと脇谷に理恵とのことを話すことができる日が来るのではないか、と思った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9B}「へぇ。意外ときれいじゃん」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《脇谷の部屋の中を見回して、美紀は言った。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「おれは、きれい好きなんだよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《美紀と脇谷はこたつに入って、向かいあった。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《脇谷がミカンを投げた。美紀は片手でキャッチすると、ミカンを食べ始めた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9B}「理恵さんとは、どこまでいったの？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「ど、どこまでって、なんだよ・・・？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9B}「だからぁ、キスしたとかさぁ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「キ、キス！？おまえ、なに言ってんだよ！？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《脇谷は、うろたえて、くわえていたタバコを落とした。美紀は、ミカンを口に放りこんで言った。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9B}「その様子だと、手をつないだこともないんでしょ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「ね、ねぇよ。言ったろ、片思いだって」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9B}「２人きりで、どこか行ったことは？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「ねぇよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9B}「じゃあ、好きって言ってもいないんでしょ」

a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9B}「理恵さんは、脇谷の気持ちを知ってるの？」

a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《脇谷は、横を向いて煙を吐き出した。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9B}「あっきれた！それじゃあ、まだ全然何もしてないのと同じじゃん」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《脇谷は、小さくなって聞いた。美紀が、ぴしゃりと言った。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9B}「そう！」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《美紀は、脇谷をまっすぐ見て言った。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9B}「そんなんじゃ、何年経っても、恋人になんかなれないよ？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「だってよぉ、何をやったらいいのか・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9B}「理恵さんの好きなタイプは、どんな人なの？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9B}「好きな芸能人は？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《脇谷は、気まずそうに首を振った。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9B}「脇谷、理恵さんのこと何にも知らないんじゃない！」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9B}「そうよぉ。・・・まったく、それじゃ、うまくいかなくて当然よぉ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9B}「はぁ・・・。しょうがない。私が、一肌脱いであげる」

strings.jp: {X96}「なんだ？なんのことだ？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《脇谷は、戸惑って美紀を見た。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9B}「つまり、私が理恵さんのことを調べてあげるってこと」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「おまえが！？いいよ。そんなことしてくれなくてよ。よせ。やめてくれ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《脇谷はどぎまぎして言った。美紀は首を振った。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9B}「いまさら恥ずかしがってる場合じゃないでしょ？脇谷、来月には卒業でしょ？卒業したら、もう気軽に会ったりできなくなるよ？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「む。まぁ、そうだけどよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9B}「もう時間ないんだから」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「そうはいってもよぉ・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《脇谷は、下を向いてタバコを消すと、箱からもう１本取り出した。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9B}「それに、私、脇谷には借りがあるもん」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「なんだよ、借りって？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《脇谷は顔をあげた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9B}「私、脇谷に会わなかったら、いまも援助とかして、ふらふらしてたと思う。きっと、好きな人もできなかったよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《少しの間、２人は見つめあっていた。脇谷は、しぶしぶという感じで言った。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「そこまで言うならしかたねぇな。・・・でもよ、美紀、どうやって調べるんだよ？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9B}「尾行する」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9B}「恋は情報収集がポイントよ。女のことは女のほうがよくわかるし」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9B}「好きな食べ物、好きなマンガ、読んでる雑誌とか。どんなプレゼントがうれしいとか。あと、好きな男性のタイプ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9B}「いちいち人に聞いたりするより、尾行したほうが早いもん」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9B}「でも、脇谷じゃ面が割れてるし、だいいち、男がやったら、ストーカーになっちゃうでしょ？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「いや、でもよ、いくらなんでも尾行はまずいんじゃねぇのか？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9B}「大丈夫！私にまかせておいて。理恵さんのこと、もう完璧に調べちゃうから」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《美紀の勢いに圧倒されて、脇谷は言った。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「まぁ、そんなに一生懸命やらなくていいからよ。あんまり無理するな」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9B}「脇谷、きっと私に感謝するわよ。・・・そうだ。脇谷、ピッチの番号教えといて」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「ああ、かまわねぇぜ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9B}「理恵さんのこと、なんかわかったら、かけるから」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《脇谷は、手近にあった紙切れに番号を書きこんだ。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
