strings.jp: {X96}「・・・だけどよぉ、美紀、おまえ、自分のことは、どうするんだよ？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9B}「人のことより自分の心配をしなさいよ。私は、べつに急いでないから、いいの」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 目が覚めると、そのまま机に直行し、寝る前に開いていたページを見、エンピツを手に持つ。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 機械的に勉強している自分に気がついて、何のために勉強しているのか、わからなくなる。自分は機械だ。勉強以外なにもしない機械だ。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: そうでなければ、家から１歩も出ないで、起きてから寝るまで勉強しているはずなどありえない。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 新聞もテレビも見ず、誰にも会わないという生活を続けていると、自分が世の中から切り離された存在になったと感じる。どうしてこんなことになったのだろう。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 明日から、３日連続の入学試験が始まる。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 試験さえ終われば、もとの生活に戻ることができる。それを望んでいるのに、試験の日が来てほしいとは少しも思わなかった。机の上の理恵の写真を見た。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵が用意してくれた参考書は、まだ終わっていなかった。せめて最終日までには終わってくれるといいのだが。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 考えるな。よけいなことは何も考えるな。とにかく覚えろ。ひとつでも多くの事柄を記憶しろ。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: そう自分に言い聞かせて、英単語集を開き、勉強を続けた。しばらくすると、理恵がやってきた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: ドアを開けると、理恵は、あっけにとられたように、おれの顔を見た。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「ちょっと、やつれたね・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: おれの顔を触れて、言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「ちゃんと寝てる？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 毎日３時間は寝ている、と答えた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「たったそれだけ！？だめだよ、もっと寝なきゃ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 心配そうにおれを見て、言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「ちゃんと睡眠をとらないと。頭がよく働くには、栄養のあるものをきちんと食べて、しっかり睡眠をとるのが大切なんだよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: そうかもしれない。１日が４８時間あれば、喜んでそうするだろう。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「あ、そうそう、差し入れ持ってきたの」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: バスケットをおれに手渡した。サンドイッチが入っていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「明日からだね・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「じゃ、ちょっと、テストね。・・・ズッギャアーン！理恵の世界史クイズ～！」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 彼女がアメリカ史の問題を出し、それに答えた。正解率は７割ほどだった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: しばらく、黙ったまま、お互いを見ていた。理恵が言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「・・・大丈夫だよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵は優しく微笑んだ。おれは、まだ終わっていない参考書のことを考えた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「私から見ても、{X92}くんは、ほんとうによくやったもの」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「あとは、体調に気をつければ、大丈夫」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 考えていることを悟られないように、曖昧に微笑した。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「あ、それからね、お昼休みだけど、外に出るといいよ。頭が、リフレッシュできるから。２人で見にいった時、座ったベンチ覚えてる？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「もし緊張したり、不安になったら、あそこに座って、４月には、ここにいるんだ、って自分に言い聞かせるの」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「緊張してたら、できることもできなくなっちゃうから」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: うなずいた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「それで、もしよかったら、私のことを思い出して。・・・なんちゃって、へへ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 恥ずかしそうに笑った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「じゃ、私、帰るね。邪魔しちゃ悪いから」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「がんばって」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 彼女が帰った後、鏡で自分の顔を見てみた。何日ぶりだろう。鏡を見るという行為を忘れていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 頬のあたりがこけていて、無精ヒゲが不規則にのびていた。目の下にクマができていた。まるで病人のようだな、と思った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵の持ってきたサンドイッチを頬ばりながら、勉強を続けた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 気がつくと、夜の１２時になっていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 思考が鈍り、瞼が重い。眠気との戦いは、すっかり習慣になっている。机から立ち上がり、水道水で顔を洗った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 冷蔵庫から強壮剤を取り出し、一気に飲みこんだ。もう数ダースは飲んだのだが、この味だけは慣れることができない。頭を振って、机に戻った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 強壮剤の効き目はないに等しかった。この世には睡眠薬はいくらでもあるのに、不眠薬がないのはなぜなのだろう、と思った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 小さく呪いの言葉を吐いて、トイレに立った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: ｄａｉｎｔｙ。優美な。好みのやかましい。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: ｄａｌｌｙ。もてあそぶ。戯れる。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: ｄａｍｅｓｃｈｏｏｌ。英国で女性が子どもに読み書きを教えた私塾。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: ｄａｍｍｉｔ。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: ちくしょう。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 小便をしながら、考えていることを、すべて声に出していたのに、気がついた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: おれは、どうにかなってしまったのかもしれない。べつに驚くほどのことでもないが・・・。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: ふと、小便に目をやると、血が混じっていた。血尿だ。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: べつに騒ぐほどのことでもないな、と考え、小さく笑った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 机に戻り、勉強を続けた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: ノートの上に水滴が落ちた。なんだろう、と思い、ティッシュで拭った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 自分の涙だった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: いよいよ、自分はどうにかなってしまったに違いない。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 自分は、どうして、ここまでして勉強しているのだろう。受験がすんでしまえば、何の役にもたたなくなることを。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 少しの間、そのことを考えたが、すぐにやめた。勉強を続けた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《２月１３日。美紀は、駅前のファッションビルにある菓子店にいた。彼女の１０メートル先を河合理恵が歩いていた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《店はバレンタイン・デーを明日に控え、１年のうちでも、最高のデコレーションを施して、女性たちの購買意欲をそそろうとしている。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《美紀は、ＰＨＳを取り出すと、脇谷の番号を押した。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9B}「脇谷。あたし」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9B}「いま、理恵さんがチョコチップを買ったわよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「ああ？おまえ、ほんとに尾行してるのか？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9B}「そうよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「そうよって、おまえ・・・。まぁ、いいけどよ。おまえ、そんな何買ったとかいちいち電話してたら、きりがねぇだろう」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9B}「ばっかねぇ。明日はバレンタインじゃない」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9B}「チョコチップは、自分でチョコレートを作るときの材料でしょ？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「む。そうなのか」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9B}「つまり、理恵さんはチョコを作るのよ。誰かにあげるために」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9B}「もしかしたら、脇谷にあげるのかもしれないよ？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《美紀は、おどけたように、言った。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「ま、まさか・・・。ははっ、なに言ってんだよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《脇谷は、ぎこちなく笑った。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9B}「だって、ないとは言いきれないよ？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「よせ・・・。おまえ、妙なこと言いやがって・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9B}「これで、理恵さんが誰かにチョコあげるのは確定ね。明日は理恵さんを尾行して、誰にチョコをあげるか調べるね」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「なんだとう！？やめろ、美紀！」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9B}「やめないよー、だ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《まだ脇谷が何かしゃべっていたが、美紀はＰＨＳを切った。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《理恵が店を出た後、美紀は店内を歩き、さまざまな趣向を凝らしたチョコレートを眺めた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9B}（いいなぁ、理恵さん。料理とか得意なんだろうな・・・。私は、そういうの全然できないし・・・）
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9B}（それに、きれいだし・・・。私なんか勝ち目ないよね・・・）
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《美紀は、ひとつのチョコレートに目をとめた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9B}（あ、かわいい！これにしよう・・・）
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《グリーンの紙に赤いリボンで包装された商品を手に取ると、美紀は店員に言った。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9B}「これ、ください」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: そんな馬鹿な、と思った。もう一度、最初から問題用紙を見た。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 何度見直してみても、どの設問も自分の勉強しなかったことばかりだった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: １問もわからない。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 周囲の受験生は、よどみなく解答を書きこんでいる。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: おれは解答用紙を前に、何をすることもできず、絶望的な気分で座っていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 大学の掲示板に合格者の受験番号が貼り出されていた。どこを見ても、自分の受験番号はない。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 間違いではないか、と思い、受験票の番号を確認してみる。やはり、自分の番号はどこにもない。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 呆然として、その場から歩きだした。合格したのだろう、友人と抱き合って喜んでいる学生とすれ違った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 門の前に、理恵が立っていた。隣には、おれの知らない男が立っていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 男が理恵の肩を抱き、２人はおれを残して歩きだした。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 暗い表情で言うと、理恵は、おれに背を向けた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「理恵！待ってくれ！」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 走りだしたが、何かにつまずいて、転んでしまった。激しく地面に倒れこんだ。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: そこまでで、目がさめた。自分が理恵を追って走った時の、頬にあたった風の感触がまだ感じられる。とにかく、夢だった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: ベッドから起き上がって、時計を見た。朝の６時だった。まだ鳴っていない目覚ましをオフにした。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: ２月１４日。入試は今日で最後だ。シャワーを浴びに、浴室のほうへ歩いた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 昨日までの試験について、考えた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 国語はほとんどの問題に答えることができた。英語は、おそらく半分程度の正解率だろう。やはり、鍵を握っているのは、世界史だ。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 一昨日の経済学部の入試では、世界史は、慣例をやぶってインドなどアジアの近、現代を中心にした出題となっていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 昨日の商学部では、重点的に学習したアメリカ史からの出題はなかった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 今年から出題傾向が変わったのかもしれない。今日もこの調子だったら、おしまいだ。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: やはり、４０日くらいの勉強では、無理があったと思わないわけにはいかない。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: シャワーを浴びると、カバンに参考書類を詰めこんだ。受験票を持ち、家を出た。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 午前９時。バスを降り、大学の門をくぐった。寒い日だった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 試験の１時間前に、教室に入った。来るのが早すぎたのか、まだ受験生はまばらだった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: さすがに３日目ともなると、校舎の配置もわかって、迷うこともない。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 机の上に貼られた受験番号を確認し、席に座った。大きな教室で、高校の３倍は広く、天井が高い。かすかな空調の作動音がしていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 最初の科目は英語で、試験の開始は１０時３０分だった。配点は１５０点。３科目中最大だ。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: これだけ英語が重視されているのに、日本の学生が英語をしゃべれないのは、外国人にとっては奇妙にうつるのに違いない。皮肉な気持ちで微笑した。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: しばらく英熟語を復習していると、１人また１人と受験生が教室に入ってきた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 席で復習に励む受験生は少なく、廊下に出て談笑する受験生の声が聞こえた。余裕があるな、と思った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: こんなところで必死になっても、意味はないのかもしれない。しかし、何もしなければ、不安感に襲われるのがわかっていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 夢中で勉強していると、いつのまにか、ほとんどの学生が着席していた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 試験官が問題の束を抱えて入ってきた。いよいよだな、と思った。心拍数が上昇するのを感じた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《学校がないので、脇谷は、ここのところ１０時に目をさますのが常だった。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《もぞもぞと起き出したものの、寒いので、こたつに入った。うとうとしていると、ＰＨＳが鳴った。美紀からだった。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9B}「今、理恵さんが家を出たわ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《美紀は、息を弾ませて言った。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「美紀？おまえ、本当に尾行すんのか？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9B}「そうよ。どこに行くのかわかったら、またかけるね」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《不安にかられて、脇谷が言った。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「おい。もういいよ。やめてくれ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9B}「やめない」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《そう言うと、美紀が電話を切った。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《脇谷は、タバコを取り出すと、火をつけた。落ち着かなかった。電話のせいだった。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}（美紀のやつ、よけいなことしやがって・・・）
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《脇谷は立ち上がった、窓の外を眺めた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}（そんなこと、あるわけねぇよな・・・）
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《脇谷は、自分の妄想を首を振って打ち消した。理恵が自分にチョコレートをくれるのではないか、という妄想を。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 終了のブザーが鳴り、解答用紙が集められた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 横の受験生から解答用紙を渡された。自分の用紙をその上にのせ、隣の受験生に渡した。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 自信をもって解答できたのは、半分といったところだった。後は、あてずっぽうが当たることを祈るしかない。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 周囲の学生たちが、たったいま終わった問題の解答について話しあっていた。それを聞いていると、自分の解答のほとんどが間違っていたのではないか、と思えてきた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: もう終わったことについて考えてもしかたがない。まだ国語と世界史がある、と自分に言い聞かせようとしたが、うまくいかなかった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: ふいに理恵の言葉を思い出した。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 彼女は、昼休みに外へ出れば、気持ちが落ち着くと言っていた。アドバイスに従い、外へ出ることにした。ため息をついて、席を立った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《１２時３０分。美紀は理恵の約２０メートル後方を歩いていた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《理恵が大学の門の前で立ち止まるのを見て、美紀は歩道の反対側に渡った。理恵の背中ごしに大学の中が見えた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《美紀は、門に刻まれた文字を見た。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9B}（専日大学、か・・・）
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《美紀は、ＰＨＳを取り出すと、脇谷の番号を押した。１回の呼び出し音で、脇谷が出た。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9B}「ハロー」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「遅かったじゃねぇか！いま、どこだ？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《興奮した口調で、脇谷が早口に言った。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9B}「あれ？脇谷、さっき、もういいって言わなかったっけ？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9B}「あはははは。嘘よ、嘘。いまね、専日大学にいるの」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9B}「理恵さんは待ち合わせしてるみたい。相手は大学生かもね」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《脇谷が深いため息をついた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9B}「どうする？もうやめる？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《少しの沈黙があって、脇谷が言った。弱々しい声だった。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「いや。やめるな。どんなやつに渡すのか見てくれ。理恵さんが、どんなやつとつきあってるのか、それだけでも知っておきてぇ・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「すまねぇな・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「ふぅ・・・。そりゃあよ、理恵さんに彼氏がいても不思議じゃねぇとは思ってたけどよ。いざ、こうしてそれがわかると、なんとも言えねぇ気分だぜ・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《美紀は、うつむいた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9B}「・・・ごめんね」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9B}「私、おせっかいだったかも・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「いや、そんなことねぇ。理恵さんに彼がいても、別におまえのせいじゃねぇしよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9B}「そうだけど・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「気にするな」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「それよりよ、どうなんだ、理恵さんは」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《美紀は、理恵のことを思い出して、顔をあげた。理恵は同じところに立っていた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9B}「校門から入ってすぐのところに立ってる。誰か探してるみたい」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「男が来たら、ちゃんと教えてくれ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《ややあって、脇谷が言った。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「勝負、おれの負けだな・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「おまえは、がんばれよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《それからしばらく、美紀も脇谷も何も言わなかった。風が吹き、美紀の髪を乱した。その時、理恵が誰かを見つけたように、手を振った。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9B}「あ！？理恵さんが手を振ってる。きっと待ち合わせの相手だわ。・・・いよいよ登場よぉ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵の前に、男が走ってきた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「どうした、美紀！？どんな男が来たんだ！？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9B}（こんなことって・・・）
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《美紀は、自分の見たものが信じられなかった。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《理恵の前に現れたのは、脇谷が親友だ、と言って美紀に紹介した男だった。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《理恵がバッグから包みを取り出すのが見えた。美紀は、その包みを知っていた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《美紀の目の前が曇った。美紀は泣いていた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「美紀！？どうしたんだよ！？・・・美紀？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 目の前に立っている理恵を、信じられない思いで見つめた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: ベンチに座っていると、理恵の声が聞こえたような気がした。気のせいだ、と思い、なにげなく校門のほうを見ると、理恵が立っていたのだった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「よかったぁ！{X92}くんが、ベンチにいなかったら、どうしようって思ってたんだ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: うれしそうに微笑んで、言った。寒さのために頬が赤みを帯びていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「あのベンチからだと、校門が見えるでしょ？・・・英語どうだった？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 正直に、半分くらいできた、と教えた。彼女は、うなずいて聞いていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「あのね、ほんとは終わってから渡そうと思ってたんだけど、やっぱり昼休みのほうがいいから、思い切って来てみたの」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「はい、これ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: バッグから鮮やかなレッドの包みを取り出した。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「開けてみて」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 中には小さな箱があった。開けてみると、円形のチョコレートが入っていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 表面におれの名前と、アルファベットがレリーフされていた。”ｇｏ　ｔｈｅ　ｄｉｓｔａｎｃｅ”、とあった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「”ｇｏ　ｔｈｅ　ｄｉｓｔａｎｃｅ”。最後までやりぬけ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: そう言うと、理恵は照れたように笑った。やっと、今日がバレンタイン・デーだったことを思い出した。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「わざわざ、これを渡しに？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「うん。魔法のチョコだよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 得意そうに笑う理恵を見た。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 彼女はいつでも、損得など考えず、おれを信頼し、応援してくれる。自分は、彼女に何をしてやれるだろうか、と考えた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「・・・理恵、ありがとう」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「ちゃんと意味があるんだよ。脳が活動するエネルギーは糖なの。だから、これを食べれば、脳にエネルギーがいくというわけ。ふふっ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: おれは、彼女を抱きしめた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 今朝見た悪夢のことを考え、自分が入試に失敗した時のことを考えた。どうすることもできない無力感がこみあげてきた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「おい、美紀！？どうしたんだ。返事をしろ！」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《美紀の目に涙がとめどなく溢れてきた。美紀は、ＰＨＳの電源を切った。向きを変え、大学を後にした。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: おれは、彼女に報いてやりたい。しかし・・・。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「その・・・、理恵、もし、おれが落ちたら・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵は、おれから体を離し、さえぎるように首を振って、微笑んだ。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「{X92}くんは合格するよ。あんなにがんばったじゃない・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵はおれの手を握ると、ゆっくり言い聞かせるように言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「やれる、できるって信じるの」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: そう言って、おれの目を見た。言われたとおり、信じようとしてみた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「できるって言ってみて」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「できる」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 満足したように微笑した。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「・・・試験が終わったら、一緒にお祝いしよう？私、駅前の喫茶店で待ってるよ？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「がんばってね」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵は、手を振ると、門の外へと歩いていった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 彼女が行ってしまった後、その場に立ったまま、チョコレートを眺めた。自分がどれだけ彼女を愛しているか、考えた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: チョコレートを食べながら、試験会場へと歩いた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 校舎の入り口で立ち話をしている受験生が、おれの姿を見て、クスクス笑っていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: こんなところでチョコレートを食べる姿が、おかしいのだろう。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 笑いたければ、笑えばいい。おれは、べつに恥ずかしくはなかった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: どうして恥ずかしいことがあるだろう。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: このチョコレートは、世界一素晴らしい女性からの贈り物なのだ。このチョコレートは、おれの誇りだ。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵のチョコレートを食べながら、これからの試験のことを考えた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 彼女に言われたことを、心の中で繰り返した。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 「できる」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 試験が終わった後、理恵との約束どおり、まっすぐ喫茶店に向かった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 店に入ると、理恵が佐倉と一緒に座っていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 佐倉が理恵を見た。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「理恵？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「{X92}くんと、待ち合わせしていたの・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「なんだ。そうだったの」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 佐倉は、偶然、喫茶店の前を通りかかって、理恵を見つけ、ちょっと話をしていたのだ、ということだった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 彼女たちの向かいの席に腰かけた。佐倉が、おれを見て、言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「ちょっと痩せた、というか、やつれたわね・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵が同意して、うなずいた。たぶん、そうなのだろう、と思った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「今日、試験だったの？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「どうだった？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「わからない・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵は、かすかに不安そうな表情になって、おれを見た。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「でも、これだけは言える。おれは、自分にできるだけのことをやった」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: そう。結果はどうあれ、本当のことだった。理恵は、小さくうなずいて、微笑んだ。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「それで、いいのよ・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 佐倉の言葉に驚いて、彼女を見た。信じられないことに、彼女はにっこりと微笑んでいた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 公園で佐倉と交わした会話を思い出した。あの時、彼女がおれにいわんとしたことの意味が、わかったような気がした。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 急に緊張から解放されたように、おれは椅子に寄りかかった。張りつめていた糸が切れたように、力が抜けてしまった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「お疲れさま・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵はそう言って、微笑んだ。理恵の言葉を聞いて、やっと終わったな、と実感した。考えてみると、あっというまだったような気がする。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 佐倉を見た。先ほどの微笑は消え去って、いつもの冷静な佐倉に戻っていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「佐倉さんは、もう受験は終わったの？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「まだよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: ふと、佐倉に前から聞いてみようと思っていたことを思い出した。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「佐倉さんは、勉強が楽しい？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 一瞬考えて、言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「好きな学科は楽しいわ。でも、中には好きじゃない学科もあるし、その中には、私にとって、一生無意味なものもある。当然、楽しくないわ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: それなら、どうしてそんなに勉強するのだろう。聞いてみた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「私が私のしたいことをするのに、どうしても東都大クラスの法学部に進学する必要があるからよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「べつに受験勉強自体は、そんなに好きじゃないわ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵が微笑した。彼女は、佐倉が勉強する理由を知っているのだろう。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「私は、弁護士になりたいの。それも最優秀の」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「社会的弱者といわれる人たちがいるわ。誰よりも弁護を必要としているのに、弁護費用がない人たちが」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「不当な差別を受けている人たち。外国人。無知につけこまれて騙される老人・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「私は、そういう人たちの力になりたいの」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 何の気負いも感じさせずに、さらりと言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「優秀な弁護士を雇える人間は、本当は刑務所に入るべき連中であることが多いわ。でも、いくらそんなことを指摘してみても、何も変わらないわ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「ある作家が、こんなことを言っていたわ・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「いじめられている子を助けようとしても、自分が強くなければ、自分もいじめられるだけだ。助けるには、まず、自分が強くなければならない」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「社会的強者にしか、社会的弱者を助けることはできない」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「でも、弱者を救おうとする強者は少ない。残念なことだけど、真実だわ。私はそういう状況を少しでも改善したいの」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: おれが理解しているかどうか、確認するように間をおいた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「だから。・・・わかった？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: わかったというしるしに、うなずいた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「さてと、私はまだ勉強しなくちゃならないわ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: そう言って、立ち上がった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「じゃあね、理恵。あまり遅くなる前に帰ったほうがいいわよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「うん。バイバイ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 手を振って、佐倉は店を出た。理恵と２人きりになった。理恵は、かすかに微笑してティーカップを見つめていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「終わったよ・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵を見つめた。お互い何も言わなかったが、見つめあっているだけで幸福だった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: そのうちに、おれは、そこで眠ってしまった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: ３時間後に目覚めると、理恵はまだそこにいて、微笑んでいた。どうして起こしてくれなかったのか、と聞くと、彼女は言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「だって、疲れてると思ったから・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: いくら疲れている、といっても、理恵を待たせてまで寝ようとは思わない。勘定をすませ、店を出た。外は、すっかり暗くなっていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「理恵、家に電話した？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「してない」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「きっと心配してるよ。帰ろう。送るから」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵はおれの腕に手を回して、寄りかかった。空を見上げると、星がよく見えた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: おれは微笑して、彼女を抱き寄せた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《午後１１時、脇谷が部屋でうたた寝していると、ＰＨＳが鳴った。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《脇谷は起き上がると、慌てて電話をとった。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《しばらく間があって、美紀がそれだけ言った。声が力を失って、弱々しかった。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「どうしたんだよ、今日は！？あれから、おまえに電話しても、電源が切れてるみたいで、全然つながらねぇしよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「おまえ、なにやってたんだよ？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《美紀は黙っていた。雑音に混じって、小さな呼吸音だけが、聞こえてきた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「おい、美紀、どうした？なにかあったのか？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「いま、どこにいる？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「よし。そこにいろよ。いまから行くからな」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《脇谷はＰＨＳを切ると、駆け足で家を出た。小雨が降り、寒さの厳しい夜だった。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《脇谷が息を切らして公園にやってくると、噴水の前のベンチに美紀が１人で座っていた。脇谷は駆け寄った。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「美紀！おまえ、どうしたんだよ・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《美紀は、ゆっくりと顔をあげた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《美紀は悲しげに、視線を落とした。雨が、少し強さを増した。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「なぁ、美紀、頼む。なにがあったか教えてくれ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《２人は、沈黙したまま、向きあっていた。脇谷が、じりじりして聞いた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「理恵さんの彼氏は、どんなやつだったんだ？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《美紀はうつむいたまま、顔をあげようとしなかった。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「美紀、そもそも、理恵さんのこと調べるって言いだしたのは、おまえだったじゃねぇか」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《少し間をおいて、美紀が、呟くように言った。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9B}「こんなことになるって知ってたら・・・、そんなこと言わなかったよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「美紀、もう理恵さんに彼氏がいることは、わかってるんだ。もうこれ以上、おれがショックを受けることはねぇよ。だから、心配すんな・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「ただ、せめて、そいつがどんな奴なのかだけ、知っておきてぇんだ。・・・本当に、それだけなんだよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9B}「もういいじゃん。理恵さんに彼氏がいるって、それがわかったら、もういいじゃん」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「理屈のうえではそうかもしれねぇ。だけどよ、それを知らねぇと、理恵さんのこと、諦めきれねぇんだ・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《長い無言の間をおいて、美紀が言った。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9B}「ねぇ、脇谷・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9B}「あの・・・、あのね、もし・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《美紀は、脇谷の目を見つめた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「もし、なんだ？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9B}「もし、知らないほうがいい真実があったとしたら・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《脇谷は、美紀の言葉をさえぎった。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「どんな真実だろうと、おれは知りてぇんだ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《美紀は、困惑して、言った。脇谷が首を振った。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「美紀・・・、どんなことだろうと、おれは覚悟はできてる。とにかく知りてぇ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《美紀は、哀願するように脇谷を見た。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「・・・言ったろう。覚悟はできてる。たとえ、どんなひどい真実でも、おれは知っておきてぇんだ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《美紀の口調には、拒否というよりは、恐れが、表れていた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「言えよ、美紀。理恵さんは誰にチョコを渡したんだ？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9B}「・・・やっぱり、言えない」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《美紀は首を振った。脇谷は、美紀の肩を掴んで、揺さぶった。怒鳴るように言った。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「教えろ！美紀！誰だったんだ！？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「誰だったんだ！？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《美紀は脇谷の目を見、うろたえたように視線をそらした。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《長い沈黙が訪れた。聞こえるのは、噴水に落ちる雨の音だけだった。脇谷は美紀の目をまっすぐ見つめ、視線をそらそうとしなかった。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《脇谷が目を見開いた。再び、長い沈黙が訪れた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《美紀は脇谷の表情を見た。疑念、戸惑い、怯え、驚愕、それらすべてが表れていた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《脇谷は、美紀の肩から手を離した。全身から力が抜けてしまったようだった。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《美紀の声は震えていた。脇谷に話してしまったことに、彼女はショックを受けていた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「・・・美紀、おまえ、どうしてそんな嘘をつく？・・・本当のことを言ってくれ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《脇谷は、絞り出すように、なんとかそれだけ言った。美紀は視線を落とし、力なく首を振った。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《脇谷は美紀の肩を掴んだ。美紀が顔を上げた。美紀の目は涙で濡れていた。脇谷の表情が、一気に揺らいだ。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《脇谷は、放心したように、よろよろと歩きだした。美紀は、その場に立ちつくしていた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9B}「待って、脇谷・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《脇谷は、歩き続けた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9B}「脇谷！・・・好きなの」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《脇谷は、立ち止まった。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9B}「好きよ。私、脇谷が好き・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《自分自身の言葉に驚いたように、美紀は両手で口を覆った。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《脇谷は、しばらく美紀に背中を向けたまま立っていた。やがて、また、歩きだした。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《脇谷の歩く速度が、ゆっくりと速まり、そのうちに走りだした。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《脇谷の姿が見えなくなると、美紀は、その場に泣き崩れた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《美紀の手には、脇谷に渡そうとしていたチョコレートが握られていた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: ９時きっかりに理恵が迎えに来た。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 今日は、２月２４日。文学部の合格発表日だ。３日続いた合格発表の最後の日だった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: ドアを開けた。理恵が、昨日、一昨日と変わらない笑顔で立っていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「おはよう、理恵」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「おはよう。今日は、すっごくいい天気だよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 空を見上げた。理恵の言うとおりだった。真っ青の空に、大きな雲が漂っていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 家を出て、理恵と専日大学へと歩きだした。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「どきどきするね・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵が、にっこりと笑って、言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: ピクニックにでも行くような様子の理恵を見て、彼女には不安のかけらもないな、と思った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 一昨日の経済学部、昨日の商学部と、２日連続で、無駄足になっていた。掲示板のどこにも、おれの受験番号はなかった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: ２日とも、２人で気まずい笑顔を見合わせて、帰ったのだ。”まだ明日がある”と言いあいながら。だが、今日はもうそのセリフを言うことはできない。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「今日で最後だね・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: お互い、ほとんどしゃべらないまま、専日大への道のりを過ごした。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 前の２日同様、小１時間で専日大に到着した。すでに発表を見にきた受験生がちらほらと見かけられた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 掲示板へ歩いていると、顔をほころばせて帰って行く女の子とすれ違った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 場合によっては、ここに来るのは、今日が最後になるな、と皮肉な気持ちで考えた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 掲示板の前では、受験生たちが、笑ったり、飛び上がったり、うつむいたり、うなだれたりしていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 掲示板の前に立って、合格者の発表を眺めた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 掲示板には、番号順に、合格者の受験番号が並んでいた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 祈るような気持ちで、自分の番号のあたりを追った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: ・・・おれの番号は、なかった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵は、おれが落ちたことがどうしても信じられない様子で、何度も掲示板を見直していた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵をその場に残したまま、呆然とベンチまで歩くと、半ば倒れ込むように座りこんだ。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 全身から、力という力が抜け落ちてしまったようだった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵が掲示板から戻ってきた。おれの前で立ち止まった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: おれは顔をあげることができなかった。彼女の顔を見ることができなかった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: なんとかそれだけ口にすると、深く息を吐き出した。自分の中から、すべての気力が消滅してしまった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 病人のような気分だった。混乱し、敗北感にさいなまれていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 自己憐憫という卑屈な精神状態に陥って、自分は今度こそ理恵を本当に失望させてしまったのだ、という事実をかみしめていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: おれをいたわるような思いやりに満ちた声だった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: こんな状態にあって、なお彼女はおれを気遣っている。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: そして、おれは、彼女に何もしてやることができない。彼女の小さな夢ですら叶えてやることができない。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 何も言うことができないまま、永遠とも思える時間が流れた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 突然、理恵が言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「あ・・・、{X92}くん、補欠合格のとこは見た？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 見ていない、と答えた。一昨日、昨日と、補欠合格に望みをかけては、落胆を繰り返しただけに終わった。いまさら見る気にはなれなかった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 動こうとしないおれを残して、理恵は、補欠合格者の掲示へ走っていった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 考えてみれば、当然のことなのだ。いくら努力したとはいえ、勉強に費やした時間は、たった１カ月半だ。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: それで合格してしまったら、１年、もしくはそれ以上勉強してきた人たちに申し訳ない。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 自分はなぜ合格できるなどと考えたのだろう、と不思議に思った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 気がつくと、理恵が戻ってきていた。顔をあげて彼女を見た。理恵の顔は生気に満ち、瞳が輝いていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「あったよ・・・。補欠のとこに」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 信じられなかった。補欠の掲示板まで走った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: ・・・あった。間違いない。自分の番号だ。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵を見た。おれの横で微笑んでいた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 彼女の顔に喜びがぱっと広がった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「おめでとう」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: まだ合格と決定したわけではない。首を振って、補欠合格の説明の掲示を読んだ。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 補欠合格者は、正規の合格者の辞退者があった時に合格扱いになる。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 正規合格者のうち入学辞退者が出たぶんだけ、補欠の上位から順番に合格に繰り上がる、ということだった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 合否は、正規合格者の入学手続きの締め切りの後、すみやかに決定され、３月３日までにその結果が郵便で通知される、そう書いてあった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: ３月３日まで、おれは合格者でも不合格者でもないわけだ。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: なんとか首の皮１枚つながったな、と思った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 合格発表の日以来、毎日が緩やかに過ぎていった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 学校がなく、特に旅行に行くといった予定もなかったので、受験勉強の間できなかったことを思いつくままにやってみた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 時計やカレンダーといったものの存在を忘れ、その時に思いついたことをやって過ごした。たとえば、寝たいだけ寝る、というようなことを。
