strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAD}「馬鹿か、おまえ？プレゼントなんてもらうものだろ？あげてどうする？しかも、働いてまで」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAD}「女にプレゼントなんかしてみろ。つけあがるだけだぜ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: にやにやと笑っていた。一瞬でも気を許したのは間違いだったと思った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAD}「おまえは、さんざんおごらされたあげくに、飽きて捨てられるってパターンだな。間違いねぇな。そう、この調子だと１００万くらい貢がされるな。ひひひ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAD}「たいしてかわいくもねぇんだろ、どうせ。別れろ別れろ。傷の浅いうちにな」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵を見て同じセリフを言ってみろ、と思った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAD}「いいか、女なんてものはな、貢がせて貢がせて、飽きるまでしゃぶりつくすんだよ。徹底的にな」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAD}「いざという時、金がなくなった時とか、ヤクザに追われてるとか、そういう時にかくまってもらったり、利用すんだよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAD}「後は、借金があるとか嘘言って、風俗で働かせるとかな。で、さんざん貢がせたら逃げる。そういうもんだろ？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAD}「いかにして金を出させるかが勝負なんだよ。それには、自分に夢中にさせなきゃだめだ。なのに自分が夢中になってどうすんだ？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 黙って、彼の言いたいように言わせておいた。楽しくはなかった。気を紛らわそうと、次々に酒を注文した。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAD}「ま、精進しろよな、学生。なんなら相談にのってやってもいいぜ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAD}「学生、いいこと教えてやるよ。覚えとけ。女は冷たくされるほど、夢中になっていくんだぜ。ひひひ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: やっと店を出ると、１０時をまわっていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 駅で神谷と別れ、家へと歩いたが、まっすぐ歩けなかった。明らかに飲み過ぎた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 公園で酔いをさまそうとベンチに座ったが、今度は吐き気が襲ってきた。気分の悪いまま何分間か過ごし、結局吐いた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 神谷と飲んだことを後悔した。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: １１時。やっと自分の部屋に帰ってくると、ベッドに倒れこんだ。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 吐き気が治まらないので、眠ることで乗り切ろうとしていると、電話のベルが鳴った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 無視していたが、ベルは鳴り続け、ついに根負けして受話器をとった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「{X92}ー！おまえ、どこをほっつき歩いてたんだー！」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 脇谷だった。その興奮した大きな声が頭と胃に響いた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「おれの頼んだことは、ちゃんとやってくれたんだろうな！？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「馬鹿野郎！プレゼントだよ、理恵さんの。調べてくれって言ったろうが！」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 吐き気が襲ってきた。なんとか早く電話を切りたいと思った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「わかったから・・・。頼む。静かに話してくれ・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「なんだ？気分でも悪いのか？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「そうか。で、理恵さんの欲しいものはわかったのか？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 不明瞭になっていく意識の中、脇谷のためになんとか考えをめぐらせた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「おい。聞いてんのか？{X92}？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「え？・・・ああ、プレゼントね。ちゃんと調べたよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「ああ。理恵・・・、理恵さんが欲しがっているのはテニス・シューズだよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: セルジオ・オタッキーニのことを教えた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「おお。でかしたぞ、{X92}！やっぱり持つべきものは友だなぁ。信じてたぜ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「ああ。怒鳴ったりして悪かったな。これで、理恵さんのハートをがっちりキャッチできるぜ。へへ。よし、{X92}、今度なんかうまいものでもごちそうするぜ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「ああ・・・。もういいか？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「おお・・・。じゃあ、また明日学校でな」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 電話を切り、ベッドに倒れこんだ。すぐに深い眠りに落ちた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 翌朝、重大なことに気がついた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 脇谷がシューズをプレゼントするのなら、おれは何をプレゼントしたらいいのだ？
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵の誕生日は２日後だ。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 自分の軽率さを呪ったが、遅すぎた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 放課後、ひとりで学校から帰った。今日のうちに理恵のプレゼントを決めなければならない。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 駅前を探し歩くしかないなと考えていると、後ろから理恵に声をかけられた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「これから帰るんでしょう？・・・一緒に帰らない？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 帰ろう、と言おうとして思い止まった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 明日、理恵の家に行くまでにプレゼントを用意しなければならない。そのことが頭をよぎり、誘いを断ることにした。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「今日はちょっと用事があるんだ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「ん・・・じゃあ、さよなら」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵の後ろ姿を眺めながら、なんとしてもいいプレゼントを用意しなければならないな、と考えた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: もし脇谷のプレゼントのほうがよかったら、おれの立場がない。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: １時間ほど駅前の商店街を歩いてまわった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: アクセサリー、時計、スポーツ用品、化粧品、さまざまな店に入ったが、自分が理恵の好みについて無知なことが悔やまれるだけだった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 空腹を感じ、ファストフードの店に入ろうとすると、聞き覚えのある声がした。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X98}「どうしたの、しょぼくれた顔しちゃって」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: のり子さんだった。こんなに早く再会できるとは思わなかった。この前とは違い、メイクしていたが、ごく控えめなものだった。趣味のいい香水の匂いがしていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X98}「悩みがあるんでしょう？ほら、お姉さんに言ってみなさい」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: そう言って微笑んだ。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「大したことでは・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 断ろうとした。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X98}「それにしては深刻そうな顔をしてたみたいだけど？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: ファストフード店の看板を見た。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 事情が飲みこめたというように、うなずいた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X98}「おなかがすいてるんでしょ？ほら、いらっしゃい。ごちそうしてあげる」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: ついてくるように手招きした。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 空腹ではあったが、それよりも、のり子さんと話すことで何かヒントが得られるのではないか、と考え、ついていくことにした。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: のり子さんになら、相談してみる価値があるのではないだろうか。女性の気持ちは女性に聞くのが一番確実だ。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 一緒に歩いて行くと、のり子さんは駅から少し歩いた場所にある居酒屋に案内してくれた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X98}「もぉ、かわいいー。そんなことで悩んでたのね」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 肩を揺らして笑った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: のり子さんからすれば、あまりにも子どもっぽい悩みだということはわかる。それでも、面と向かって笑われると傷ついた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X98}「あら、ごめんね。そんなつもりじゃなかったのよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: おれの表情を見てとり、笑いをこらえて言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X98}「違うのよ。{X92}くんがハンバーガー屋さんの前で思いつめた顔で立ってたから」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X98}「私、てっきり、手持ちのお金がないから食べようかどうか迷ってるんだと思ったのよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X98}「だから、おごってあげようって。そしたら、彼女のプレゼントのことで迷ってたっていうから」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X98}「自分の勘違いがおかしかったのよ。ほんとよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 本当かもしれないが、それだけが理由だとは思えなかった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: きまりが悪く、恥ずかしさを紛らわすために、一息にビールのジョッキを空にした。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X98}「もぉ・・・。怒ってるの？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: あやすように頭を撫でられた。ますます子ども扱いされた気がした。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X98}「・・・そうそう、プレゼントの話だったわね」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 困ったような笑顔で言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X98}「その子は{X92}くんのことをどう思ってるの？好きなの？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 少なくとも嫌われてはいないと思う、と言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X98}「そう。それなら話は簡単ね。なんでもいいのよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「なんでもいい？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X98}「もうちょっと歳をとると変わってくると思うけど、あなたくらいの年代なら、何をもらってもうれしいわよ。好きな人からなら」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: あまりにも前時代的な意見だ。からかわれているのではないか、と思った。本気なのか確かめようと、のり子さんの目を見た。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X98}「本当よ。{X92}くんの気持ちがこもっていれば、どんなものだってその子の宝物になるわよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「じゃあ、のり子さんもそうなんですか？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X98}「私？もちろん。心のこもったプレゼントならうれしいに決まってるわ。金額なんて関係ないわよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X98}「疑ってるみたいね。じゃ、こう考えてみて」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X98}「その女の子が{X92}くんにプレゼントをくれたの。もらったものは、{X92}くんの好きなものじゃなかった」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X98}「{X92}くんはその子のこと嫌いになる？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X98}「そのプレゼントはいらないから、誰かにあげてしまう？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X98}「でしょう？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: にっこり微笑んで、言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X98}「そういうこと。わかった？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: そう言うと、のり子さんはおれの肩を叩いた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X98}「じゃ、行きましょう」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 会計で自分のぶんを払おうとしたが、のり子さんは認めてくれなかった。入った時よりいくらか軽い気分で店を出た。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「すいません。ごちそうしてもらって」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X98}「いいのよ。遠慮しないで」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 知り合ったばかりなのに、親切にするのは当然と考えているようだった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: のり子さんが面倒見がいいのは、育ちのせいなのかもしれない。彼女の実家のことを思い出して、そう思った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X98}「お互い働く学生同士じゃない。がんばらなくちゃ。ね？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: まだおれのことを勤労少年だと誤解していた。もし何か困ったことがあったら電話しなさい、と言ってＰＨＳの番号を教えてくれた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X98}「じゃあね」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: また会いたい、と思った。美人だからというだけではない。のり子さんには、そう思わせる内面の魅力があった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 手を振ると、のり子さんは歩きだした。その場に立って、のり子さんの後ろ姿を見送った。すると、歩道の反対側にいる理恵と目があった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: １０メートルほど離れたところに理恵がひとりで立っていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: おれが見つけるより先に、おれに気がついていたようだった。手を振って、彼女のそばまで走った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「まだ帰ってなかったんだ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵は小さくうなずいた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「理恵、なにしてたの？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「え・・・？うん、・・・夕食の買い物してたの」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 料理好きとはいえ、毎日のように自炊するのはたいへんだな、と思った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: きみのプレゼントを買いに来た、とは言えなかった。言葉を濁した。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「ちょっと買い物に」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵は、突然、思い出したように笑顔になった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「すごくきれいな人だったね・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「のり子さんのこと？そうだね。モデルだから・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「モデル・・・。そうなんだ・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 気のせいか、理恵がおれの目を見ようとしないように思えた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「理恵、明日だけど、放課後に喫茶店で待ち合わせでいいかな？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 待ち合わせを決めていなかったことを思い出して、聞いた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「じゃあ、明日、喫茶店で」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵が元気がないように感じた。気分が悪いかどうか聞いてみたが、なんともないということだった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「さよなら」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「じゃあ、明日」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 少し歩いてから、理恵に正直に何が欲しいか聞いてみようという考えがよぎったが、その時には理恵の姿は見えなくなっていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: まだファッションデパートには行っていなかったので、閉店時間を気にしながら、プレゼントの物色に向かうことにした。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: ファッション・デパート”ファルコ”の女性向けのフロアでは、落ち着かない気分を味わっただけに終わった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: どんなプレゼントがいいのか店員のアドバイスに耳を傾けてみたが、どうしても理恵が喜ぶという確信が持てなかった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 結局、あきらめた。理恵を驚かしたりすることは断念し、直接理恵の意向を聞いてみることに決めた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: あまりいいやり方とはいえないが、選択を誤って理恵をがっかりさせるよりはましだ。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: それに、物でなければならないというきまりはない。例えば、評判のレストランで食事をするというのだって、プレゼントになりうるのではないか。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 翌日。学校に行くと、脇谷の姿が見えなかった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵を喜ばせる策を考えながら、上の空で授業時間を過ごした。放課後になっても脇谷は学校に現れなかった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 田村に脇谷のことを聞いてみた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA4}「いや、知らない。電話でもしてみたら？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 中野にも聞いた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA5}「いんや、聞いてねぇよ。さぼったんでないの？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: もしかして、脇谷は学校の外でプレゼントを渡そうとしているのではないだろうか。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵が下校する途中、偶然を装って現れる。脇谷がそんなことを計画していたとしても不思議はない。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵と待ち合わせしている場所で脇谷に会ってしまったら、どう言い訳すればいいのだろう。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 不安な気持ちで廊下を歩いていると、佐倉真由美に呼び止められた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「どこに行くの？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 警官が尋問するような口調で言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「どこか。きみには関係ない」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 彼女に対して後ろめたいことはなにもないのに、こうしていると緊張するのはなぜなのだろう、と考えた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: もし検察官や判事になれば、彼女は目を見張る活躍をみせるのではないだろうか。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「あなた、理恵になにをしたの？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「なにって？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 質問の意図がわからなかった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「とぼけないでほしいわね。今日の朝、すぐに気がついたわ。理恵がおかしかったのよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「話しかけても、聞いているのかどうかもあやしいし、それに全然笑わなかったわ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「なにか理恵によくないことが起こった、そう考えたわ。あなたが理恵にいかがわしいことをしたに違いないって」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「覚悟しなさい。私はただではすまさないわよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「言いがかりだ。いかがわしいことなんて・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「してないって言うのね？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「もちろん。それに今日は・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 言いかけてやめた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「今日はなんなの？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 黙っていると、佐倉が言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「理恵と約束があるの？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 答えなかったが、そうだと言っているようなものだった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「理恵は来るかしら？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: にやりと笑った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「これでいいんだわ。理恵もやっとわかったのよ。あなたがどのていどの人間か」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 腹がたったが、それを知られれば彼女を喜ばせることになるのではないか。そう考え、微笑してみせた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「あなたって、本当おめでたい人ね」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: あきれたように言うと、佐倉は去っていった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 約束の時間から、すでに２時間が過ぎていた。コーヒー１杯でもたせるには長すぎる時間だ。理恵が忘れているのかと思い、家に電話してみたが、留守電だった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵は来るかしら、という佐倉の言葉を思い出した。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 佐倉は、おれの知らない何か重大なことを知っているのではないか。理恵がここに来られない事情のようなことを。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: そう考えて、思い直した。もし来れなくなったのなら、理恵がおれにそう言わないはずがない。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: それなら事故にあったのかもしれない。理恵が交通事故にあったところを想像し、不安な気持ちになった。コーヒーをもう１杯注文した。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 落ち着かない気分で、喫茶店の外を眺めた。理恵の姿は見えなかった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XBC}「あ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 聞いたことのある声だった。誰だったろうと思いながら、顔を向けた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 脇谷とナンパをした日、話しかけてきた女の子だった。名前を思い出そうとした。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「ええと、きみは・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X99}「大沢ひな子」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「そうそう、ひな子ちゃん。いや、そうじゃなくて・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X99}「座っていいですか？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: おれの返事を待たずに、正面に座った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X99}「もう座っちゃった。えへへ・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: いたずらっぽく笑った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X99}「ケーキ頼んでいいですか？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: メニューを広げると、ケーキのリストを熱心に見始めた。まるで子どもだ。いや、子どもそのものだ、と思った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: ケーキを注文すると、おれの顔を眺めて、楽しそうにしゃべり始めた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: くったくなく話しているひな子ちゃんは、いかにも愛らしく、無邪気だった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: この前の彼女のとっぴな行動は夢だったのではないか、と思えてきた。しばらく、お互いの学校生活について話した。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X99}「ふうん。{X92}さんは３年生なんですかぁ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: いつのまにか、彼女のペースにのせられて友だちのように会話していることに気がついた。なにかおかしい。考えてみれば、これは不自然すぎる状態だ。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「ひな子ちゃん・・・、おれのこと名前くらいしか知らないはずだよね？それなのに、どうして話しかけたりしたの？知らない人と一緒にいたりして、怖くないの？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X99}「怖くないです」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X99}「だって、ひな子、{X92}さんのことが好きだから・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: あっけにとられていると、ひな子ちゃんがおれの袖を掴んだ。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X99}「ね、{X92}さん、どこかつれていってください。ひな子、遊園地がいいな」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「・・・とにかく、だめだよ。ここで人と待ち合わせしているんだ。それに、ひな子ちゃんには彼氏がいるじゃないか」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 人のよさそうな大学生のことを思い出して、言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X99}「彼氏！？やめてください！」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: ひな子ちゃんが目を見開いた。明るい表情が途端に曇った。考えるのもおぞましそうだった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X99}「あの人は・・・。あの人の親と私の両親が親しくて、あの人が家に遊びにくるようになったんです」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X99}「家族どうしのつきあいで。・・・最初はなんともなかったんです」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X99}「ふつうの人だと思ってたんです。でも、私のことを見る目がおかしいって気がついて」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X99}「それに、あの人が来ると、いつも私の下着がなくなるんです。最初は気のせいだって思ったんですけど」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X99}「でも、遊びに来た日、もしかしてって思って下着を入れてる引き出しにセロテープを貼っておいたんです」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X99}「あの人が帰って、調べてみたらテープがはがれていて・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 唇を震わせた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X99}「あの人、ちょっとおかしいんです。私の帰り道で待ち伏せしたり、毎日電話をかけてきたり、後をつけられたこともあるんです・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X99}「あの、どういうことかわかりますよね？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X99}「本当、異常なんです・・・。私、怖くなって。警察に行こうかとも思ったんですけど。親が我慢しなさいって・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 苦痛に満ちた声だった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X99}「あの人の家、財界とつながっているらしくて、もし怒らせたら、私の父の会社なんて簡単につぶされてしまうらしいんです。でも・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 消え入りそうな声になって言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X99}「学校から１人で帰るのも怖いんです・・・。私、どうしたらいいのか・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 小さな手で顔を覆った。話していることが真実なら、ほっておくわけにはいかない。詳しく話を聞こうとした。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 今はあまり話したくない、と彼女が言い、後日電話で話すということに決まった。ＰＨＳの番号を教えてくれた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 入り口から理恵がこちらへ歩いてきた。店まで走ってきたのだろう。頬が上気していた。息をきらせながら言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「遅くなってごめんね。部活でケガ人がでちゃって、病院までつきそって行ってたの。・・・あれ？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: おれがひとりでないことに気がついた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「あの・・・？ああ、いつか{X92}くんと一緒にいた？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵が説明を求めて、おれを見た。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: ため息をつくと、あきれたように言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X99}「ほんと、あなたって見境ないのね・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: その声は、さっきまでの彼女とはまるで別人だった。子どもっぽさは微塵もなかった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 表情から無邪気さが消えうせ、大人びたけだるさが現れていた。この前とまったく同じだ。突如、人格がいれかわる。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X99}「片方と約束したのを忘れてた。そんな感じね・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 指で髪の先端をもてあそびながら、言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X99}「別に他の女に手を出すなとは言わないけど。せめてこういうことがないように配慮してほしいわね。私、なんか、しらけちゃった」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X99}「私、こういう修羅場って苦手。自分でなんとかしてね」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: どうしてかはわからないが、ひな子ちゃんは自分がデート中だったのだと理恵に思いこませたいらしかった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵を見た。表情がこわばっていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「違うんだ、理恵、この子の言ってることは・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: なんとか説明しようとした。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「あの、別に、私、用があったわけじゃないから・・・。じゃあ、ごゆっくり・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 平静な声だったが、かすかに震えていた。微笑むと背を向けて歩きだした。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「理恵・・・、ちょっと待って・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 慌てて席を立った。理恵が店から出ていった。追いかけようとしたが、レジで店員に呼び止められ、伝票の清算を命じられ、そのために理恵をつかまえ損ねてしまった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 全力で走り、すぐに歩いている理恵に追いついた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「理恵、待って」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 呼びかけたが、理恵は振り返ろうとしなかった。歩く速度が少し速くなった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 無言のまま、しばらく歩き続けた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵は立ち止まると、くるりとこちらへ振り向いた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「どうしてついてくるの？あの女の子と一緒にいればよかったのに」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 困ったように微笑んでいた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「だって、約束したじゃないか。理恵の誕生日を一緒に過ごそうって。別に、あの子は・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「・・・それともモデルの人？あの人、きれいだったものね」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「のり子さん？どうして？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「そのほうが、私といるより楽しいでしょう？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「そんなわけないだろう」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵の声が震えた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「この前も用事があるなんて言って、あのモデルの人と会ってたんでしょう！？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「・・・私のことはほっておいて」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「とにかく誤解なんだ。話を聞いてくれ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: ふたたび理恵は歩きだした。後について歩いた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵が走りだした。しかたなく、おれも走った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 突然、理恵が立ち止まった。振り返っておれを見た。その瞳は潤んでいるように見えた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「ついてこないで！」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 強い口調で言うと、また走りだした。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: おれがずっと追ってくるので、理恵は走る速度をさらに速めた。顔を下に向けて走っていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵が角を曲がろうとした。よく前を見ていなかったために、角の向こう側を歩いていた男に強い勢いでぶつかった。理恵はその場に転んだ。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XB7}「どこ見て歩いてんだ、こらぁ！」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 男が理恵に怒鳴った。理恵を庇おうとして、おれはその男の前に出た。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「す、すみません！」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAD}「ああ！？・・・お？おまえ、学生じゃねぇか？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵がぶつかったのは、神谷だった。バイトの帰りのようだった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAD}「なにやってんだよ、学生・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: おれと理恵を見て、飲みこめたというように笑った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAD}「ははぁ。デート中か・・・。彼女、けっこうかわいいじゃんかよ～」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: おれの髪を手でかきまわした。ぽかんとして座っている理恵に向かって言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAD}「あ、彼女、おれ神谷っていって、こいつのバイトの同僚」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 神谷は理恵に手をかして立たせた。視線をおれに向けて、にやにや笑った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAD}「それで、プレゼントはもう渡したのか？なに買ったんだ？テニスシューズとか言ってたよな。いくらした？ほら、教えろよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 神谷はげらげら笑いながら、理恵に話しかけた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAD}「こいつ、きみにプレゼント買うためにバイトしてたんだよ。おれの職場で」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 驚いていた。こういうことは秘密にしておきたかったが、もう遅かった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAD}「あ、学生、さすがに彼女には秘密にしてたのか。はははっ。悪ぃ。ばらしちまったみたいだな。ひひひ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 神谷の意地の悪い笑みを見て、わざとばらしたな、と思った。おれを笑いものにするのがレクリエーションなのだ。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAD}「ひひひ。こいつ、きみに何プレゼントした？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 興味本位に理恵に聞いた。理恵は答えられなかった。もらっていないのだから、当然だ。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAD}「なんだ。おれには内緒かよ。ひひひ。教えろよ、学生～」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 神谷の質問に答えあぐねていると、理恵がひとりでゆっくり歩きだした。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「すいません、神谷さん。また今度・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵を追った。神谷は不思議そうにおれを見ていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAD}「おい、学生・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 黙って歩きつづけ、理恵のマンションまでやってきてしまった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵は、うつむいたまま家の鍵を開けた。入っていいと言ってくれるのではないかと思ったが、彼女はなにも言わなかった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: おれを残したまま、理恵が中に入った。かすかな音をたてて、ドアが自然に閉まった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: なんということだ、と思った。これでは、この日のためにしてきたことが、すべてむだになってしまう。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: それだけではない。このまま気まずくなって、理恵と別れることになってしまうかもしれない。そんなことになったら・・・。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 絶望的な気分になり、ドアのむこう側に理恵が立っていることを信じて、話しかけた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「とにかく、ごめん。プレゼント何がいいか結局わからなくて・・・。せっかくの理恵の誕生日だったのに」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「喫茶店で会ってから、理恵に選んでもらおうと思ってたんだけど、あんなことになっちゃって・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 信じてもらえないだろうな、と思いながら、ひな子ちゃんのことを説明した。理恵は黙っていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: ドアのむこうに理恵が立っているかどうか確信が持てなくなった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「理恵になにかしてあげたくて、バイトしたりして、・・・それなのに、何がいいかわからなくて」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「今日、喫茶店で待ち合わせした後に、理恵に決めてもらおうと思ってたんだ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「ほら、中学の時、理恵の誕生日にプレゼントできなかっただろ？今度こそは、あの時のぶんまでって思ってたんだ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「それがこんなことになって。ほんとにごめん・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 返事がなかった。しかたなく帰ろうとすると、ドアがゆっくり開いた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: やはり、理恵はドアのすぐ後ろにいた。おれの話は聞いてもらえていたようだった。黙って、彼女が何か言うのを待った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「謝るのは、私のほう・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵が下を向いて言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「{X92}くんがバイトしてたなんて知らなくて。用があるってバイトのことだったなんて・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「なのに、私、さっき{X92}くんにひどいこと言っちゃった・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「恥ずかしい・・・。私、ほんとに馬鹿でおっちょこちょいで・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「ごめんなさい」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「そんなこと、気にしなくていいよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵が誤解したのも無理はなかった。こうなったのは彼女の責任ではない、と思った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「本当？許してくれる？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「もちろん」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 笑ってうなずいた。和解できそうなので、ほっとした。これで、なんとか理恵の誕生日を祝うことができるだろう。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「ありがとう。・・・ね、入って」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 彼女の表情が和らいだ。ドアを開けてくれ、やっと家に入れてもらうことができた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: ２人でリビングに歩いていく途中で、理恵が立ち止まった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「やだ。どうしよう・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 途方にくれた表情で、おれを見た。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「私も{X92}くんとごはん食べようって思って、それで待ち合わせしてから一緒にスーパーでお買い物しようと思ってて・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「だから、お料理の材料用意してないの・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: しょんぼりして言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「そう。じゃあ、おれ、なにか買ってくるよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: そう言って、玄関へ行こうとすると、リビングで理恵がなにかを見つけた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: リビングへ行ってみた。テーブルの上にボトルと箱がのっていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「お母さんだわ・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: ケーキとシャンパンを指さして言った。うれしそうに笑った。シャンパンの下に、一緒にいられないことを謝る置き手紙があった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: ケーキはオーダーメイドのようだった。直径３０センチほどはある大きなもので、チョコレートのプレートに理恵の名前が彫ってある。理恵が微笑んで言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「でも、２人で食べきれないね・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: リビングから理恵の部屋に移動した。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: ２人でテーブルをセットし、ケーキのろうそくに火をともした。部屋の照明を暗くした。グラスにシャンパンを注いだ。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「誕生日おめでとう」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: グラスをあわせると、心地よい音がした。ろうそくの火が彼女の顔を照らしているのを見た。いつもの理恵にもどったな、と感じた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「そうだ。理恵、プレゼント、何がいい？今日はもう遅いから、明日渡すよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「そんな・・・。いいよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「よくないよ。せっかくバイトしたんだし」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「ううん。・・・やっぱりなんでもいい」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「頼むよ、理恵。今日、プレゼントできないだけで、落ち着かない気分なんだ。まずかったと思う。せめて、明日には理恵を喜ばせたいんだ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「いいの。こうして一緒にいてくれるだけで」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「私、言ったよね。誕生日の時、一緒にごはんが食べたいって。それが叶ったから、もういいの・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 彼女になんと言ったらいいか、わからなかった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: それからしばらく、幸せな気分で何杯かシャンパンを飲んだ。理恵の笑顔を見て、自分が求めているものはこれだったのだ、と感じた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: ケーキの味に飽きてきた頃、理恵が場所をかえて、おれの隣に座った。彼女の頬が赤くなっていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 満足げに微笑んで、おれの肩に頭をのせた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「ふふふふふっ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 楽しそうに笑った。酔っぱらっているな、と思った。彼女が酒によわいと言っていたことを思い出した。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: すでに、２人でシャンパンのボトルをほとんど空けてしまっていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「あはははは」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 笑いだした。なにがおかしいのだろう、と思った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 笑いがおさまると、またおれにもたれかかった。体を擦り寄せてきた。アルコールで体がほてっていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: よくなついた猫がするような感じで、おれに体をすり付けた。くすぐったかった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「理恵、それは、なにをしているの？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「私の匂いをつけてるの・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: そう言って、くすくすと笑った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「なんのために？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「うふふふふ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 顔をあげて、おれを見た。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「{X92}くんは、私のなわばりなの。だから匂いをつけるの」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 翌日になっても理恵はこのことを覚えているのだろうか、と思った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「なわばり、なわばり～」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵は、さっきまでより強い力で体をすり付けた。勢いあまって、おれの前に倒れこんだ。あわてて理恵を抱きとめた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵を抱えた手が乳房に触れていた。薄いブラウスを通して、彼女の鼓動が感じられたような気がした。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 彼女の呼吸する音が聞こえた。彼女の瞳を見つめた。髪を撫で、自分にとって最も大事な女性を抱きしめた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: ・・・時々、生きていることに漠然とした不安に襲われる。遠くの国には、飢えて死を待つだけの人々がいる。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 突然の事故。気の滅入るような犯罪。孤独な老人たち。悪夢のような紛争。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: そして、死について考える。自分自身が無力で無価値な存在であることを知って、絶望的な気分になる。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: ・・・だが、自分には、理恵がいる。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: それさえあれば、ほかのことは問題ではない。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵を抱きしめながら、そう思った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: そっと理恵にキスをした。彼女の柔らかい唇を吸った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 彼女の頬、首筋、耳にキスをした。いくらキスしてもしたりなかった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵がおれの背中に腕をまわし、力強く抱いた。それに応えるように、彼女を抱く力を強めた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 服の上から彼女の乳房に触れた。理恵が小さく体を震わせた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 自分の心臓が狂ったように高鳴っていた・・・。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵が体をのけぞらせた。おれのペニスの先端部分が、理恵の性器に入っていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵の瞳が涙で光っていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: ペニスを抜いた。理恵をリラックスさせようと、体を愛撫した。ペニスは萎える気配がなく、ますます固さを増していくようだった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: もう一度挿入しようかどうか迷った・・・。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「だ、だいじょうぶ・・・。我慢できるから・・・、たぶん・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: おれの気持ちを読み取って、言った。申し訳ないような気がした。おれのために、自分の苦痛を我慢しようというのだ。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵の瞳から溢れた涙を、指で拭った。できることなら、彼女が感じている痛みを、かわって感じてやりたいと思った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵は、そうすれば痛みが軽減されるとでもいうように、おれの肩にしがみついた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: おれは、彼女が少しでも痛みを感じないように動こうとしたが、うまくやれたかどうかわからなかった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 翌朝、学校に行くと、脇谷が来ていた。ひどい鼻声だった。昨日のことを聞いてみた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「それがよぉ。おれ、ここんとこ風邪ぎみだったんだけどな、プレゼントの資金稼ぎがあるし、休まず働いたんだよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: ティッシュで鼻をかんだ。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「たぶんそれが悪かったんだな。だんだんひどくなって、昨日の朝、目が覚めたらすげぇ熱でよ。身動きがとれねぇ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「それでも学校行こうとしたんだけどな、親にとめられちまったんだ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「結局、医者のとこに連れてかれて、注射うたれて、そのまま寝かされちまった。それで、万事休すだ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: また鼻をかんだ。医者のことでさかんに悪態をついていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 注射に睡眠薬の成分が混じっていたに違いない、と決めつけていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「あの医者の野郎、人の運命を弄びやがって・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「そうだったのか」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「ああ。まったく、この脇谷徹、一生の不覚だぜ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「それでどうするんだ、プレゼントは？今日渡すのか？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「いや、やめとくぜ。いまさら渡すのもかっこ悪ぃからな。シューズは返品することにするぜ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 脇谷は肩を落として、ため息をついた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「理恵さんのハートを射止めるはずだったのによぉ。・・・ついてねぇよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 突然、なにかを思い出したように、脇谷は顔をあげた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「待てよ・・・、まだ５月じゃねぇか。まだチャンスはいくらでもある。こんなことでくじけてる場合じゃねぇ。そう思わねぇか？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 同意を求めて、おれを見た。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「ああ。そうだな・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「そうだろ？野球はツー・アウトからっていうからな、まだこれからよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「みててくれ。こんなことでくじける男じゃねぇぜ。この脇谷徹はな」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: そう言って笑った。立ち直るのがはやいな、と思った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 脇谷が理恵をあきらめるには、まだまだ時間がかかりそうだった。それが、おれと理恵の関係に気がつくより前であることを祈った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: もし、そうでなければ・・・。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 期末テストの日々が穏やかにやってきて、同じように穏やかに過ぎていった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: テストは、脇谷には２科目、おれには１科目の赤点という結果を残した。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: というわけで、夏休みを間近に控えた放課後。おれと脇谷は補習について、悪態をついていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「赤点を喰らうのは、構わねぇ。こんなことで、貴重な青春の日々が失われちまうってことが我慢ならねぇ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 帰ってきた解答用紙を丸めながら、言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「なぁ、{X92}、夏休みの予定はどうなってる？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 何もない、と答えた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「おい、おまえ、それでいいのか？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「”なにが？”じゃねぇだろう。おい、しっかりしろ。この夏休みは特別なんだぜ？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
