strings.jp: どう特別なんだ、と聞いてみた。脇谷はあきれたようにおれを見た。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「一生にたった一度しかねぇ高３の夏休みだろうが！」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「おれたちは、二度と帰らない１８の夏を空しく過ごすわけにはいかねぇんだ。わかるか？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「なるほど。それで、何をするんだ？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「む。そこなんだがな、{X92}、おまえ、なにかこう素晴らしいアイディアねぇか？その、理恵さんを誘ってどこかにいくとかよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 自分と理恵のことは、まだ話す決心がつかないでいた。ずっと秘密にしておいて、その間に脇谷が諦めてくれるのではないか、という希望にすがっていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: ふだんはそのことについて考えまいと努め、脇谷が理恵のことを話すたびに、現実に引き戻された。脇谷が事実を知った時のことを考えると、恐ろしかった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: しばらく２人で夏休みの計画について考えていると、女の子が廊下で大きな声で話しているのが聞こえてきた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XBC}「休み入ったら、海行くって言ってたじゃん。あれっていつになったの？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XBC}「え？来週ー。大正第一のコーくんも来るんだって」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 脇谷は口を開けたまま、女の子たちの声に耳を傾けていた。真剣な表情になって言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「なに？女の子の話？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「あたりまえだろう！海だよ海。まったく、何で今まで気がつかなかったんだろうな。これこそ、１８の夏にふさわしいイベントだぜ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: うれしそうに海について話し始めた。海は男女の仲を劇的に親密にする魔力がある。一緒に海に行くということは、つきあうための準備が完了したも同然だ、などなど。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: ３分もしないうちに、海に行くという約束をさせられてしまった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「まぁ、まかせとけって、いい穴場を知ってるんだ。へへへ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 自信ありげに笑っていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「よし、そこでだ。おまえは理恵さんを誘え。まだ２人きりで行くって段階でもねぇしよ。またつきそってくれ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 勢いに流されて、ＯＫしてしまった。すぐに後悔した。脇谷は海に行った時のことをあれこれ妄想して、有頂天になっていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「・・・ま、気がつくと理恵さんとおれが２人きりになってる、っていうのがベストだな」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「いつも、そんな感じなら、そのうち、ふと目があって、自然に手が触れあって・・・。くくく」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「あ、それからな、理恵さんにも誰か友だちを誘ってきてもらえ。でも、佐倉はごめんだぜ。あの女は苦手だ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 同感だ、と思って、うなずいた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「修学旅行の時は、ほんとうにひどいめにあったからよ・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「・・・ほんとうに素晴らしい眺めらしいですよ。ですから、いっしょにどうですか？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「明日の予定はもう決まっているのよ。まずクルーザーに乗るわ。それから、陶器のミュージアムにいって、その後がギヤマンミュージアム、ハンドベルもやってみたいわね」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「グランドオペラは行かないんですか？クルーザーなら帆船のほうがいいでしょう？この脇谷に任せてくだされば、１分も無駄にせずに、最高の１日をエンジョイできますよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「おもしろそう。いいよね、真由美？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「だめよ。せっかくの修学旅行だもの。ふだん味わえない女子校気分を満喫したいわ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「へへ。まぁ、そう言わずに。この脇谷徹は役にたちますよ。写真撮影や買い物の荷物持ち。おまえもそうだよな、{X92}」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「まにあってるわ。それに・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 佐倉がちらりと脇谷を見た。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「ここは美しいところだわ。その風景をじっくり楽しみたいの。その時に風景を台無しにするような醜いものは見たくないでしょう？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「醜いものって？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「あなたたちよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「けっきょく理恵さんと一緒に行動することはできなかったしよ、さんざんだったぜ。もうあんなことはこりごりだ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「ま、そんなことはいい。それより海だ。楽しみだなぁ、おい・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 夢見るような表情になった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「もしかしたら、おまえも、理恵さんと一緒に来た女と愛が芽生えるかも知れねぇぞ。へへへ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 翌日の放課後。喫茶店で理恵と待ち合わせた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 夏休みの予定について聞くと、特に決まっていない、と言っていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「どうして？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: ティーカップの中をかき回しながら、言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵に海に行く計画について話した。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「どう？行かない？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「え？うん。もちろん行くよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 休みに入ったらすぐに、と教えた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「楽しみだね。・・・そうだ。水着買わなきゃ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: どんな水着を買うのか、と聞くと、困ったように笑った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「秘密。ふふっ。海に行く時まで教えないよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「だって、恥ずかしいもん」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 結局、海で見ることになるのだから、同じことなのではないか、と聞いてみた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「でも、だめ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 彼女は、下を向いて、カップに口をつけた。まったく教える気はなさそうだった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「海って、どのへん？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「知らない。脇谷が言うには穴場らしいんだ。電車で２時間くらいだって」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「ふうん。・・・ほかには誰が来るの？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「まだちゃんと決まってないんだ。とりあえず、おれと脇谷だけは決まってる」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「それで、理恵にも誰か誘ってほしいんだけど・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 佐倉ではない子を連れてきてほしい、というのをどう言ったらいいか、考えた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 佐倉は理恵の親友である以上、何の理由もなく誘うなと言えば、理恵は理由を知りたがるだろうし、知ればいい気はしないはずだ。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 考えをまとめられないでいると、理恵の後ろから声がした。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「つまり、私ね」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 驚いて声のほうを向いた。声の主が振り向いた。佐倉真由美だった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「あ、真由美」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 佐倉は自分がいた席から立ち上がると、勝ち誇るような顔をして理恵の横に座った。いったい何時からいたのだろう、と考えた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「ここの前を通りかかったら、理恵が{X90}と一緒にいるのが見えたのよ。理恵の身に何かよくないことが起きるような気がしたのよ。間にあって、よかったわ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 冷たく鋭い目でおれを見た。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「いかがわしいことをしようとしても無駄よ。あなたの計画はたった今挫折したわ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵のほうに向き直って、言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「そうね、ともみも誘いましょう。貴久美にも声をかけようかしら。こんなのと一緒っていうのが残念だけど、女の子だけで楽しみましょう」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 脇谷がこうなったことを知ったら、落胆するに違いないな、と考えながら、佐倉が計画を自分のものにしていくのを聞いていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵は、単純に、大勢で遊びに行くというアイディアを喜んでいた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「じゃあ、私、ともみに電話するね」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 楽しそうに笑う理恵を見ながら、ため息をついた。これで、海に行っても理恵と２人きりになるのは無理になったな、と残念に思った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 翌日の朝。脇谷に、昨日喫茶店であったことを報告した。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「なんだとう！？佐倉が来るのか！？おまえ、なんとかならなかったのか？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「ごめん」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「ま、過ぎたことはしかたねぇな・・・。で、どうすんだ？女の子は３人になっちまったんなら、こっちももう１人くらい必要だろう？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「中野と田村は？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「それが、だめなんだ。田村と中野は、日本横断ヒッチハイクに挑戦するとかでよ。帰ってくんのは、８月に入ってからだって言ってたよ。困ったぜ・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「おまえ、なんか心当たりねぇのか？適当な奴。・・・もちろん、おれと理恵さんの間を邪魔しねぇ奴ってのが条件だけどよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「誰かあたってみるよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: そのことについて考えながら、教室を出て、廊下を歩いていると、千葉という男が、おれの肘をつかんで引き寄せた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 同じクラスの生徒だった。おとなしく、存在感の薄い、少し変わった男で、彼が教室の片隅でひとり笑いを浮かべているのを何回か見たことがある。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 彼は、緊張のためだろうか、小刻みに震えていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA6}「あの、ぼく、さっき、{X92}くんと脇谷くんが話してるの聞いてて、それで・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 黙って、彼を見た。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA6}「その、海に行くのに、メンバーが足りないみたいだったから・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 何かに怯えるように、びくびくしていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 彼はしばらく黙っていた。突然、叫ぶように言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA6}「お願いだ！ぼくも連れていってくれ！」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 戸惑った。友だちでもない人間が参加すること自体、奇妙なことに思えたし、しかも、千葉である。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 青白くやせ細った体は、海のイメージからはあまりにもかけ離れている。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 千葉は、うつむいて、黙りこんだ。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 彼が海に行きたがる理由がわからなかった。１人でいることの多い彼が、自分たちの仲間に入ろうとするのが、いかにも不自然なことに思えた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: それに、これまで彼と言葉を交わした記憶がなかった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 彼が何も言わないので、行こうとすると、腕をつかまれた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA6}「絶対に誰にも言わないでくれよ？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 目が血走っていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA6}「実は、ぼく、佐倉さんのことが、・・・す、す、す、す」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA6}「ああ・・・。ついに言ってしまった。ぼくの最大の秘密を」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA6}「・・・絶対、誰にも言わないでくれよ？約束だよ？指切りしてくれ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 彼が小指を突き出した。しばらくそのままの姿勢でいたが、おれが応じようとしないので、あきらめて手をひっこめた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA6}「お願いだ。お願いです。連れていってください。もし、連れていってくれなかったら、ぼく、自殺します」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: がたがたと震えながら、おれの手を強い力で握った。今にも泣きだしそうだった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: おれは、戸惑いながら、脇谷と相談してみる、と告げた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 翌週の月曜日。脇谷と街中をうろついていた。天候がよく、このぶんなら、明日は絶好の海水浴日和になるだろう、と思った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「なんだか妙な展開になりやがったなぁ・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 千葉のことを話すと、脇谷は顔をしかめていた。少しの間、考えて、言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「よし。まぁ、いいだろう。奴なら、きっと、隅っこでおとなしくしてるだろう。たぶん害はねぇ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「しかしよ、物好きな奴もいたもんだぜ。よりによって佐倉が好きだとはなぁ・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: おれは、うなずいた。佐倉と千葉。どう考えても、うまくいくとは思えない。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「千葉が佐倉の相手をしてくれるんなら、おれと理恵さんが２人きりになるチャンスもありそうだ。そう考えれば、奴だって役にたたねぇわけでもねぇしな」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「それよりな、{X92}、何か足りねぇと思わねぇか？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 青果店の前で立ち止まって、言った。おれが理解できないでいると、さらに言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「つまりよ、ガキじゃねぇんだから、ただ泳ぐだけじゃ芸がねぇだろう？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 彼の言っている意味がわからなかった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 脇谷は青果店にならんだスイカを指差した。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「スイカがどうかしたか？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「馬鹿野郎、海といったらスイカ割りだろうが。これ以上に盛り上がるイベントがあるか？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: そうだろうか、と思ったが、口には出さなかった。脇谷は、上機嫌でスイカを手にとると、品質を確かめていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「理恵さんが食べることになるんだ。最高のものを選ばねぇとな・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: スイカ選びを彼に任せ、通りをぼんやりと眺めた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 通りの反対側を腕を組んで歩いている大学生くらいのカップルが目にとまった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 人ごみの中で彼らだけが目にとまったのは、男女とも外見に非の打ち所のないカップルだったからで、実際、何人かは振り返って見ていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 男のほうをどこかで見たことがある気がした。思い出せなかった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 気になって、脇谷に声をかけた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「脇谷、あの男、知らないか？どこかで見た気がするんだ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「ああ？男なんて、ほっとけ。今、それどころじゃねぇんだ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 脇谷は、ちらっとカップルのほうを見たが、すぐにスイカに興味を奪われてしまった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: その男のことが何故か気にかかり、記憶を呼び起こそうとしてみたが、結局、思い出すことはできなかった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 空が晴れ上がった新鮮で快い７月の美しい朝だった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 集合場所である駅のホームに行くと、脇谷と千葉、理恵と佐倉がすでに来ていて、ベンチに座っていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 脇谷が困ったような表情で、おれに耳打ちした。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「おい、{X92}、千葉だがよ、あいつ、わけわかんねぇんだよ。話しかけてくるんだけどな、何言ってるか全然わかんねぇ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「しかも、よくしゃべりやがるんだ。ずっとあの調子じゃ、困るぜ。とても相手しきれねぇ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「ほっておいたら、どうだ？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「それでも、だめなんだ。お構いなしなんだよ、あの野郎は」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA6}「どうしたの、{X92}くんたち。内緒で何の話～？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: ふだんの教室で見る千葉とは別人のようだった。明るいのだが、無理をした不自然な明るさで、彼にはまるで似合っていなかった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 脇谷がいまいましそうな顔で、千葉を見た。陽気なゾンビィを持て余し、どうしていいかわからない、という感じだった。人懐っこいゾンビィ。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「な、わかったろ？この調子なんだよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 脇谷がおれに言った。千葉は、自分がうっとうしがられていることに、まったく気がつかないようだった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 千葉を相手に脇谷と奮闘していると、女の子がやって来た。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9C}「あ、あの、遅刻しちゃいました？・・・ご、ごめんなさい」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 内気な感じの女の子だった。柿沼ともみ、と自己紹介した。理恵と同じクラスだということだった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9C}「ほんと、ごめんなさい。私、目覚ましかけるの忘れてて・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「いいわよ、ともみ。たった２０分くらいの遅刻を気にすることないわ。こんな連中は待たせておくくらいがちょうどいいのよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 脇谷は、佐倉の言うことを気にするようすもなかった。理恵と一緒に遊びに行けるというだけで十分なのだろう。満面の笑みを浮かべ、女の子たちに言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「よし、それじゃ、さっそく行きましょうか」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「言われなくても、行くわ。いちいちつまらないことを口に出さないで」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 女の子たちがベンチから立ち上がり、ホームに入ってきた電車に乗りこんだ。電車が動きだすと、千葉が、楽しくてしようがない感じで、叫んだ。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA6}「しゅっぱぁーつ！」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 一瞬、みんなが凍りついたように、千葉を見た。佐倉の頬がひきつっていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 脇谷と顔を見合わせた。やはり、千葉を参加させたのは間違いだった、と彼の顔が告げていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 電車を２回乗り換え、あとは目的地の駅で下車するだけだった。４０分もすれば着く、と脇谷が言っていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA6}「それで、ネハンゲリオンのラストには多説あってね・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 電車が動き出してから、千葉は、まるで無限にエネルギーを持っているかのように、しゃべり続けていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 問題は、彼の話す話題を誰も知らず、興味もない、ということだった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 他のみんなは、したい会話もできず、なんとか彼の話を無視しようとして、窓の外を眺めたり、本を読んだりしていたが、彼の声は必要以上に大きかった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「あなた、いいかげんにしたらどうなの？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 佐倉が千葉を睨んで言った。千葉は、夢から覚めたように、はっとして佐倉を見た。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「少しは、静かにしていられないの？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: おれは心の中で佐倉に喝采を浴びせた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「ああ。まったくよ・・・。千葉、おまえだけ送り返されてぇのか？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA6}「ご、ごめんなさい。友だちと海に行くなんて生まれて初めてだから、ぼく、興奮しちゃって・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: がっくりして、言った。脇谷も佐倉もまったく同情しようとしなかった。冷たい目で千葉を見ていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9C}「それ本当ですか？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 柿沼ともみが興味をそそられて言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA6}「うん」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9C}「かわいそう・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA6}「でも、いいんだ。こうして海に行けるだけで、もう思い残すことはないから・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 急に明るさを取り戻して、千葉が言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA6}「こうしてると”ああっ破壊神さまっ”の２巻を思い出すなぁ。・・・はっ！？ということは、ぼくが圭一で、佐倉さんが・・・ぽっ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 誰も千葉の言っていることが理解できなかったが、あえて意味を質問しようとする人間はいなかった。佐倉が眉をよせて、ため息をついた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA6}「あ、ごめんなさい。・・・みんな、”破壊神さま”知らないんだ。・・・もしかして、また、余計なこと言っちゃったかなぁ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 脇谷が諦めたように首を振った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: しばらくの間、気まずい沈黙が続いた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: そのうちに、千葉が黙ったことで、やっと会話がぽつりぽつりと始まった。女の子たちは、最近人気の高いテレビドラマについて話していた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9C}「あ、それ録画してるの。毎週。それでね、それでね、知ってる？反街さん、次の回で死んじゃうんだよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「ええっ？ほんとう？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9C}「ほんと。原作がそうなの」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「あら、残念ね。きっと視聴率下がるわよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「ああ、反街かぁ。人気あるって話だよな。あんな弱そうな男、おれは、どこがいいんだかわからねぇよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「わからなくていいわ。それに、誰が見てもあなたよりはかっこいいわよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA6}「あのう。反街崇っていうと、ネハンゲリオンの加地さんみたいな人ですか？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 一瞬、誰もが千葉が話し始めるのを危惧した。すかさず脇谷がたしなめた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「おい、千葉、そのネハンなんとかなんて誰も知らねぇんだよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA6}「ご、ごめんなさい・・・。あ、それで佐倉さんは反街のファンなんですか？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「・・・ファンってわけじゃないわ。ハンサムだから、いいと思うだけよ。かっこいい男が嫌いな人なんているのかしら？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA6}「じゃあ、かっこいい人が佐倉さんのタイプなんですか？佐倉さんの理想の男性は、どんな人なんですか？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「私？・・・そうねぇ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 佐倉は少しの間、考えて言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「長身の逞しい体格で、甘く凛々しいマスクを持った、頭がよく、お金持ちで、人望があって、よく気がついて、センスのいい男かしら」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 脇谷が皮肉な調子で言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「そんな奴、いねぇだろう」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 佐倉は勝ち誇ったように笑うと、理恵を意味ありげに見て、言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「いるわよねー？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵は笑って同意するようにうなずいた。それを見て、脇谷がショックを受けたのがわかったが、おれも同じだった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 脇谷は、明らかに元気を失って、椅子に寄りかかった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「でも、好きになるのがそういう人とは限らないよね」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵が微笑して言った。脇谷の顔がぱっと明るくなった。おれは理恵を感謝の眼差しで見た。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「そんなのダメよ。だから、理恵は・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 佐倉は言いかけて途中でやめた。憎々しげにおれを見た。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「そ、そうですよね、理恵さん！やっぱり、理恵さんは言うことが違う！」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 脇谷が幸福そうに言った。理恵は恥ずかしそうに微笑んでいた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 駅からバスに１０分ほど揺られ、停留所からさらに１０分以上歩かなければならなかった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: ビーチに着くまで、佐倉がさかんに歩かなければならないことで脇谷に苦情を言っていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「ひとつ聞くけど、今日は遠足に来たのかしら？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 強い日差しの下、湯気がたちそうなアスファルトの上を歩かされたため、顔が汗で光っていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 脇谷はもう少しで着くから、と佐倉をなだめた。さらに２度、佐倉が文句を言い、やっと目的地に着いた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 穴場という脇谷の言葉に嘘はなかった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: ビーチにほとんど人の姿はなく、砂で城を造っている地元の小学生、大学生くらいの年頃の少人数のグループがいくつかいるだけだった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 夏休みに入ったばかりで平日だったこともあったが、それにしても人は少なかった。交通の便が悪いのも、悪いことばかりではないな、と思った
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「あら、悪くはないわね・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9C}「わぁ。人少なーい。貸し切りみたい」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「・・・すてきだね」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵の言葉を聞いて、脇谷が顔をほころばせた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「いやぁ、理恵さんにそう言ってもらえると、うれしいなぁ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 太陽が輝いていた。砂浜を歩きながら、穏やかな波が寄せては返すのを眺めた。沖のほうでは、ジェットスキーを楽しむ人々がいて、水しぶきをあげていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「ほんとに穴場だよ。よく知ってたな、こんなところ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「そうか？へへ。去年ここに来ることがあってよ、それで、な」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 脇谷が得意そうに笑った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 女の子は更衣室へ向かい、おれと脇谷は人気のない場所で水着に着替えた（千葉は恥ずかしがって更衣室に行った）
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 脇谷がそわそわしだしたので、どうしたのか聞いてみた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「いや、その、もうすぐ理恵さんの水着姿が見れる、と思うと、緊張してよ・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: そう言ってから、慌てて、つけ加えた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「けっしていやらしい感情じゃねぇからな。ただ、その、美しいものを鑑賞したいっていう、純粋に芸術的なよ、その、なんだ・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「しかし、夢じゃねぇんだなぁ。ついに理恵さんの水着姿が見れるんだよなぁ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 着替えを終え、浜を裸足で歩くと、砂が暖かかった。女の子たちが水着に着替えてやってきた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「おまたせー」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「す、す、すばらしいです・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「あんまり、まじまじと見ないでー」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 脇谷とおれの視線に耐えられなくなり、理恵は恥ずかしそうに笑った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「下品な視線だわ。不快よ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 軽蔑したように、佐倉が言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 脇谷は、感動に目を潤ませて、おれに言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「海に来て本当によかったよ・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 着替えてやって来た千葉が、佐倉の前に立った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA6}「佐倉さん、きれいです」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 千葉がふらふらと佐倉に近づいた。佐倉がさっと身構えた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「近寄らないで！！半径２メートル以内に来たら、殺すわよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA6}「・・・あ、佐倉さんの言うこと、なんとなくわかったよ。ＢＴフィールドみたいなものでしょう？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「ＢＴ？なに？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: けげんそうに千葉を見た。千葉が説明しようとしたが、すぐに佐倉が黙らせた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「わーっ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵が海へ走っていって、波に飛びこんだ。柿沼ともみがはしゃぎながら理恵に続いた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「真由美もおいでよー」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵が手を振った。佐倉が、千葉が近づかないように警戒しながら、海へ入っていった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: おれの肩をたたき、脇谷はうれしそうに理恵のほうへ走り出した。表情には幸福感が溢れていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 脇谷は海に飛びこむと、理恵たちの前へ泳いで行った。おどけた表情で口をいっぱいに開け、言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「へへ。ジョーズだぞぉ。おれに捕まると、食べられるぞぅ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 脇谷がバタフライで女の子を追いかけ、理恵とともみが悲鳴をあげながら逃げていた。脇谷のおどけぶりがおかしく、おれは笑った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 脇谷が呼吸のために顔をあげるタイミングに合わせて、水をかけてやった。やがて、女の子も水をかけ、脇谷の泳ぎを邪魔した。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「げほっ。げほっ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 水を飲んだ脇谷は、泳ぐのをやめて、女の子に水をかけた。すぐにかけ合いが始まった。千葉も持参した水鉄砲で参加した。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「きゃー。私ばっかり狙わないでー」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 佐倉は水のかけ合いには参加せず、海にうかんだまま、皆がはしゃぐのを眺めていた。おれは佐倉のそばに行ってみた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「佐倉さん、具合でも悪いの？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「違うわよ。ほっといて。余計なこと考えないで、みんなと無邪気に遊んでなさい」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 子どもっぽすぎてやっていられない、ということだろう。肩をすくめ、脇谷たちのところに行こうとした。背後で千葉の声がした。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA6}「全エネルギー、ポジトロンショットガンへ。強制集束機、作動。薬室内、圧力最大」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 振り向くと、千葉が水鉄砲でおれに狙いをつけていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA6}「発射っ！」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: とっさに身を沈めると、水はおれの頭上を越え、佐倉の顔面を襲った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「千葉・・・。あなた、どうしてこういうことしかできないの？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 顔にかかった水を手の平で拭った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA6}「ご、ごめんなさい。ぼく、{X92}くんを狙ったつもりだったんだけど・・・。目標に高エネルギー反応っていうか・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「いい水鉄砲ね。ちょっと、それ貸してくれるかしら」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 千葉が水鉄砲を佐倉に渡した。使い方を千葉に聞くと、佐倉は千葉に狙いをつけ、水鉄砲を撃ち始めた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 逃げ惑う千葉を追いかけ、佐倉は何度も水を撃ち続けていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA6}「ぎゃああ。内蔵電源終了。活動限界ですっ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 佐倉が千葉を追いかけるのを眺めていると、脇谷がおれの横に来た。にっこり笑って言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「今、この瞬間、おれたちって、間違いなく青春してるって思わねぇか？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「そうかもな」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「ははは。まったく今日ほど、青春ってものを実感したことはねぇぜ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 脇谷が満足そうに笑っていると、横から水が彼の顔を襲った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9C}「あったりー」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 柿沼ともみが、千葉の水鉄砲を手にして笑っていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「やりやがったなぁ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 笑いながら、脇谷が彼女を追いかけた。楽しそうにはしゃぐ脇谷を見て、今日は彼のために裏方に徹してやろう、と決めた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: それが、理恵とのことを彼に秘密にしている、せめてもの罪滅ぼしだ、と思った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 遊び疲れて、女の子たちは砂浜に寝そべって、くつろいでいた。理恵がサンオイルを取り出した。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「真由美、塗ってあげる」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「ありがと、理恵」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 佐倉がうつぶせに寝そべった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵がふざけて背中から脇腹に手を滑らすと、佐倉がくすぐったそうに身をよじった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「どうですか、お客さん」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「きゃ。や、やめて、理恵」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: その光景を見ていた脇谷が、急に重大なことをひらめいたような表情になった。おれを見た。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「{X92}、おまえ、このチャンスを逃す気か！？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「なんのチャンスだ？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「馬鹿野郎、サンオイルを塗ってさしあげるんだよ。ほら、来い。おまえは、柿沼さんに塗ってさしあげろ。おれは理恵さんだ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 突然、横から千葉が話に割りこんできた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA6}「じゃあ、ぼくは佐倉さん！」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 脇谷もおれも、聞かなかったことにした。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「よし、気合い入れていくぞ、{X92}」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 気がすすまなかったが、脇谷について女の子たちの前まで行った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「手伝いましょうか？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 脇谷がにこにこして女の子たちに言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「間にあってるわ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 寝そべったまま佐倉が冷たく言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「女性にサンオイルを塗るのは男のつとめですよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「その汚らわしい手で触れないで。鳥肌がたつわ。それに卑猥の魂胆がみえみえよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: まったく交渉の余地はなかった。脇谷はしばらく頑張っていたが、相手にされなかった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「そ、それなら、お飲みものでも、買ってきましょうか？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「飲みものはいいわ。ひとつお願いがあるんだけど」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「なんでしょうか？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「あっちに行って」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 脇谷はがっくり肩を落とした。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「だめよ、理恵。甘い顔をすると、すぐつけあがるのよ、こういう連中は」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 彼女の必要以上の強硬な態度は、さっき一緒になってはしゃいだことを恥じて、その失点を取り返そうとしているからではないか、と感じられた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「くそっ。せっかく打ち解けたと思ったのによ・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 女の子たちから少し離れた場所に腰をおろすと、脇谷は海を見つめた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「だめだ。このぶんじゃ、理恵さんといい雰囲気になるなんて、とても無理だぜ。ああ、おれの１８の夏が過ぎていく・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 深くため息をついた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「おれは、はかない夢を見ていたのかもしれねぇな・・・。理恵さんと２人きりになれるなんて、しょせん、ありえねぇことだったんだ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 脇谷の落胆ぶりが気の毒になって、彼を元気づけようと思った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「元気だせよ。もう１回行ってみよう」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 脇谷に手を貸して、立たせた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 脇谷が理恵たちのほうを見た。急に彼の表情が一変した。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「げ。なんだ、あの野郎は！？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: ２０くらいに見える男が、理恵たちのほうへ歩いてきた。理恵の後ろから、彼女の頭を手の平でぽんと叩いた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「ナンパしようというのか、理恵さんを。ふふ。おもしろい！！どいつもこいつも、この脇谷徹がぶっ殺してくれるぞ～」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 早足で歩き出した脇谷を、不安な気持ちで追いかけた。今の脇谷はフラストレーションの塊だ。暴力沙汰になる可能性は高い。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: もし、そうなりそうな気配があったら、自分は彼を止めることができるだろうか。ぼんやりと考えていると、脇谷の歩く速度が遅くなり、止まった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「なんだ？どういうことなんだ・・・？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 脇谷が戸惑うのも無理はなかった。理恵たちは、その男と楽しげに話しているのだ。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 初めて会ったばかりという雰囲気ではまるでなかった。偶然の再会を祝う知人同士にしか見えず、事実そうだった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAE}「理恵、遊んでていいのか？受験生だろう？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「えへへー」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 妹に接する兄のようだな、と感じた。笑いながら、理恵の頭をこづいたりしていた。理恵は少しも嫌がる様子がなく、むしろ喜んでいた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 長身で、どちらかというと痩せているが、スポーツによってついた筋肉のせいで、貧弱さは微塵も感じられない。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 脇谷とおれは、あっけにとられて立ちつくしていた。理恵がおれたちに気がついた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「あ、先輩、友だちの{X92}くんと脇谷くん」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵がおれと脇谷を男に紹介した。男が微笑んで、おれたちを見た。見事な白い歯がこぼれた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAE}「よろしく。森伸彦だ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 男はごく自然に手を差し出した。気がつくと、考える余裕もなく握手していた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 穏やかなその口調から、自信と育ちのよさを感じさせる。彼を間近で見て、昨日、脇谷がスイカを買っている時に見たカップルの片方だったことに気がついた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵たちと話しているのを聞いているうちに、彼が一流の私大の学生であること、去年卒業したテニス部のＯＢであることを知った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 脇谷は、理恵たちが森と話しているのを、黙って眺めていた。握った手に不快感と敵意がはっきりと表れていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAE}「元気だった、真由美ちゃん？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「はい。先輩、」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}（おい、{X92}聞いたか？”真由美ちゃん”だとよ・・・）
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAE}「胸、少し大きくなった？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「やだ、先輩。へんなこと言わないでください」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 佐倉が照れて笑うのを、信じられない思いで見つめた。脇谷がぽかんと口を開けていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: これが、あの佐倉なのか？彼女から、ふだんの威厳は消えうせてしまっていた。どこにでもいるただの高校生にしか見えなかった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}（おいおい、こりゃ、どうしたことだよ・・・）
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「先輩こそ、ちょっと筋肉が落ちたんじゃないですか？大学で遊んでばっかりいるんでしょう？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAE}「ははは。まいったな」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「先輩、テニスやってないんですか？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAE}「今は、ほかのことが面白くてね。でも、まだまだ理恵には負けないさ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「あー。ひっどーい」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 女の子たちは、少なくとも、おれたちと遊んでいる時よりは楽しそうだった。脇谷が口をかたく結んだ。おもしろいはずがない。おれも同じだった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵と笑いあう森を見て、昨日、彼を見た時に妙に気になった理由がわかった。４月、まだ理恵とつきあうより前、脇谷とテニス部の練習を見にいったことがあった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: その時、テニスコートで理恵と親しげに話し、理恵の飲み物に口をつけていた男だった。ただの同じクラブの仲間以上の関係に見えた。似合いのカップルに。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: こうして理恵と森が楽しげに話しているのを見ていると、あの時の光景がまざまざと思い出された。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XBA}「伸彦ー」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 声がして、森の仲間がやって来た。スポーツマンらしい引き締まった体格の男に、女性が２人。そのうち１人は昨日森と一緒だった女性だった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XBA}「あら、伸彦の後輩？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAE}「うん。理恵と真由美ちゃん、ともみちゃん、それに脇谷くん、{X92}くん」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 彼らは、森の所属するサークルの仲間で、全員大学生だった。簡単に自己紹介した。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XB5}「日高みずき。上知の国際の２年です。よろしく」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XB6}「細川洋子です。清心女子の学生です」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAF}「高岡俊樹。稲早田大に通う苦学生や。よろしゅう」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 柿沼ともみが不思議そうに聞いた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9C}「みなさん学校違うのに、どうして同じサークルなんですか？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAF}「大学のサークルは、違う学校の人間でも入れるもんなんや。気があった仲間が集まってるだけやさかい」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9C}「はぁ。知りませんでした」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAF}「なんなら、きみも来年入る？歓迎するで」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9C}「え？そんな、私なんか。運動苦手だし、無理です」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAF}「関係あらへんて。洋子なんて、いまだにスノボは初心者コースやし、ウィンドも下手やしな」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XB6}「私はパラセーリングがしたくて入ったの」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「わぁ。パラセーリングやったことあるんですか？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: それからしばらく、アウトドア・スポーツの話、大学生活の話、海外旅行の話へと会話が賑やかに移っていった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「まったく、なんなんだ、あいつら。さっさとどっかへ行ったらどうなんだよ。ずうずうしいにもほどがあるだろう」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 脇谷は憮然とした表情で言った。おれと脇谷は、森たちの輪から２メートルほど離れた場所に座っていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「佐倉もよ、どうなっちまったんだよ。全然いつもと違うじゃねぇか」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 脇谷の不満もよくわかった。今日はそもそも脇谷の発案で実現した海水浴だった。しかし、脇谷の存在はいまや忘れられたにひとしい。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: パーティーの主役だった男が、予期せぬ有名人の登場によって参加者から忘れ去られ、テラスでひとりカクテルをすするはめになったようなものだ。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA6}「うわー！かっこいー！森さん、チュロキーに乗ってるんですかぁ！？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: いつのまにか、千葉までもが輪に加わっていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAE}「きみは車に興味があるのかい？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA6}「はい。確か最高出力１９０ｐｓ、最大トルク３１．１ｋｇ－ｍですよね」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 森が購入したＲＶ車について、千葉は夢中になって話していたが、森は嫌な顔ひとつせずに答えていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 脇谷やおれに車の話などできるはずもない。免許すらないのだ。せいぜい教室でカー雑誌をめくり、あれこれと空想をふくらますのが精一杯だ。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: ３００万円近いワゴンを乗りまわす相手と会話する気には、とてもなれなかった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「けっ。どうせ親に買ってもらったんだろうよ。ボンボンが。・・・千葉の野郎もよ、せっかく連れてきてやったのに、恩を忘れやがって」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「どうする？あいつら、どこかへ行くつもりはなさそうだけど」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「{X92}、まさか、おまえまであいつらの中に入るっていうのか？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「そうは言ってない。ただ、ここで座ってても、事態はよくならないだろう？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「む。まぁ、そうだがよ。おれは嫌だぜ、あんな奴らと仲よくするのは。御免こうむる」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 脇谷は、うつむいて、砂に絵を描き始めた。理恵たちが森たちと別れる気配はない。このままこうしていても、状況は変わらないだろう。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: だからといって、おれたちが彼らと一緒にいれば、ただの引き立て役になるのは目に見えている。どうすることもできず、苦々しい気持ちで森たちを眺めた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵たちが騒ぐのが聞こえた。佐倉が頬を赤らめていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「そんな。からかわないでください」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAF}「いやぁ。ほんまやで。初々しくて」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAE}「高岡の言うとおりだ。メイクもほとんどしてないし。化粧でごまかさなくてもいいからね。きみたちくらいが一番きれいなんだぜ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XB5}「あら、伸彦、それは私に対するあてつけ？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: みずきが冗談ぽくすねてみせると、どっと明るい笑いがおこった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAF}「理恵ちゃんも、ともみちゃんも、真由美ちゃんも、ほんま、かわいいわ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 女の子たちが、うれしそうに照れ笑いを浮かべていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「あいつら～。調子にのりやがって～。今度会ったら、ただじゃおかねぇ。くそっ。まったく、やってられねぇぜ、ちきしょう～」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 脇谷が悔しそうに歯ぎしりした。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAE}「ん？どうしたんだ、きみたち」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 森が、やっとおれたちの存在を思い出して、声をかけた。歩いてきた。高岡もやってきた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAE}「気分でも悪いのか？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 違った意味でそのとおりだ、と思った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAE}「せっかく海に来たのに、座っていてもしょうがないだろう？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAF}「ほんまやで。海に来たら元気に騒がな。・・・せや。きみらビーチバレーせえへんか？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 黙って無表情に聞いていた脇谷の表情が変わった。不敵な笑みが浮かんだ。立ち上がった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「いいっすねぇ。ビーチバレー。けっこうじゃないっすか。なぁ、{X92}」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 意味ありげにおれに目くばせした。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「どうしたんだ、脇谷。いきなりビーチバレーやるなんて言いだして。そんなに好きだったのか、ビーチバレー？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「まぁ、いいじゃねぇか。あいつらがやろうって言ってんだからよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: おれの肩に手をまわして、囁いた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「くくく。あいつら、ついに墓穴掘りやがったぜ・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「こりゃ、チャンスなんだぜ、{X92}。ビーチバレーでこてんぱんにしてやりゃあ、あいつらも面目丸つぶれだぜ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「勝つ自信があるのか？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「だいたい、サーフ・アンド・スノーとかぬかしてたが、しょせんは女とチャラチャラ遊んでるだけじゃねぇか」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「ただのボンボンだぜ。そんな連中に負けるわけがねぇだろう」
