strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 森と高岡を見た。ビーチバレー用のネットとポールを運んでいた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 高岡のもりあがった背筋は、彼が何らかのスポーツの経験者だと告げている。あまり甘くみないほうがいいような気がした。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 脇谷にそうアドバイスしたが、彼は聞き入れようとはしなかった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: コートの設営が終わり、女の子たちがまわりに集まった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「よろしくお願いしますよ、先輩。へへ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAF}「かわいい女子高生の前や。かっこ悪いとこ見せるわけにはいかへんな」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 高岡が理恵たちにウィンクした。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「きれいな女子大生の前で、みっともないところは見せられませんすね」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 勝利を確信して、脇谷がにやりと笑った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAE}「待て。ただやるだけじゃ退屈だろう。せっかくだから、何か賭けようじゃないか」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAE}「どうだ。負けたほうが、みんなに飲み物をおごるっていうのは？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「全然かまわないっすよ、先輩。へへへ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAE}「よし、決まりだ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 森が微笑んだ。女子大生の２人が口笛で雰囲気をあおった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「{X92}くん、脇谷くん、がんばれー」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: コートのそばに座った理恵が声援を送った。脇谷が目を輝かせた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「まかしておいてください、理恵さん！」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9C}「がんばってくださーい」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAE}「よし。じゃあ、始めよう」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 森が手にビーチボールをのせて言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 高岡がボールをうまくコントロールしてトスをあげた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 森が伸びやかにジャンプすると、一瞬、フェイントを交えながら、鋭くボールを撃ち抜いた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: フェイントのモーションにつられた脇谷が慌てて手を伸ばしたが、届かなかった。ボールは砂の上を軽くバウンドした。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「ゲームセット」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「くそっ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 悔しさを隠そうともせず、脇谷は足もとの砂を蹴り上げた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 女の子たちは、ゲームの結果に満足して、楽しそうに手を打った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「１５－６。意外に健闘したわね」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 試合の結果を当然のことと受けとめていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9C}「森先輩たちってスポーツの才能あるんですねぇ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 脇谷がやりきれない表情で、佐倉を見た。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 千葉が全員の希望する飲み物を書いたリストを持ってきた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 森と高岡がネットを片付けている横を、脇谷をつれて飲み物が買える店へと歩いた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 脇谷はうつむいたまま、さかんに呪いの言葉を吐いていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「くそ、くそ、くそ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「落ち着けよ。熱くなるほどのことじゃないだろ？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 脇谷がおれの顔を見た。顔を歪ませていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「{X92}、おれは悔しいっ。悔しいぞぉ～」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: おれは脇谷の肩を叩き、なだめようと努力した。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: おれと脇谷は両手に飲み物を抱えて、みんなのところへ戻った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA6}「何やってんだぁ。遅いぞぉ～」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 千葉がはしゃいで言うと、全員が笑った。脇谷が歯ぎしりした。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「おい、{X92}、おれはもうたくさんだ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: おれの耳元で言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「あの大学生連中と別行動にしようじゃねぇか。みんなに説明してよ。千葉の野郎は、大学生連中にくれてやるぜ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 脇谷は飲み物を配りながら、佐倉に声をかけた。手を引いて、彼女をつれてきた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「何の用よ？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 不審そうに脇谷を見た。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「いや、その、佐倉さん、あの大学生連中とは、このへんで別行動にしませんか」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「どうしてって、その、つまり、あの人はあの人たちだけで遊びたいんじゃねぇかなって思って・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「あなたが一緒にいたくないのなら、いなければいいだけの話だわ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「私たちは楽しいの。・・・つまらないなら、帰ればいいでしょう？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「話って、それだけ？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 脇谷は、がっくりと肩を落とすと、歩き出した。振り向かずに言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「{X92}、ちょっとトイレ行ってくる・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: おれは、ため息をついて、大学生たちへ視線を向けた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 激しいショックが頭を通り抜けて、おれは思わず息をのんだ。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 森が理恵の肩に手をまわして、なにかを話していた。理恵は、森にうなずいたり、笑ったりしていた。それは、仲のよい友人以上のものに見えた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 呆然として立ちつくしていると、佐倉が言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「お似合いでしょ？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: おれは激しく動揺したまま佐倉を見た。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「理恵と森先輩、テニス部のベストカップルっていわれてたのよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「まるで、理恵と森がつきあっているような言いぐさだ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 動揺を悟られまいと平静な声で言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「そうよ。知らなかったの？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: そのことをおれに伝えるのが、うれしくてたまらないようだった。彼女の目的がおれに苦痛を与えることなら、十分すぎるほど目的を果たしていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「本当よ。なんなら、理恵に聞いてみるといいわ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 頭の中で、佐倉の言った言葉が反響していた。森が理恵の耳元でなにか囁いていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 佐倉は満足したように、森たちのほうへ歩いていった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 森がこちらを見た。視線が交差した。彼は立ち上がり、おれを手招きした。微笑んでいた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 胸に彼に対する激しい怒りが溢れてくるのを感じた。彼の目をまっすぐ見据えながら、すぐそばまで歩いていった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAE}「{X92}くん、だったな。ちょっと手伝ってくれないか。これからバーベキューをするんだ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 彼は、親しみのこもった口調で、高岡のワゴン車にバーベキュー用のセットや食材が積んであるのだ、と説明した。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: おれはうなずいて、彼の後ろをついていった。彼と２人で話したいことがあった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 車はビーチを５分ほど歩いたところに停めてあった。高岡が荷台から、折りたたみ式のテーブルを取り出していた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAF}「手伝ってくれるんか。助かるわ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 森はおれにガスのボンベを持つように指示し、彼はグリルを持った。理恵たちがいるところまで彼と並んで歩いた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「森さん」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAE}「ん？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「理恵に触らないでもらえますか」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAE}「どうして？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: おれは強い口調で警告した。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「どうしても」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 興味をそそられたように、顔をこちらに向けた。微笑した。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAE}「いやだね」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 彼の自信に溢れた微笑を見ると、怒りがこみあげてきた。昨日の光景を思い出して、言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「森さんは、あの人、みずきさんと付き合っているんでしょう。昨日、駅前で見ましたよ。デートしてるところ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAE}「だったら？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「理恵に手を出さないでください」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAE}「いいかい、{X92}くん。もし理恵がきみのことを誰より好きなら、おれが何をしようと心配する必要はないだろう？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 彼に言われるまでもなく、理恵に触ることに対してだけなら、自分がここまで激しい感情にはならないことがわかっていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 男として、彼にはあまりにも魅力がありすぎた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 自分が動揺しているのも、彼と争ったら負けるということを無意識のうちに認めてしまっているからだ。彼の目を睨んで言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「心配してるんじゃない。理恵に触るな、と言っただけだ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 彼の微笑は少しも崩れなかった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAE}「理恵だって嫌だったら、おれの手をはねのけるんじゃないかな？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 事実だが、認めたくなかった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAE}「{X92}くん、誰を好きになるかは理恵の自由だよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 言い返すことができなかった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 黙ったまま森と歩いていくと、理恵は女子大生との会話に夢中になっていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 森が理恵に話す機会を与えたくなかったので、すぐに理恵を呼んだ。笑顔のまま、やってきた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「ねぇ、みずきさんたち、今度カナダに行くんだって。スキーしに。いいよねぇ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 彼女が連中に感心するのが、おもしろくなかった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「じゃあ、理恵も一緒に行ってきたらいいよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 突き放すような口調に戸惑って、おれを見た。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「どうもしない」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: そんなつもりはなかったのだが、激しい口調になってしまった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「なにかあったの・・・？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 心配したように言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 森といた時の彼女の笑顔を思い出した。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「理恵、聞きたいことがあるんだ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 言おうかどうか、一瞬ためらった。答えを知るのが怖かった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「森先輩・・・、森とつきあっているのか？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「佐倉が言っていた。理恵が森とつきあっているって。本当か？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵が目をそらし、困惑したように小さくうなずいた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「でも、それは、{X92}くんとつきあう前だよ・・・。２年生の時」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵の声が頭の中で反響し続けていた。頭の中に、理恵と森が抱き合っているところ、キスしているところが浮かんでは消えていった。長い間無言が続いた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「今でも森のことが好きか？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「好きだけど、・・・つまり、先輩として好きなの」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「おれよりも森のほうがいい？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵は、目を丸くしてぼんやりと立っていた。悲痛な表情になって言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「そんな・・・。どうして、そんなことを言うの？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「森とベタベタしないでくれ！」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 怒鳴られたショックで、理恵が小さく体を震わせた。凍りついたように、その場に立ちつくしていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「おれは嫌なんだ。理恵が森とベタベタするのを見るのが。森に体を触らせないでくれ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵を責めても何にもならないことがわかっていながら、おれはそうせずにいられなかった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 不信、不安、憎悪といった感情がごたまぜになって、自分から冷静な判断力を奪いさってしまった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵が力なくうなずいた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 彼女の悲しそうな顔を見ると、心が乱れた。理恵は、森と仲良くしたいのだ。仲良くしたい？愛しているから？
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵がおれを愛してくれている、と思っていたし、今でも愛してくれている、と思う。それなら、なぜ、頭を壁に叩き付けたい衝動に駆られるのだろう。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: それは、森が自分より魅力的だからだ。争って、勝つ自信がないからだ。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: お互い無言でみんなのところへ戻った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 食材に女子大生が包丁をいれていた。バーベキューの用意はほぼ終わっていて、いつのまにか高岡の車がバーベキューのそばに移動していた。音楽を鳴らすため、と高岡が説明した。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: トイレから戻ってきた脇谷がおれを呼びとめた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「おい、{X92}、おまえ、連中の手伝いしてたって本当かよ？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「おまえ、あいつらと一緒に遊びたいのか？ニコニコしてバーベキューが食いたいのかよ？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 不満そうに言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: おれは、脇谷に、連中と離れているよりも、バーベキューに参加したほうが連中に対して一矢報いることができるのではないか、と説明した。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: やつらの金で飲み食いすることは、ささやかだが、憂さ晴しになるのではないか。まさか金を払えとは言ってこないだろう。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 脇谷にそう言ったものの、本当のところは、理恵が森といちゃつかないように監視したいからだった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「そうか。そういう考え方もあるな。よし、奴らのぶんまで食いまくってやるか」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: バーベキューに用意された食材は豊富で、脇谷とおれがいくら頑張ったところで食べつくすのは無理に思えた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: カットした肉や野菜が皿に並べられ、その中から好きなものを串に刺して焼くように言われた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 空腹だったことも手伝って、脇谷は次々に料理を頬ばった。おれも食べようとしたが、理恵のことが気にかかって、いつまでも同じ串を手に持っていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「片っ端から食いまくって、楽しい雰囲気をぶち壊しにしてやるぜ。へへへ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 脇谷は一心不乱に食べまくった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵はおれに言われたことを意識して、佐倉とともみの間に立っていた。森は、グリルの反対側で、みずきと談笑していた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XB6}「はい。脇谷くん」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 脇谷が食べまくるので、面白がって、次々に焼きあがった串を脇谷に手渡していた。動物にエサをやるのと同じ喜びを感じているようだった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XB6}「すっごーい。ほんとよく食べるわねぇ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 感心したように言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XB5}「ほんとねぇ。はい。野菜も食べなきゃだめよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: みずきが野菜だけを刺した串を脇谷に渡した。脇谷は両手に持った串を交互に口に入れていた。その動作が滑稽に見えるので、みんなが笑った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAF}「見事な食べっぷりやなぁ。どこまで入るか見物やで」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 脇谷は不敵な笑みを浮かべた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「まだまだ食えますよ。おれは、まだまだこんなもんじゃないっすよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 先輩たちがどっと笑った。食べまくることで打撃を与えようというアイディアは、まったく意味をなさなかった。いい見せ物になっただけだった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAF}「理恵ちゃん、どうや、味は？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「美味しいです。ソースをつけなくても美味しい。素材がいいから、お塩とコショウだけで美味しいんですね」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAF}「そや。きみみたいなもんや」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵が恥ずかしそうに笑った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 脇谷が苦々しい表情で高岡を見た。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAF}「ともみちゃんは？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9C}「すっごい美味しいです。はい」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAF}「喜んでもらえて、うれしいわ。真由美ちゃんは、なんで野菜しか食わへんの？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「あまりお肉は好きじゃないんです」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XB5}「真由美ちゃんってベジタリアン？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「いえ。単に味が好きじゃないだけです」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9C}「でも、ただでごちそうになっちゃって、なんだかすいません」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAF}「え？ただやないで？誰がそんなこと言うたん？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 脇谷がのどをつまらせた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAF}「はっはっはっ。冗談や。きみらみたいな可愛い子だったら、いつでも喜んでごちそうするで」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA6}「でも、かっこいいなぁー。海でバーベキューなんて。ぼくたちには、とてもできないですよ。先輩たちって、全部かっこいいですねー」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 脇谷が不快そうに千葉を見た。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAF}「なに言うとるんや。バーベキューくらいで、おおげさやなぁ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA6}「それだけじゃないですよ。海外とかに行って、いろんなスポーツやって、乗ってる車はかっこいいし。あー、ぼくも先輩たちみたいになれるかなぁ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAF}「馬鹿やなぁ。そんなん、きみかてできることやないか」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9C}「でも、ほんとう、憧れちゃいます。すっごい大人って感じがして」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「高校生とは、確かに雰囲気が違うわね」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAF}「なんや、そんなこと言うたかて、１～２歳しか歳変わらへんのやで。人をおっさんみたいに。きみらだって大学に入ったら・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: それからしばらく大学生活の話題で盛り上がった。脇谷の顔が曇っていった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 脇谷が食べるのをやめて、おれに耳打ちした。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「おい、{X92}、まただ。嫌な展開になってきたぜ・・・。くそ。どうにかできねぇもんかなぁ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 思案していた。やがて、何か思いついたようにうなずいた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「そうか！なんて馬鹿だったんだ、おれは！」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「スイカだよ、スイカ。はは。すっかり忘れてたぜ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 脇谷の表情に明るさが甦ってきた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「これは、もらったようなもんだぜ。海といえばスイカ割りだからな。みんな、盛り上がるぜ。へへ。これで主導権はこっちのもんだ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 脇谷は佐倉の横に立って、満面の笑みを浮かべ、言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「佐倉さん、バーベキューなんてつまらないでしょう？実は、スイカを用意してあるんですよ。スイカ割りをしませんか」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「え？いやよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「そんな・・・。海といえばスイカ割りじゃないですか」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「やりたければ、１人でやるといいわ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 今度は理恵を誘った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「うん。でも、バーベキューが終わってからにしよう？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「ともみさんは？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9C}「あ、はい。でも、どうして今すぐなんですか？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 脇谷はため息をつき、肩を落とした。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA6}「脇谷くん、ぼくも、もぐもぐ、やらないよ。そんなの子どもっぽいし。もぐもぐ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「いつ、おまえを誘ったよ！？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 脇谷の表情から明るさが失われていった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「ちきしょう。何をやってもダメなのかよ。{X92}よ、こうなったら、おれたち２人でやらねぇか？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: やけくそ気味に言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「よし。やろう」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「そうだ。おれたちだけで最高に盛り上がろうじゃねぇか。みんなにやっとけばよかったって思わせてやろうぜ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 脇谷がスイカを取り出し、砂の上に置いた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「{X92}、どっちが先にやるよ？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「脇谷、先にやれよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「そうか？よし」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 脇谷はスイカから１０歩ほど離れたところに立ち、木刀を持った。おれは目隠し用のタオルを巻いてやった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「見えないぜ。よし、始めようぜ。木刀を振るチャンスは１回だけにしよう。割れるまで順番にチャレンジだぜ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 目隠しをした脇谷が、１歩１歩、前へ歩いていった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「ずれてるぞ。少し右だ。・・・そう」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 森たちがスイカ割りの光景に気づいて、こちらを見ていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「あと３歩くらいだ。これ以上ヒント出さないぞ！」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 盛り上げようと声をはりあげてみたが、空しいだけだった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 脇谷はスイカの１メートル弱前で立ち止まった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 木刀を振りおろした。スイカがあっけなく割れた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 脇谷は、目隠しをとってスイカが割れたのを確認すると、困惑したようにおれを見た。バーベキューをやっているみんなから笑い声がおこった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「気にするな。それより、スイカ食べないか？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「む。そうか。そうだよな。よし、食おうじゃねぇか。これもスイカ割りをやった人間の特権よ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 脇谷がぐしゃぐしゃになったスイカの破片を手にとった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 手に持ったスイカは暖かかった。少し不安だったが、思い切ってかじりついた。とても食べられたものではなかった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 脇谷がスイカを食べ、吐き出した。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「ぺっ。ぺっ。なんじゃこりゃ。そうか、冷やすのを忘れてた」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: みんなからどっと笑い声がおこった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「ちきしょう。あいつら～、もう我慢ならねぇ～」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 脇谷は手に持っていたスイカを握りつぶし、みんなのほうを見た。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 彼は立ちあがると、険しい表情でバーベキューのほうへ歩きだした。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: トラブルが起きなければいいが、と考えながら、脇谷の後をついていった。みんなはまだ笑っていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 高岡が笑いながら言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAF}「ほんま、いいコンビやで、きみら。おいしすぎるわ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 脇谷が高岡を睨んだ。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「そんなに面白いすか？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 口調に苛立ちがはっきりと表れていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAF}「ん？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 脇谷の態度の異常さに気がついて、みんなの顔に戸惑いが浮かんだ。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「おれらを笑いものにして、気分がいいすか？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAF}「怒ったんか？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 困惑したように言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「たかが高校生をコケにして、いい気分すか？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: なだめようとして、脇谷の肩に手を置いた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「先輩たち、かっこいいっすよ。金持ちのボンボンで、頭よくて、チャラチャラしてて」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 女子大生が顔を見合わせた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「やめなさい。みっともないわよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 脇谷は冷静さを取り戻すどころか、一段と挑発的な態度になって、高岡に言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「へっへ。さぞかし運動神経もいいんでしょうねぇ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAF}「脇谷くんかて、よさそうやないか」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: はぐらかすように言った。脇谷の態度に反発する気はなさそうだった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「高岡さん、泳ぎもうまいんでしょうねぇ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAF}「さぁ。うまいかどうかは知らへんけど」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「おれに泳ぎを教えてもらえないすかね」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAF}「そら、かまへんけど」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「あの、ブイのところまで泳ぎませんか。おれもできるだけついていきますから」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 沖に浮いているブイを指差した。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAF}「そやかて、けっこう遠いで、あのブイは」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 高岡の言うとおりだった。ブイはかすかにほんの点として見えるだけで、そう簡単に往復できるような距離ではない。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「あれ、先輩、まさか、泳げないんすか？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 嘲笑するように言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAF}「いや、行かれへんことはないと思うけど、疲れるんちゃうかなぁ・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: あまり気がすすまないようだった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「なら、いいじゃないですか。それとも、逃げるんすか？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 高岡は、脇谷の挑戦的な態度を持て余したように、肩をすぼめた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAF}「まぁ、ええやろ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「へへへ。そうこなくっちゃ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: やりとりを黙って見ていた森が、微笑して言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAE}「脇谷くん。泳ぐのはまた今度にしないか？これからカクテルをつくるんだ。きみもどうだ？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「ビーチバレーは受けたじゃないすか。今度はおれの誘いを受けてもらいたいすね」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 高岡が諦めたように、体をほぐし始めた。おれは、脇谷の気をしずめようと話しかけた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「脇谷、落ち着けよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 穏やかに言った。脇谷は、おれを見て、自信ありげに笑った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「大丈夫だ。おれは、泳ぎは得意なんだ。それに見ただろ？森が止めようとしたのをよ。あいつら泳ぎには自信がねぇんだ。へ。逃げようとしやがった」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 森が止めたのは、脇谷の言うような理由からだとは思えなかった。彼は場の雰囲気を修正しようとしたのにすぎないのではないだろうか、と感じた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「いいか、{X92}、このままじゃ終われねぇんだよ。負けっぱなしじゃねぇか。理恵さんの前で、負けっぱなしで終わるわけにはいかねぇんだ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 彼の決意を変えることはできそうにないな、と思った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XB6}「スタート！」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: かけ声と同時に脇谷が海に向かって走り出した。少し遅れて、高岡がスタートした。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 脇谷は全力疾走のまま海へ飛びこんだ。高岡がその後ろから走っていた。彼は全力で走っていないのではないか、と感じた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAE}「脇谷くん、まずかったな」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 森がおれの横に立って、言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAE}「高岡、水泳でインターハイに出たことがあるんだ。兵庫県の代表で」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 泳いでいる２人を見た。脇谷が全身を激しく動かしているのに対し、高岡はゆったりとしたフォームでありながらスピードでは勝っていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 脇谷がこの勝負に勝つ見こみはまったくないな、と思った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 森がテーブルの上にジンやラムといったボトルを並べ、カクテルの用意をしていた。女の子たちがカクテルを注文した。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 森は銀色のシェイカーを慣れた感じで扱っていた。動かすたびにシェイカーが太陽を反射していた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAE}「{X92}くん、なんにする？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: おれは首を振った。今日は最悪の日だな、と思った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9C}「わぁ。すごーい」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 森がボトルやシェイカーを放り投げながら、シンガポール・スリング、エッグ・ノック、マティーニといったカクテルをつくるのを、ぼんやりと眺めた。理恵たちが歓声をあげていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: おれは高岡の泳ぎを見、森の華麗な動作へ視線を移した。彼らと張り合っても無意味であることを痛感した。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAE}「どうかな？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 女の子たちがカクテルに口をつけていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9C}「おいしいです。全然お酒って感じがしないです」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「うん。なんだかジュースみたい」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAE}「はは。あまり飲み過ぎるなよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 森は楽しそうに次々にカクテルをつくり、女の子たちが笑いながらそれを飲んだ。楽しい休日そのものだな、と感じた。おれと脇谷をのぞいて。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: おれは泳いでいる脇谷を見た。高岡が脇谷をぐんぐん引き離していた。勝負が終わった後、彼にどんな言葉をかけたらいいか。考えた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: しばらくして、みんなのほうを見た。理恵の姿がなかった。森もいなかった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: おれは、柿沼ともみに、理恵がどうしたのか聞いた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9C}「酔ったみたいだから日陰で休む、って言ってましたけど」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: あっちのほう、と指を差して教えた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「森、森先輩はどこ？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9C}「あれ？そういえば、いませんねぇ・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 佐倉が面白そうにおれを見ていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「何をそんなにうろたえているの？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「森先輩を知らない？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「理恵を心配して、見に行ったわ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 彼女が完全に言い終わるより先に、おれは理恵を探しに走り出した。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《高岡はブイまで到達すると、泳ぐのをやめて、脇谷が追いつくのを待った。彼にとっては流した程度の泳ぎだったため、呼吸の乱れはほとんどなかった。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《少し離れたあたりで、ジェットスキーを楽しんでいる男がいて、エンジンの音が響いていた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAF}（脇谷くん、息あがっとるみたいやな。先に行かしてやらな、バテてまうやろなぁ）
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《脇谷を気遣って、高岡は、後半、脇谷を先に行かせることに決めた。その場に浮いたまま待った。少しして、脇谷が追いついた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「へ。先輩、もうギブアップすか。ペース配分ってものを考えねぇからっすよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《脇谷は息をするのも辛そうだったが、なんとかそれだけ言った。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAF}「ははは。まったく、きみの言うとおりや」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《脇谷はブイに手を触れると、ターンして来た道を逆に泳ぎ始めた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAF}（彼に花を持たせてやったほうがええかもしれへんな・・・）
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《高岡は、脇谷の後ろから、追い抜かないペースで泳ぎだした。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《脇谷の近くでエンジン音がした。脇谷が音のほうを見ると、ジェットスキーに乗った男が面白半分に伴走していた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}（なんだ、こいつは？）
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X83}【ジェットスキーの男】{X82}「タイマンのレースしてんのか？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《脇谷に笑いかけて言った。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《脇谷は無視した。それでなくても、泳ぐのに精一杯だった。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X83}【ジェットスキーの男】{X82}「おい、無視すんなよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《男はアクセルを開け、脇谷の注意を向けようとした。脇谷はあくまで無視の構えだった。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《退屈していたのだろう。それに、海の上ではジェットスキーに追いつける人間などいない。あくまで安全な立場でからかうことができる。男は脇谷につきまとった。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X83}【ジェットスキーの男】{X82}「あれかよ。どっちが速いか勝負だー、とかやってんだろ？青春て感じで」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X83}【ジェットスキーの男】{X82}「暗いやつだな・・・。おまえ友だちいねぇだろ？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X83}【ジェットスキーの男】{X82}「おまえ、フォームなってねぇな。おれが教えてやろうか？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X83}【ジェットスキーの男】{X82}「あのなぁ、手は親指から、なるべく前方に入れて、へその下をかくようにするんだよ。そうすっと、水をかく量が多くなんだよ。泡もたたねぇしよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X83}【ジェットスキーの男】{X82}「ゆっくりでもいいんだよ。しっかりかくのが大事なんだよ。それと、いちいち１かきごとに呼吸すんじゃねぇぞ。５かきに１回も吸えば十分なんだよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X83}【ジェットスキーの男】{X82}「そんで抜くときは小指からな。膝は曲げないで、足の付け根から動かせ。息継ぎするときは、肩を見るようにすんだ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X83}【ジェットスキーの男】{X82}「おい、だから、そうじゃねぇって言ってんだろ！手はもっと・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《堪えかねて、脇谷が怒鳴った。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X83}【ジェットスキーの男】{X82}「んだ、てめー、人が親切に教えてやってんのによ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《ジェットスキーの男は、いったん脇谷から離れ、距離をとってから、鋭いスピードで接近した。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X83}【ジェットスキーの男】{X82}「おら、いくぞ！」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《男は脇谷の前方で急ターンしてみせた。大量の水しぶきが脇谷を襲った。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X83}【ジェットスキーの男】{X82}「ひゃーほほ。ふひひひ。どうだよ。プレゼントは気にいったかよ？おい？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《降り注ぐ海水を浴びて脇谷の泳ぎが鈍ったのを見て、男は大声で笑った。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「てめぇ、くたばれ！！」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《水を飲んでむせながら脇谷が叫んだ。しかし、男を喜ばせただけだった。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X83}【ジェットスキーの男】{X82}「まーだ、わかってねぇな、おまえ。お仕置きが必要だな、こりゃ。へひひひ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「すいません、先輩」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAE}「気にしなくていいから。ほら」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《森は冷水にひたしたタオルを理恵の額にのせてやった。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《理恵は森の車の助手席にいた。弱めの冷房の中、シートを倒し、横になっていた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAE}「理恵が具合が悪いのに、ほっておくわけにはいかないだろ？日射病かもしれないし、なおさら外で１人にはできないよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「いえ、たぶん、ちょっと酔っただけですから」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAE}「うん。・・・理恵はアルコールはダメだったな。ごめん」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「ううん。私が勝手に飲んだだけです」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAE}「気分がよくなるまで、休んでいろよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《理恵が目を閉じた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAE}「さっきね、{X92}くんに、理恵に触るなって言われたよ。・・・彼氏かい？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「あ、はい。先輩と私のこと、誤解しているみたいなんです。だから・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAE}「誤解か・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《森はかすかに微笑んだ。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAE}「誤解じゃなかったら、どうする？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《理恵は目を開けた。少しの間、沈黙が続いた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAE}「理恵は、{X92}くんのことが好きか？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《理恵は森を見た。うなずいた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAE}「おれのことは好きじゃない？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《森は優しく微笑んだ。そして、窓の外に視線を向けた。{X92}の姿が見えた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAE}「時々、考えるんだ。どうして隣に理恵がいないんだろうって」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《{X92}が森に気がついて、視線が交差した。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAE}「今でも理恵が好きだ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《そう言うなり森は、理恵に覆いかぶさるようにキスをした。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: ともみに教えられた方向へ走ったが、理恵は見つからなかった。どこか建物の中なのだろうか。しかし、それらしい場所はなかった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: たとえ理屈には合わなくても、早く見つけなければたいへんなことになるという気がして、息づかいが荒くなり、急いだ。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 赤いＲＶ車が停まっていた。車に注意を払っていなかった。運転席に誰かいるのが見えた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 森だった。助手席は倒してあり、誰がいるのかわからなかった。森が横を向いて話しているので、誰かいることは間違いない。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: さらに車へと近づくと、森がこちらに気がついた。なにか話していた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 突然、森が助手席へ体を倒した。おれは、何が起こっているのか確かめようと、数歩前に進んだ。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 助手席には理恵が寝ていた。森が理恵に口づけしていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: はっとして理恵が起き上がった。彼女はフロントガラスごしにおれの姿を見つけた。呆然としていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: なぜ、理恵が森の車にいて、キスをしているのか。その問いに、なんとか楽観的な結論を導き出そうとしてみた。無意味だった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵がドアを開けて、外へ出てきた。おぼつかない足取りで歩きだし、やがて走りだした。森は運転席に座ったまま、無表情な目でおれを見つめていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: おれは立っていた。身動きもせずに。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《理恵はショックで呆然としたまま砂浜を早足に歩いていた。目が潤んでいた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《真由美とともみがバーベキューの後片付けを手伝っていた。みずきが理恵に気がついた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《よろめくような歩き方だった。理恵はまだ酔いが覚めていない。まだ休んでいるべきなのだ。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XB5}「あ、理恵ちゃん・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《早足でやってくる理恵に声をかけたが、理恵は全く反応を示さなかった。佐倉も理恵の姿を見た。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《理恵の様子がおかしいことに気がついて、佐倉はおそるおそる声をかけた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「あ、理恵、もういいの？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《佐倉のほうを見ないで、横を通り過ぎると、理恵は海へ走っていった。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《佐倉はあっけにとられて理恵の後ろ姿を見つめた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: おれは、気力も体力も尽き果てて、ただつっ立っていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 胸を裂かれるような苦しみにさいなまれていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 目の前を飼い主から離れた犬がひもを引きずって、走っていった。ぼんやりと波の音を聞いていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 海からの風に吹かれながら、現在の自分について考えた。嫉妬、恐怖、自己不信、がごたまぜになっている。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 自分はこれから何をすればいいのだろう。理恵を失うということについて、あまり真剣に考えたことがなかった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: これでおしまいなのだろうか。ただ黙って理恵が奪われるのを指をくわえて見ているべきなのだろうか。考えた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵をあきらめることができる。できない。できるはずがない。たとえ理恵が森を愛していたとしても、あきらめることはできない。自分は彼女を愛しているから。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: とにかく理恵と話すべきだ、と思った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵の去った方向へ走りだした。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: みんなのいる場所へ行くと、バーベキューはもう終わっていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 佐倉が詰め寄ってきて、怒りをみなぎらせて言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「理恵に何をしたの！？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵を探した。ここにはいない。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「あっちへ走っていったわ。質問に答えて。何をしたの！？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 佐倉の問いには答えないで、すぐさま理恵を追った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「待ちなさい！」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《ジェットスキーの男は、獲物を追いつめるサメのように、脇谷と高岡の周囲を旋回し続けていた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《脇谷は無視していれば、彼がいなくなるだろうと考えたが、それは誤りだった。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X83}【ジェットスキーの男】{X82}「おら、どうした？どうしたよ？悔しかったらかかってきな。ひゃーひゃひゃ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《男が脇谷の斜め前方で急ターンした。水しぶきが脇谷を襲ったが、すでに何度もやられているので、対処のしかたがわかっていた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《深く息を吸いこむと、水に潜った。逆らわずに波を受け、治まると頭をあげた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「なんともねぇぜ。へっ。そのていどかよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《脇谷が挑発すると、男が怒りに顔をひきつらせた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAF}（まずいんちゃうかなぁ、脇谷くん。あんまり茶化すと、あいつ無茶するかもしれへんで・・・）
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《浅瀬に近づいているのに、男は気にする様子もみせなかった。あるいは、夢中になって、その事実を見過ごしているのかもしれない。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵が泳いでいるのが見えた。まだ泳ぎ始めたばかりなのだろう。たいして遠くにはいっていない。泳ぐスピードもさほど速くないので、簡単に追いつけるはずだ。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 彼女の後を追って、海に入った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: ジェットスキーのエンジン音がしていた。音量から考えて、近くだな、と感じた。ずいぶん浅いところを走っている人間もいるものだ。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 不意に、理恵がさかんに手をばたつかせた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 泳ぎ方を変えたのだろうか、と思ったが、そうではなかった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 間違いない。おぼれているのだ。彼女は具合が悪くなった、と柿沼ともみが言っていたのを思い出した。足がつったのかもしれない。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: そんなことはどうでもいい。必要なのは彼女を助けることだ。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 大きく息を吸うと、必死に彼女に向かって泳ぎだした。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 後ろの方から森が叫ぶ声が聞こえた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAE}「理恵！」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: おれは全力で泳いだ。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「おい、もうすぐ浅瀬だぜ。へ。もう終わりみたいじゃねぇか」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《脇谷は、ジェットスキーの男の波しぶきの攻撃に慣れ、余裕すらただよわせていた。》
