strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「おまえの攻撃ってのは、そんなもんかよ！」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《嘲笑するように、脇谷が言った。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《ジェットスキーの男は唾を吐くと、脇谷から離れた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《十分に距離をとると、アクセルを大きく開け、高速で走りだした。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAF}（やばいで。まさか、つっこむ気やないやろな・・・）
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《スピードを上げながら、ジェットスキーが脇谷の前に接近した。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}（なんだ？まさか・・・）
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《脇谷の顔に恐怖の色が浮かんだ。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《ジェットスキーの男は、脇谷の数メートル目の前で急ターンした。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《しかし、脇谷と接触するぎりぎりまでタイミングを遅らせたため、ターンはひじょうに強引な角度で行わざるをえなかった。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《男はマシンをねじ伏せようとしたが、体勢に無理がありすぎた。ジェットスキーから振り落とされ、海に落下した。スキーは脇谷の前を横切って、それていった。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「ぶわっはっはっは。ごぼ。げほげほっ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《男の失敗に爆笑したために、脇谷は派手に水を飲んでしまった。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《ジェットスキーは主を失ったまま、走行したが、すぐには止まらなかった。男がウェアにキーをつなげるのを怠ったためだった。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: やっと理恵のいる場所までたどり着いた時には、理恵は水を飲んで、水面から沈みかけていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: １秒でも早く彼女を助けなければならない。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵を肩に担ごうとしていると、ジェットスキーのエンジン音が急速に近づいてくるのに気がついた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 音のするほうを振り向いた。無人のスキーがまっすぐこちらに向かってくる。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 気がつくのが遅すぎた。ジェットスキーは目の前まで来ていた。もう理恵をつれて泳ぐ余裕がない。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: おれは、とっさに理恵の盾になろうとした。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: なぜそんなことをしたのか、わからない。理屈で考えれば、おれが盾になったからといって、理恵を助けられる保証などない。なかば無意識のうちに体が動いていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: すべてがスローモーションのように感じられた。おれは自分が感じることになるであろう痛みを思い、息をのんだ。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: おびただしい水しぶきを浴びせながら、ジェットスキーは１メートル横をかすめて通りすぎていき、静止した。助かった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: おれは大きく息を吐き出すと、理恵のことを思い出した。振り返った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 森が理恵を担ぎ上げるようにして、声をかけていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAE}「理恵。聞こえるか？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: おれが感じたのは、森が理恵を助けたことへの反感ではなく、理恵が無事だったことへの安堵だった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 森が、おれを見て、言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAE}「{X92}くん、手伝ってくれ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: うなずいて、彼と一緒に理恵を担ぎ、砂浜まで泳いだ。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 森、佐倉、ともみ、みずき、が心配そうに理恵のまわりにかがみこんでいた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: おれは少し離れた場所から、理恵の様子も見守った。気管に入った水を吐き出そうとしていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「げほっ、げほっ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: ぐったりしていた理恵が水を吐き出した。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 森が理恵をそっと寝かせた。理恵が小さく呻いた。まもなく理恵がゆっくりと目を開いた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: まだ意識がもうろうとしている感じだった。目を薄く開いていても、しっかりまわりが見えているわけではない。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 佐倉が、意識を呼び覚まそうとして、声をかけた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: しばらくして、理恵の意識がはっきりした。彼女を囲んでいる人々の顔を見回した。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 声が震えていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 森が理恵の傍らから立ち上がって、おれの前に歩いてきた。微笑んでいたが、どこか元気がないように感じられた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAE}「理恵が呼んでる」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 森の手をかりて立ち上がった。理恵のそばに屈みこんだ。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAE}「{X92}くんだ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 森が言うと、理恵がこちらを見た。不安そうな表情だった。まだ溺れたショックから抜け出していないな、と感じた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「理恵、大丈夫？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵がゆっくりとした動作で上体を起こした。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: おれの目を見て言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「私・・・、あれは私がしたんじゃなくて・・・、ごめんね・・・、ごめんね・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: それだけ言うと、理恵はおれの肩に頭を寄せて静かに泣いた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 自分が溺れかかったことよりも、おれのことのほうが大事なことだというのだろうか。気がついて、最初に考えたのがおれのことだったという事実でもう十分だった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: おれは自分の嫉妬心を恥じた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵をそっと抱いた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「ごめんね、ごめんね・・・。私・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「理恵、もういいんだ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 彼女をなでながら、自分はどうして彼女を信じてやれなかったのだろう、と考えた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: おれは彼女を守ってやれる男になりたい。彼女を疑ったり、責めたりしない男に。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA6}「あれ～、何やってんの～？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: トイレに行っていた千葉がこちらへ笑いながらやってきた。おれは我にかえって理恵から体を離した。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: ハッとして、あたりを見た。理恵を抱いているところを彼に見られたのではないか、と不安になった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「あそこ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 佐倉は沖のほうを指差した。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: みずきが、脇谷は結果が同着だったことが不満で、高岡にもう１度勝負を強要したのだ、と説明した。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《脇谷たちは帰りの電車で、今日のことについて喋り合っていた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《脇谷が得意満面に高岡との２回目の勝負について熱弁をふるっていた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA6}「すごいや。本当、見直したよ、脇谷くん。あの高岡さんに勝つなんて、尊敬しちゃうな」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「そうか？わっはっは。まぁ、高岡の奴もそこそこやるけどよ。しょせん、この脇谷徹とはモノが違うよ、モノが」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《佐倉がうんざりしたようにため息をついた。ともみが苦笑した。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「ブイで折り返すまでは、まったくの互角だったんですよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「１回目のときは、本気出すまでもねぇと思ったから、前半でリードをゆるしちまったんすけど、それが響いて、引き分けだったでしょう」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「だから２回目は、体力を温存しつつ、前半はやつにピッタリくっついたんすよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「その話２度め」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「あれ、そうでしたっけ？まぁ、聞いてください。こっからなんすよ、本当の山場は」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《脇谷が楽しそうに笑った。彼は、高岡が自分に花をもたせてくれたことなど知るよしもなかった。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「後半に勝負をつけようとしたら、あの高岡の野郎がくっついてきやがった。おれは考えたすね。こいつ絶対最後までもたねぇぞって」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「でも、あいつも根性があったな。あそこまで、おれに食い下がったんだから。それは、認めてやりますよ。へへ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「だが、この脇谷徹の無尽蔵のパワーの前に高岡は屈した。ラストの２０メートルくらいで、おれはじりじりと奴を引き離し・・・、聞いてます？理恵さん？あれ？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《脇谷が理恵がいないことにやっと気がついた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: おれがトイレから出ると、理恵が洗面台で手を洗っていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: おれはまわりを見回した。みんながいるのは隣の車両なので、見られる心配はないのだが、万が一ということもある。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「もう具合は大丈夫なの？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「うん。心配かけてごめんね。お酒で酔ったまま、急に泳いだのがいけなかったみたい。足がつっちゃって、どうしようって思ったら、お水飲んじゃって・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「なんともなくてよかった」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵がうつむいた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「今日はほんとうにごめんね。あの時、私、気持ちが悪くなって、寝てたの。森先輩が車の中で休んだらって言ったから。そしたら、突然、先輩が・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「それに、おぼれた時も助けてもらって・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「いいよ。もう気にしてない」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「ほんとう？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「うん。まぁ、森先輩が好きなら、月に１度くらいはデートしても構わないよ。ただし、おれにバレないように」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: おれがおどけて言うと、理恵が顔をしかめ、笑った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「もう。{X92}くんのいじわる！」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「理恵、でも、どうしておれを？正直言って、男として森はおれよりずっと魅力があるよ。くやしいけど。ハンサムで金持ちで洗練されてて・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵は少しの間考えていた。やがて、かすかに微笑んで言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「それは・・・、どう言ったらいいのか、よくわからないけど・・・、{X92}くんが{X92}くんで私が私だから、としか言いようがない気がする」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: おれは微笑して彼女を見つめた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「さっき言ったことだけど、ほんとう？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「森先輩と月１回デートしていい、っていうの？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: おれは彼女をあっけにとられて見た。理恵がぷうっと吹き出して、笑った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: おれは彼女を抱き寄せキスをした。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《夜の１２時。森はホテルのバーのカウンターに１人で座っていた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《高岡がきょろきょろしながらバーに入ってきて、森を見つけた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAF}「なんや、ここにおったんかいな」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《高岡は森の隣に座った。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAF}「みずきに頼まれたんや。おまえが全然部屋に帰らへんから探してくれいうて・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAF}「おれとビリヤードしにいくいうたんやろ？彼女、ビリヤード場まで探しにいって、おまえがおらへんから、おれの部屋に電話したんや」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAF}「・・・どうしたんや？ケンカでもしたんか？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAE}「おまえの部屋にいるとでも言ってくれたらよかったのに」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《森がグラスに口をつけた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAF}「それはできへんわ。洋子、みずきと仲いいやんか。そんな嘘言うても、つつぬけやで」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《森は微笑し、グラスを空にした。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《彼はスコッチを注文した。バーテンが飲み過ぎではないかとアドバイスしたが、森は首を振った。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAF}「おまえ、なんかあったんか？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAE}「女の子にふられたんだ・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAF}「おまえが？冗談やろ？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《高岡は本気にしなかった。森はグラスを見ながら、微笑した。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAF}「まさかとは思うけど、・・・ほんまなんか？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAE}「本当さ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《高岡が半信半疑のまま聞いた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAF}「相手は誰や？まー、誰と言うたかて、驚かへんけどな。おまえのことや。この前連れてたあのモデルの子か？化粧品のＣＭの子？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《森は微笑したまま小さく首を振った。高岡がしつこく質問したが、森は答えなかった。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAF}「なんや秘密かいな。まぁ、ええわ。そんなら、どうしてふられたんや？誰かほかの男にとられたんか？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAE}「そう」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAF}「は。ははは。おまえでも、女をとられるっちゅうことがあるんやなぁ。どんな奴なんや、そいつは？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAE}「ふつうの高校生だ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAF}「はぁ？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《高岡は本気にしなかった。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAE}「高岡、失恋の経験は？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAF}「嫌味かいな？そんなん数えきれへんわ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAE}「辛かった？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAF}「まぁな。なんや、おかしいで今日は。おまえらしくもない」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《森が笑った。いつもの優美な笑顔だった。ひとつだけ、いつもより寂しげだったことをのぞけば。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 夏休みの長い時間を持て余していたおれは、脇谷に呼ばれて彼の家を訪れていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: ２人で遊んでいる時のいつものパターンで、おれは脇谷と酒を飲みながら馬鹿話に花を咲かせていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「ふう・・・いやあ、実にいい気分だぜ。ほれ、{X92}もう一杯」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「いや・・・おれ、ちょっと小休止」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「なんだ、もう酔ったのか？これからだろうが」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「結構飲んだじゃないか。おれは脇谷ほど酒に強くないんだから」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「酒に強い？おれが？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「ああ、普段から飲んでるんだろ？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「おまえだってそうじゃないか。部屋に何本かボトル置いてあるの知ってるぜ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「たしなむ程度だよ。それに最近はあまりやってない」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「へえ、どうしてだ？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「飲む気がしなくなっただけだよ。・・・前は暇潰しにやってたようなもんだったから」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「空しさを紛らわすための酒ってわけか。どうしたよ、なにか楽しいことでも見つけたんか？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「いや・・・まあ、なんというか・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「酒に溺れて人生見失うのはもったいない・・・と、まあそう思っただけだよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「金もかかるしな」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「そうそう」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「脇谷はいいよな。店の酒ってことは、ただみたいなもんだろ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「おれはちゃんと金払ってるぜ。まあ、他で買うよりはずっと安く手に入るがな」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「毎日飲んでるだろ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「別に習慣じゃないが気が向いたときに、な。・・・まあ、欲しいときにすぐ手に入るってのは便利だよな」

strings.jp: 独り言のようにつぶやいていた。

strings.jp: 計画。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 確かに脇谷の計画からすれば、彼がおどかし役になれない理由も分かる。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: だが、その理由を知っていたところでおれ自身が考えを変えるつもりもない。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: ピエロの役など、進んでやろうとする者などいるはずもないのだ。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「ああ・・・千葉か。今取り込み中なんだ。・・・悪いが後にしてくれ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA6}「さっきの話だけど・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA6}「おどかし役・・・ぼくがやってもいいけど・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「ほ、ほ、ほ、本当かあっ？！」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 脇谷が大声で叫んだ。千葉の肩を掴んで力任せにゆさぶる。あやつり人形のように揺れる千葉。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「そうかっ！やってくれるのか。千葉あ！！感謝するぜ！！」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「でも、千葉はメンツに入ってないじゃないか」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「構わねえよ！いやあ、助かったぜ、千葉！」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「これでヤローのメンツはそろった。あとは女の子のメンツだが・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「４人。理恵さんを含めてあと４人だ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「{X92}、理恵さんに集合の時間を伝えに行くついでに、あと３人女の子のメンツを揃えてくれないか」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「え・・・どうやって」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「理恵さんの友だちに声をかけてみるとか、いろいろあるだろう。なあ、頼む」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 返答に困っているうちに、あと３人、女の子を揃えることを約束させられてしまった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「ようし、頼んだぞ、{X92}！あ、それから肝試しをやるってことはふせておいてくれ。それを理由に断られたら元も子もなくなる」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「・・・そうだっ、中野たちにおどかし役が決まったことを教えてやらねえと。{X92}、おれちょっと行ってくるわ！」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 満面の笑みを浮かべ脇谷は教室を飛び出していった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: あとにはおれと千葉だけが残った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「・・・しかし千葉、どうしておどかし役なんて損な役を引き受けたんだ？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 当然の疑問だった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA6}「・・・{X92}くん。お願いがあるんだ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA6}「祭りの日に・・・佐倉さんも呼んでほしいんだ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: それだけ言うと千葉はうつむいたまま黙ってしまった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: なるほど、千葉は佐倉が目当てだったのか。納得のいく答えだった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「だけど・・・誘っても来るとは限らないぞ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「それにたとえ彼女が来たとしても、千葉はおどかし役で佐倉とはほとんど一緒にはいられないんだぞ？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA6}「いいんだ。彼女と会えるだけで・・・ぼくにはそれで十分なんだよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: ぽつりと呟いた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA6}「お願いだよ。{X92}くん」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 千葉は泣きそうな顔で哀願した。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 千葉は自ら損な役まわりを買って出てくれたのだ。条件つきとはいえ彼のささやかな願いをおれは叶えてやりたいと思った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「・・・分かったよ。だけど断られてもおれを恨まないでくれ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA6}「ほ、本当？！・・・ありがとう、{X92}くん！」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 千葉は瞳を潤ませ歓喜した。そして独り言のように何やらぶつぶつ言いながら教室を出ていってしまった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 脇谷には理恵を誘えと頼まれ、今度は千葉に佐倉を・・・か。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: なにかと人から頼みごとをされるこの身と、断れない自分の性格にあきれながら小さくため息をついた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: ＨＲが終わり放課後になった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 脇谷に頼まれたとおり、理恵のほか、残り３人の女の子を揃えるために、おれは彼女の教室をおとずれた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 教室の後ろの席で、女の子たちが女子校生向けの雑誌を見ながら談笑していた。そこに理恵もいた。そして佐倉真由美も。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 雑誌に載っている、かっこいい男の子の写真が紹介されているコーナーを見て、彼女たちがそれぞれの意見を出しあっていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9D}「・・・むうう。たまらんスねえ。ともみ、どの男がいい？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9C}「うんとね、左の男の子がいいよね。うん」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9D}「バッカ。右上っスよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9C}「そうかな？やっぱそうなのかな。・・・そうかも。うん」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9D}「理恵はどれ？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「うーん。真ん中の男の子がいいのだ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9D}「それも悪くはないナリー」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「左は知能が低すぎるわ。右上はプライドだけが暴走して中身がついていってない」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「真ん中は誠実そうに見えるかもしれないけど、それ以外にとりえがないだけね。ノット・クォリファイド」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9D}「身もフタもないナリー」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 女の子たちの楽しそうな声を聞きながら、ドアの近くで教室に入るきっかけを考えていると、佐倉が席を立って近づいてきた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「・・・さっきから気になってたんだけど、なにか用？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 君じゃなく理恵に用があるのだ、と言ってやりたいのを我慢した。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「理恵ね？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: あっさりと言いきった。佐倉は理恵を呼ぶとこちらに来るよう手招きした。理恵はおれを確認すると笑みを浮かべ立ち上がった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: だが、正直、意外だった。佐倉はおれが理恵と付き合っていることを快く思っていないハズだ。追い返されるものだと思っていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「なにが？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 言葉につまると佐倉が言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「あなた、私のこと意地の悪い姑かなんかだと思ってるでしょう」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: ジョークのつもりか、と考えていると理恵がやってきた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「どうしたの、{X92}くん」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: にこにこしながら聞いてきた。妙に機嫌が良さそうだった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 考えてみれば、付き合っているにもかかわらず学校で理恵と話すことは滅多になかった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: おれがこうして出向いて来たことがうれしいのだろう、と思った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「いや、祭りの件で話があって・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵に待ち合わせ場所と時間を説明した。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 佐倉の前で話すのは気が引けたが、結果的に彼女も誘う予定なので構わず話した。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 男のメンツについては脇谷とその仲間たち、とだけ言っておいた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 佐倉は理恵の横で黙って聞いていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「うん、わかった。公園に６時ね」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「へへえ、楽しみ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 佐倉はひととおり話を聞き終わると、無言で教室に戻ろうとした。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: これが理恵と２人きりで祭りに行く話だったら、ここまでおとなしく引き下がりはしなかったろう。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: だが、このまま行ってしまっては、こちらが困るのだ。慌てて彼女を引き留めた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「佐倉さんも来ない？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: ぴくんと体を震わせて立ち止まった。ゆっくりと顔を向けた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 驚いているようだった。自分に誘いがかかることなど、まったく予想していなかった、という感じだった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「さっき話したように女の子は彼女１人だし、・・・もし、時間が空いていたらだけど・・・いや、ぜひ来てくれないか」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: じっと見つめる佐倉の視線にうろたえ、しどろもどろになってしまった。佐倉は黙って聞いていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 聞いてみたが反応がなかった。無視している、というより聞こえていないように思えた。理恵が声をかけた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「真由美、行こうよ。ねえ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 曖昧に返事をした。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「・・・いけない。私、これから大事な用事があるの。すっかり忘れていたわ。・・・ごめん理恵、先に帰るわね」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 自分の席に戻りカバンを手にすると、おれと理恵の間を早足ですり抜けていった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「さようなら」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 視線を合わせずに、そのまま階段を降りていってしまった。おれは理恵と顔を見合わせた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「これは、断られたと見るべきなのかな？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵に聞いてみた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: しばらく考えてから理恵が答えた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「たぶん、ＯＫだと思う」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「どうしてそう思うの？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 疑問に思って問いかえした。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「いやだったらすぐに断ると思う。でもはじめてだよ。真由美が曖昧に答えるなんて」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: やはり驚いていたのだ。もしかすると佐倉は人から誘われたりする経験が少ないのかもしれない。あるいはそれで照れていたのかも、と考えた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「じゃあＯＫしてもらえたと考えていいのかな？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「たぶん、ね」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵が言うなら大丈夫だろう。なにしろ佐倉とは親友の仲だ。彼女の言葉を信じることにした。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「それで、ちょっとお願いがあるんだけど」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵に、友だちをあと２人誘ってくれないか、と相談した。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「２人ね。うん、わかった。たぶん大丈夫だと思う」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 用件は終わった。このまま２人で帰りたい衝動に駆られたが、それは叶わぬ夢だ。誘惑に負けぬよう早めに切り上げることにした。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「じゃあ、祭りの日にまた」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「うん、じゃあね。楽しみにしてる」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 教室の前で理恵と別れた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 学校内で理恵と話すときは、常に周りに気を配らなければならない。そのために口調も他人行儀なものになってしまう。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵の後ろ姿を見ながら、心の中で頭を下げた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 祭り当日。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: おれは脇谷とともに、待ち会わせ場所である公園の噴水広場の前に来ていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「しかしよ、よりによって佐倉まで来ることになるとはな・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「しかたないだろ。それが千葉の出した条件だったんだ。それとも断った方が良かったか？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「それに誘いはしたけど来るとは限らないよ。なんか彼女、おれの話黙って聞いてただけだったから」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「む、そうか」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「・・・来たみたいだぞ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「理恵さんか？！」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 目を輝かせながら言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「・・・来てやったわよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「こんばんわ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「こんばんわ・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 誘われたことが彼女のプライドをくすぐったのか、佐倉はそっけない態度で答えた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: だが、かすかに口元がゆるんでいるのをおれは見逃さなかった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 脇谷はおれの横ですねたように黙っている。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「いや、なんでも」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 佐倉が脇谷の表情に気づいて言った。答えに窮していると、うしろから理恵が声をかけてきた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「こんばんわ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 浴衣姿に身を包んだ理恵が現れた。かすかに石鹸の香りがした。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 脇谷はうつろな目をして呆然と理恵を見つめていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「こ、こ、こ、こんばんわ、理恵さん」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 夢から醒めたように答えた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}（み、見ろ、{X92}、理恵さんの浴衣姿を。う、う、美しいとは思わねえか？）
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 脇谷がうれしそうに耳うちしてきた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: おれも脇谷と同意見だった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}（こんな日が来るなんて・・・夏祭りってものがあって本当によかったよ・・・）
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 脇谷は空を見上げ瞳を潤ませていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「理恵。よく似合ってるわ、その浴衣」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「へへ、ありがとう。真由美も着てくると思ってたのに」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「別にお祭りだからって浴衣着なくちゃいけないワケじゃないでしょう？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「それに見せたい相手がいるワケでもないし」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: ちらりと視線をおれに向けた。皮肉が込められているのはあきらかだった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「や、やだ・・・なに言ってるの真由美」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵が頬を赤らめながらおれの方を見た。おれはこの露骨なやりとりに脇谷が気付いてしまうのではないかと内心冷や汗をかいていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: だが、おれの心配をよそに脇谷はひとり空を見上げ感涙していた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9D}「こんばんわあ。わお、理恵、浴衣きてきたんだ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9C}「いいなあ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 貴久美とともみが現れた。簡単にあいさつすると、女の子同士でおしゃべりをはじめた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「時間ぎりぎりね。また準備に手間取ってたんでしょう？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9D}「ふっふっふ、ごみ～ん」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9C}「きれいだなあ。私も浴衣着てくればよかったなあ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「へへ、ありがとうなのだ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 楽しそうに談笑する女の子たちの輪から、佐倉が抜け出し声をかけてきた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「約束の時間よ。これで全員そろったの？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 腕時計を見て言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「ふう」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 軽くため息をつくと佐倉は噴水の方へ歩いていった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「怒ったのかな？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「違うと思うけど。ただ、時間に厳しいから、真由美。・・・ちょっとごめんね」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 佐倉のあとを追って理恵も噴水の方へ向かった。貴久美とともみは離れたところでおしゃべりをしていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: あとにはおれと脇谷だけが残った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 脇谷はまだ自分の世界にイっていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: どこからともなく千葉が現れた。まるで気配を感じさせなかったので肝を潰した。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「ち、千葉。おまえ・・・どっから現れた？！」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA6}「そこの木の陰から・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 千葉は近くの林を指さして言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「木の陰って・・・じゃあ、おまえずっとそこにいたのか。どうして？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA6}「佐倉さんが来たら、き、緊張しちゃって・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA6}「{X92}くん。あ、ありがとう。佐倉さんを誘ってくれて。ぼくおどかし役精いっぱいがんばるよ！」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「そ、そうか。がんばってくれ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 千葉はおれの手をとって瞳を潤ませた。となりでは脇谷が天に向かって涙している。奇妙な光景だった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA5}「メッス」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 中野と田村がやってきた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「遅いよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA5}「悪ぃ。これでも全速力で来たんよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA4}「途中でコーヒーの新製品の販促にひっかかって。こいつがどうしても飲みたいって」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA5}「試さずにおられようか」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA4}「コンパニオンのお姉さん嫌がってたぞ。おまえがあ～でもない、こ～でもないってうるさいから」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA5}「言わずにおられようか」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA4}「おかげで遅れた」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA5}「アイムソーリィ。だが、真実の道を歩む者に妥協は許されないのだ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA4}「ま・・・どうでもいいけどね、別に」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 田村と中野の口論を聞きつけて、佐倉が戻ってきた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「これで全員？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: じろりと皆の顔を見渡して言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA6}「さ、佐倉さん！！」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「・・・ち、千葉。・・・こ、こんばんわ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA6}「こ、こちらこそ、こんばんわ！」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 千葉は顔面を硬直させたまま大声で答えた。そして放心したようにふらふらと歩きだした。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 佐倉は一気に疲れたような顔をしてため息をついた。おれは吹き出しそうなのを必死になってこらえた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「みんな揃ったの？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 遅れてきた理恵が言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「そうみたいだけど・・・いつまでここにいるつもり？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: にらみつけるようにおれを見た。吹き出しそうなのを悟られたようだった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「ああ、みんな揃ったことだしそろそろ・・・おい、脇谷っ！！」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 放心している脇谷の腹にエルボーをかました。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「ぐほっ？・・・あ、ああ、そうだった。祭りだっ、祭りに行くんだっ！」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: そう言うと脇谷は先頭にたって歩きだした。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「さあ、理恵さん。僕についてきて下さい」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 皆で祭りが行われている七坂神社の方へぞろぞろと移動を始めた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「わお、いっぱい夜店が出てるよ。あっ、ヨーヨー釣りだ。真由美、ヨーヨーだよ、ヨーヨー」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「なに？ヨーヨーがどうかしたの？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「ね、真由美行こう。ヨーヨー釣るのだ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「ちょっ、理恵。すごいはしゃぎよう・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「見ろ、{X92}。理恵さんがあんなに喜んでいる」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「おれは今日という日を永久に忘れないだろう・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 脇谷は胸に手を当て神に感謝するように天をあおいだ。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA6}「・・・佐倉さん」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: ぽつりとつぶやきながら千葉は佐倉のほうへフラフラと吸い込まれていった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 中野と田村は夜店の食べ物を見てまわっている。中野は掘り出し物のコーヒーはないかと息まいていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: ヨーヨーを釣りそこなって、２度目の挑戦をはじめた理恵のうしろ姿をぼんやり眺めていると、脇谷に肩を叩かれた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「{X92}、わかってるな？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 脇谷が小声で、今日の計画の段取りの確認を始めた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: まず２人１組のペアを組む。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: そして１組ずつ、七坂神社のそばにある墓地を通って、出口近くに植えられている柳の木にくくりつけてあるおみくじをとって、スタート地点に戻ってくる。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 後続のペアとすれ違うことのないように、帰りは墓地の外周を通ることになっている。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: およそ誰もが考えつくような平凡なルールだった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 出口付近には千葉を待機させる。脇谷の用意した血糊でメイクした千葉が、近づいてきたペアを驚かすといった手はずだ。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: とりわけ凝った演出ではないが、千葉の演技次第ではそれなりの効果を期待できる。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 自分は理恵とペアを組み、恐がる理恵の前で頼り甲斐のあるところを見せて一気に親睦を深める計画だ、と脇谷が言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「結果的に理恵さんをだますことになってしまうが、おれはいつだって理恵さんのためなら死ぬことだって恐れないって気持ちを知ってもらいたいんだ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: こぶしを握りしめて言った。その気持ちに偽りがないのは明らかだった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: だが、そう都合良く理恵とペアを組むことが出来るのか、という疑問があった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: おれの考えを察したのか、脇谷が笑みを浮かべて答えた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「{X92}、おまえの考えている事はわかってるぜ。どうやったら理恵さんとペアを組む事が出来るのか、とそう考えているんだろう？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 軽くうなずくと脇谷はポケットから紙きれを取り出した。紙にはマジックで線が引かれていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「ペアはアミダで決めようと思う」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: アミダには上下に名前を書き込むワクがあり、上が女性陣、下が男性陣とにわかれていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「これで男女１組のペアが４組できるわけだ。どうだ、誰の目にも公平だし不正の余地はないだろう」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: それでどうやって理恵とペアを組めるというのだ、と言おうとしたが脇谷にさえぎられた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「だがよ、アミダに細工がなくとも、選択する人間に細工がしてあったら？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: なんの事かわからなかった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 脇谷が得意そうに言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「つまりよ、おれら男性陣が前もってアミダの枠組みを知っていれば・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「選択する順番は関係なく、おれらの思いどおりの結果が得られるだろうが」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: つまりは男全員が共犯なワケだ。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「まず理恵さん、つまり女性陣に先にワクを選択して、おれら男性陣があとから書き込むって寸法よ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「レディ・ファーストのつもりでな。これで完ぺきよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 脇谷が得意そうな顔でおれを見た。複雑な心境だった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: だが、真顔で説明する脇谷を見ていると、とても断れる雰囲気ではなかった。黙って彼の言葉に従った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「よし。しっかり頼むぜ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: そう言い残すと、脇谷は確認のためにと中野と田村のほうへ歩いていった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 意気揚々と歩く脇谷の後ろ姿を見送りながら、これで理恵と２人きりになるチャンスも皆無に等しくなったな、と思った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 視線をうつすと、今度は射的に熱中している理恵の姿が目に入った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 真剣な顔つきで的を狙っていたが、コルク弾は大きく的をそれていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 自分の弾を使い尽くすと、となりで見ていた佐倉真由美が理恵から銃を受け取り、構えた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: たて続けに引き金をひくと、的確に獲物に命中させていった。見事としかいいようがなかった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 獲物だったぬいぐるみを店主から受け取ると、理恵にそれを手渡した。理恵はよろこんでぬいぐるみを抱きしめた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: できることなら自分がその役目を引き受けたかった、と考えた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: ２人の姿を見ていると、彼女たちから少し離れたところに千葉の姿を確認した。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 千葉は横目で佐倉を見つめながらフラフラ歩いていた。まるで彼女以外は目に入っていない感じだ。それが彼の不幸だった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 千葉は前を見ていなかったために、前方から歩いてくるカップルに気づかず、そのままブチあたった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 貧弱な彼の体はあっけなく相手の男にはじき飛ばされた。落ちそうになった眼鏡を戻して千葉が頭を下げた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA6}「す、すみませ・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 最後は声が消えかけていた。ぶつかった相手は千葉よりも、ひとまわりも大きいガラの悪そうな男だった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 男は黙って千葉を睨みつけた。千葉は絶句して凍りついたように棒立ちになった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 一瞬緊迫した空気が流れた。どうしたものか、と考えていると、連れの女が男に声をかけた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XB8}「・・・ねえ、ここは混んでてうざいから他のところへいこうよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 男は軽く舌うちすると、女とともにその場を去った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 千葉は崩れるように座り込んだ。泣きそうな顔で息をしていると、一部始終を見ていたおれと目があった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 立ち上がりおれのもとに走ってきた。興奮した声で泣きついた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA6}「{X92}くん、こ、怖かったよお！！」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「良かったな、何事もなくて」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA6}「見てたのなら助けてよお」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「どうしようか考えてたんだ。でもよそ見していた千葉も悪い」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA6}「ぼく・・・恐ろしくて心臓が止まるかと思ったよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: いまだ興奮さめやらぬ感じで辺りを警戒していた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 千葉のような男におどかし役など本当につとまるのだろうか、と不安になった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 脇谷の提案によって、おれたちは神社の離れにある墓地の入り口に集合した。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 墓地の周辺には照明と呼べるものはなく、月明かりだけがおれたちの姿を照らす唯一の光だった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 夜中に１人でここを訪れたとしたら、それなりの不安を感じずにはおられないだろう。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: まして女の子だったらその恐怖は相当なもの、そんな事を考えながら周りのみんなの顔を観察した。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵の顔を見た。案の定、不安そうな顔つきで佐倉のそばにくっついていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「なんか不気味・・・。お、お化けかなんか出そうな雰囲気」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 周囲を見渡しながら言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「幽霊なんているわけないじゃない。霊媒士はただのサギ師だし、心霊写真は安っぽいトリックよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
