strings.jp: シニカルな態度で答えた。佐倉は霊などはまるで信じていないようだった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 田村と中野を見た。中野はさきほど夜店で手にいれた缶コーヒーを手に、なにやら田村と議論していた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: ひととおり周囲を見渡すと、千葉の姿が消えている事に気づいた。脇谷の顔を見た。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「千葉ならさっき”具合が悪くなった”とかいって帰ったぞ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: それだけ聞いて納得した。打ち合わせどおりだった。千葉はおどかし役として自分の持ち場に向かったのだ。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「そう、千葉くん、帰ったの」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 脇谷との会話をしっかり聞いていた佐倉が、ほっとしたような顔で話してきた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「ところで、こんなところにみんなを集めて何をしようというの？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 女性陣は、これから肝試しが行われることを知らない。みんなを集め、脇谷が説明をはじめた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「ふん、くだらないわね。どうしてあなたたちとペアになってまで、そんなことしなきゃならないの？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: あきれた顔で言った。脇谷が一瞬ムっとしたが、すぐに満面に笑みを浮かべて食い下がった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「いや、真由美さん。きっと満足すると思いますよ。いっときの刺激ある時間を過ごしてみたいとは思いませんか？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「過ごしたくないわ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 冷淡に脇谷の意見を否定した。それでも脇谷はあきらめようとせず、熱心に佐倉を説得しようと試みていた。佐倉はまったく無視していた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「恐いんですか。真由美さん、ひょっとして」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: じれたのか挑戦的に脇谷が言った。佐倉が眉をひそめた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「なにを言っているの？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: あきれ顔で脇谷を見た。佐倉の反応に気づき脇谷が言葉を続けた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「だってそこまで嫌がるってのはおかしいですよ。恐いとしか思えない」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「無駄に時間を潰したくないっていってるの」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「みんなはどう思ってるかわからないじゃないですか」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 機を見計らって中野が会話に割り込んできた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA5}「いいんでないの。スリルとサスペンス。好きよ、おれ、そういうの」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA4}「暇つぶしとしては、いいんじゃないの？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 田村があとに続いた。本心ではないはずだ。恐らく見返りを期待しての行動だろう。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 当然、といった顔で佐倉の方を見た。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「みんなは？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 佐倉が女性陣に向かって聞いた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 貴久美とともみが黙ってうなずいた。賛成だった。残った理恵が遠慮がちに言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「私も、やっていいと思う。・・・恐いけど」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 完全に孤立した佐倉は、勝ち誇って胸をはる脇谷に向かって呟いた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「・・・ふう、分かったわ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: それだけ言うと背を向けて、理恵の横に並んだ。隣で理恵が申し訳なさそうな顔をして佐倉を見ていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「じゃあペアを決めよう。{X92}、紙とペンを貸してくれ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: あらかじめ用意しておいたメモ用紙とペンを取り出し脇谷に手渡した。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「のぞくなよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: みんなから見えない位置まで移動すると、脇谷はアミダを書きはじめた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: しばらくすると出来たアミダを持って戻ってきた。アミダをみんなの前に差しだした。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 実際にはアミダは事前に作られている。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: いま脇谷が出した紙は、すでに男性陣が前もって暗記してあるものだ。さっき書くふりをしてすり替えたのだった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「アミダを作った。適当に線を引いたから、互いの線の行き先はおれにも分からない。つまり不正はないってワケだ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 脇谷は、上下の書き込みの部分以外を紙で隠した。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「これでよし。じゃあ、女性の方々からどうぞ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 脇谷はペンを女の子の方に差しだした。貴久美がそれを受け取った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9D}「それじゃ・・・私はここ。ともみは？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9C}「え～とね。そのとなりがいい」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 楽しそうに自分の名前を書き込んでいた。貴久美が理恵にペンを手渡した。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9D}「ほら、理恵も書いて」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: ペンを受け取ると、脇谷の持つアミダに手を添えて、どこに書こうか考えていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 目の前まで接近した理恵を見て、脇谷が顔を真っ赤にしていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「じゃあ・・・ここ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵が自分の名前をワクに書き込んだ。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: その瞬間、おれも脇谷も、田村も中野もそのワク一点に視線を集中させた。そして、記憶した。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 脇谷の顔を見た。真顔でアミダを凝視していた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「うん、終わり。真由美の番だよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵が佐倉を呼ぶ声が聞こえた。返事がないので、脇谷から佐倉の方へと顔を向けた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 一瞬ぎょっとした。佐倉はじっとおれを見ていた。いや、正確にはおれたち男性陣の方を、だ。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: おれと目が合うと、佐倉はフッと笑い、脇谷の手からアミダをひったくった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 気を抜いていたために、あっけなくアミダは佐倉の手に渡った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: うろたえ手を伸ばす脇谷に、佐倉は勝ち誇った笑みを浮かべて言い放った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「不正はないって言ったわね。その表現は正確じゃないわ。私たちが確認したワケじゃないもの」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: ニヤリと口元をゆがめて言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「だから、公正さをより確実なものにするために、アミダに線をつけ加えさせてもらうわ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 脇谷が反論しようとしたが、無駄だった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「なにをそんなにうろたえるの？公正さを尊重するなら異論はないハズよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: そう言うと佐倉は、みんなの前ですばやく、アミダに何本も線を書き足した。そして紙でアミダの部分を隠した。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「これで誰がどこにたどりつくか、分からなくなったわ。つまり公正さも完ぺきになったわけね」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: そう言うと、満足そうな顔で自分の名前を書き込んだ。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「どうぞ。今度はあなたたちの番よ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 佐倉が差し出したアミダを、脇谷が震える手で受け取った。泣きそうな顔をしていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 田村と中野が互いに肩をすぼめた。脇谷は手にしたアミダに目を下ろし、がっくりと肩を落とした。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 脇谷の計画は水泡に帰した。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 考えてみてもどうしようもないので、脇谷たちは、それぞれ適当なワクに自分の名前を記入していった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 全員が記入しおわると、脇谷がアミダの結果を発表した。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 貴久美と田村、ともみと中野、佐倉は脇谷と、そして理恵はおれとペアを組むことになった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: ペア同士が並ぶと、それぞれ軽くあいさつをかわした。脇谷は佐倉の横で、すねた顔をしてそっぽを向いていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 思いがけない結果に、おれは喜んでいた。理恵がおれの横に並び声をかけてきた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「よろしく」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「こちらこそ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵はうれしそうに微笑していた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: これで理恵と２人きりになれる。どんな形にせよ理恵と一緒にいられることに、おれは喜びを感じていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 佐倉を見た。心の中ではじめて彼女に感謝した。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 脇谷が呼んだ。なにやら手招きしている。呼ばれるままに脇谷の方に向かった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「ちょっといいか？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 脇谷はおれの腕を掴み、佐倉から少し距離をおいてから、小声で話しはじめた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「{X92}。おまえに頼みがある」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: かすかにいやな予感がした。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「おれは理恵さんとペアを組めなかった。だが、幸いにしておまえが理恵さんとペアを組んだ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 幸いとはどんな意味だ、と問い返すと、脇谷は笑みを浮かべて答えた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「いいか、{X92}。おまえは、出口付近で千葉と遭遇したら、ビビッてその場を逃げる”演技”をしてくれ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「そしたら、おれがさっそうと登場して、残された理恵さんを救出する。理恵さんはおれが守る、みたいな感じでな」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「こんな役目、おまえしか引き受けてくれねえよ。田村と中野だったらきっと断るだろうからな」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: そんな馬鹿な、と思った。演技とは言え、理恵を１人残し自分だけ逃げ出すというのは、ひどい。あまりにひどすぎる。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: そんなことをすれば理恵に”情けない男”と思われてしまう。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 彼女を放って逃げ出すなど、全くもって本意ではない。断ろうと思った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「頼む。おまえしかいないんだ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 脇谷が頭を下げた。おれは言葉につまった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: ・・・断れなかった。脇谷に対する後ろめたさも手伝って、親友である彼の頼みを受け入れざるをえなかった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: みんなのところに戻ると、さっそく肝試しが行われることになった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: じゃんけんで順番を決めた。最初の組は、おれと理恵だった。偶然にも脇谷・佐倉のペアは２番手だった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: ５分ほど時間をおいて後続のペアが続く決まりだった。脇谷に再度簡単にルールを説明され、墓地の入り口に立った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「理恵さん。気をつけて行って来てください」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「なにかあったら、おれ、必ず助けに行きますから」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「ふふ、ありがと」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 満足そうに微笑むと、脇谷はくるりと背を向けうしろに下がった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「襲われそうになったら大声を出すのよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: それだけ言うと佐倉は脇谷の横に並んだ。意地の悪いことを言う女だ、と思った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「ドキドキするね」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 小声で理恵が言った。おれの方を見て微笑んでいた。彼女も待っていたのだ。おれと２人きりになるこの瞬間を。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: うれしそうな理恵を連れて、おれは墓地の中へと足を踏み入れた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《千葉は命令されたとおり、おどかし役になるために、特殊メイクを始めていた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《脇谷から渡された衣装に着替え、自分の体に血糊を塗り付けていた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA6}（うう、墓場の中で１人でいるのって、こ、こわい・・・）
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《千葉は体を震わせた。体のあちこちが蚊にさされ、ふくれあがっていた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA6}（かゆいし、こわいし・・・やんなっちゃうよ）
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《そうこうしているうちに、ひととおりのメイクが終わった。あとはマスクをかぶるだけだ。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA6}（ええと、ひとまずこれでメイクはＯＫ、と）
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《千葉の頬に蚊が止まった。千葉は手の平でいきおいよく頬を叩いた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《蚊に刺され膨れ上がった顔面を千葉は両手でかいた。手についていた血糊が顔にこびりついた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA6}（まあ、いいや。どうせマスクを被るんだし・・・）
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《千葉は手にしていたビニール袋を見た。中には血糊が半分ほど残っていた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA6}（どうしよう。だいぶあまっちゃった。持っててもしょうがないし・・・）
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《千葉はあたりを見回し人がいない事を確認すると、ビニール袋を持った手を高くかざした。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA6}（あの木がいいな・・・）
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《茂みの中に植えられた木を狙って、千葉はビニール袋を思いきり投げつけた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《狙いどおり木に命中すると、袋が破けて中の血糊がいきおいよく噴き出した。千葉は小踊りしてガッツポーズをとった。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《それと同時に、茂みの中から人影が現れた。千葉は人影に気づくとその場で凍りついた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《千葉はその男に見覚えがあった。神社でぶつかったカップルの男だったのだ。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XB7}「なんじゃ、コラぁ！！」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《血糊まみれになった男が顔をひきつらせて立っていた。奥には半裸の女性の姿があった。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XB7}「また、おまえか！？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《アウトドアのセックスを邪魔された男は、恐ろしい剣幕で千葉のほうへと近づいてきた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA6}（こ、殺されるっ）
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《千葉がじりじりとあとずさった。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《茂みを踏み分けて男が迫ってきた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《男の怒りが頂点に達しているのを感じた千葉は、振り返ると全速力で逃げだした。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XB7}「まて、コラぁ！！」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《茂みを飛び出すと、男は千葉を追って走りだした。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA6}「ぎゃあああっっっ！！」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《狂ったように悲鳴を上げながら、千葉は墓地の中に入っていった。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「！？・・・今、なにか声がした」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵がおれのシャツをつかんで言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: はじめは楽しそうにしていたが、墓地の中を進むにつれて、理恵の顔には不安な表情が浮かんでいた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「なにも聞こえなかったけど」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「本当？・・・でも、叫び声みたいのが・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「空耳だよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「う、うん。そうだよね・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: もうすぐ千葉が待機しているあたりだ。理恵が聞いた声はおそらく千葉の仕業に違いない。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵は不安そうにおれの横にぴたりとくっついていた。千葉の演技もたいしたものだな、と感心した。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 前を見ながら理恵が話しかけてきた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「友達から聞いた話なんだけど・・・この墓地に、ゆ、ゆ、幽霊が出るっていう話、聞いたことある？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「知らない？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「あのね。１０年前の話なんだけど。１人の女性がある男性と同棲していたの」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「ある日、男性がその女性にプロポーズしてきたんだけど、その相手は大酒飲みでよく問題を起こしていたらしいの」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「で、禁酒の約束をすることで彼女は婚約したんだけど、しばらくしてまた飲みはじめてしまったらしいの」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「理由を聞いてもなにも言わないので、彼女は、妹から紹介された真面目な青年と付き合うようになってしまったの」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「彼女の帰りが遅くなったことに男性は疑問を抱くんだけど、仕事が忙しいという彼女の言葉を信じ、なにも聞こうとはしなかった」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「ある日、その男性が、お酒を飲まず珍しく早く部屋に帰ってみると、女性が出迎えてきて、がっかりした顔を見せるの」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「男性は彼女の態度から、他に男が出来たことを察して、ある日、出かけた彼女を尾行することにしたの」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「その日はお祭で、彼女が青年と神社で待ち合わせているところを男性は目撃して、激怒した」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「男性は２人のあとをつけると、ひと気のない墓地の前で、背後から２人を木片で殴り殺してしまったの」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「男性はナイフで彼女の耳をそぎ落として彼女の妹に送りつけた。妹は血相を変えて男性のもとに駆けつけてきた」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「実は妹はその男性を愛していて、姉を引き離すために青年を紹介したの」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「男性は、以前から妹にアプローチされていて、彼女に話すワケにもいかず、それを苦にお酒をはじめてしまったの」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「結局、男性は自首して半年後、牢内で病死し、全ての原因だった妹は姉たちの幻影に脅かされ、この墓地で首の動脈を切って自殺した」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「彼女の身体は血まみれで発見されたらしいわ。飛び散った血で周囲を赤く染めて・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「それからというもの、この墓地にはその妹の報われない魂が、霊となって現れるらしい・・・という話なの」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 話し終わると、理恵は黙っておれの手を強く握った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: よくある作り話だ。１０年前といえば、まだこの神社が移転されてくる前の話だ。理恵はその事実を知らないだけだ。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: つっこみをいれようかと考えたが、しばらくすると、理恵が新たな怪談を語り始めたので、おれは彼女の言葉に黙って耳をかたむけた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: それから２つ目の怪談を聞き終わったころ、墓地の出口付近にたどり着いた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵は、怪談を話しているうちに恐くなってきたらしく、おれの腕に強くしがみついていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「や、柳の木ってどこ？・・・早くおみくじとって帰ろう」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 震える声で言った。彼女のおびえぶりを見て、おれは面白半分に理恵をおどかしてやろう、と考えた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「なにか聞こえる」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「誰かいる」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: おれは近くの茂みを指さした。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵が小さく声を上げた。彼女の顔を見た。目を丸くして何かを見ていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: おそらく千葉だろう。おれと理恵のやりとりを聞いていた千葉が、機を見計らって姿を現したに違いない。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵が口をパクパクさせながら、おれのシャツを引っ張り、見るように促した。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 出来れば見たくなかった。見た瞬間、おれは無様にこの場を逃げ出す演技をしなければならない。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「なにをそんなに驚いて・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: ためらいながら理恵の指さすほうに顔を向けた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: おれはその場に凍りついた。そして目を見張った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 千葉ではなかった。理恵の見たものは、紛れもなく血まみれになった女性の半裸の姿だった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 予期していなかった事態に思考は完全に停止していた。理恵の語った怪談話が思い出され恐怖した。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 半裸の女性が一歩足を踏み出した。おれは理恵の腕をつかむと一目散に逃げだした。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「うっわああああああ～～～～～～っ！！」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: なにも考えられなかった。ただ一刻も早くこの場から離れようと、やみくもに墓地の中へと駆け出していた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《脇谷は、千葉のいるポイントへと急いでいた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《用をたしてくる、と言って真由美と離れ、まんまと１人になることに成功したのだ。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}（待っていてください、理恵さん。おれが守ってみせます）
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《脇谷は、主人公がだらしなく失神している手前、千葉におびえた理恵が自分に抱きすがる図を想像し、１人にやにやしていた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《どこからともなく悲鳴が聞こえてきた。脇谷は、それが{X92}の声だとすぐにわかった。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}（{X92}のやつ、いい演技するじゃねえか。くくく）
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《事態が打ち合わせ通りに進行していることを確信した脇谷は、歩を進めようとした。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}（待てよ。急ぐことはねえ。多少じらしたほうが、ありがたみはわくってもんだ。）
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《脇谷は、はやる気持ちをおさえながら、ゆっくりと出口のほうへと歩いていった。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XB7}「・・・なに、今の声？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XB8}「なんか、お化けに間違われちゃったみたい」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XB7}「ぷっ・・・くくく」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XB8}「似合ってるよ、あんた」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XB7}「そっちもな」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《２人は抱き合いながら、ゆっくりと地面に倒れこんだ。男は血糊で赤く染まった女の乳房を愛撫した。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XB8}「こういうのも悪くないかもね」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XB7}「へへ・・・そうだな」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XB8}「ふふ・・・あっ、ああ・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《女の口から悩ましい声が漏れた。２人は絡み合うように抱き合い、互いを愛撫し始めた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XB8}「あっ・・・はっ、はあっ、はあっ、はああっ・・・！」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「はあっ、はあっ、はあっ・・・！」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「あっ・・・はっ・・・はあっ、はあっ・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: おれと理恵は、墓地の近くの小高い丘にたどり着いていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 全速力で走ったため、理恵もおれも荒い息を吐き続けていた。理恵が涙目になりながら言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「さ、さっきのは・・・いったい・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「分からない・・・。いや、考えたくない・・・そんなこと・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵がおれの胸に飛び込んできた。がたがたと震えている。おれは理恵の肩を強く抱きしめた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: さっき見たものはいったい何だったのか。考えてみたが、思考が混乱し結論は導き出せそうもなかった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: それよりも、まず胸の中でおびえきっている理恵を落ち着かせようと、おれは彼女の腰に手を回し、しっかりと抱きしめた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: しばらくすると落ち着いてきたのか、理恵が顔を上げておれを見た。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「ありがと・・・もう大丈夫だよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: そう言って離れようとしたが、無理をしているのが表情を見て分かった。おれは離さなかった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵が小さく声を上げた。彼女の身体はおれと密着していて、高鳴る心臓の鼓動がおれの胸に伝わってきた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: この鼓動は恐怖によるものではない。理恵は恥ずかしそうに顔を上げ、おれの目を見た。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: ・・・しばらく２人で見つめ合っていた。理恵が目を閉じた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 突然、周囲がまばゆい光に照らされ、理恵が目を開いた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵が辺りを見渡し目を丸くした。おれは空を指さして理恵に言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「花火だよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵が振り返ったのと同時に、２発目の花火が上がった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 花火の方へ駆け寄り、理恵が感嘆の声を上げた。花火の閃光で彼女の身体が鮮明に浮かび上がった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: うっとりとした声で言った。さっきまでの恐怖の体験も、すっかり忘れてしまっているようだった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: さらに３発目の花火が上がった。理恵が無邪気な笑顔で振り返った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「きれいだね。{X92}くん」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: おれに向かってうれしそうに微笑した。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 考えてみれば、彼女はおれと２人きりで花火を見るのが望みだった。いま、その望みが叶ったのだ。彼女の喜びも当然だった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: だが、おれは花火に照らされる理恵に目を奪われていた。彼女の声に答えた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「ああ、きれいだ・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵はおれの視線に気づいた。無言で彼女のそばに歩み寄ると、彼女の頬に手を添えた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 恥ずかしそうに顔を赤らめると、理恵は首を傾けておれの手に頬ずりした。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: おれはやさしく理恵にキスをした。はじめはやさしく、そして次第に強くしていった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵はおれの首に手を回し、それに応じた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: おれは無我夢中で彼女を抱きしめた。そして、より激しく理恵の唇を吸った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「こ、こんなとこ・・・誰かに見られたら大変だよ・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵が耳元でささやいた。だが、彼女の切なげな声は、よりいっそうおれの興奮を高めるだけだった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}（・・・あれ、おかしいな。・・・誰もいねえじゃねえかよ）
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《脇谷は辺りを見渡した。だが、{X92}も理恵も、千葉の姿すらも見あたらない。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}（おいおい、どうなってんだよ、こりゃ・・・）
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}（あの男に理恵をまかせたのが、そもそもの間違いだったわ）

strings.jp: {X9A}（・・・確か、この近くに丘に上がる階段があったハズ・・・）

strings.jp: {X9A}（・・・あったわ）
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《真由美は、階段を上がろうと足を踏み出した。そして、落ちている物体に気づいて手にとった。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「うっきゃあああああああっ！！」

strings.jp: なんとか間に合った。誰が来たのだろうと待ちかまえてみたが、誰も来る気配はなかった。

strings.jp: {X97}「・・・おかしいね」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵が小さく声を上げた。だが、すぐにそれが千葉だと気付き、胸をなで下ろした。

strings.jp: {XA6}「声をかけようと後ろから肩をたたいたら、大きな声で叫んでそのまま倒れちゃったんだ。もう、どうしようかと・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 千葉は小さくため息を吐くと眉をしかめて言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA6}「でも、どうして気絶したんだか・・・衣装は脱いだのに・・・ぼくってそんなに恐い？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: おれは千葉に言ってやった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「千葉。おまえ、顔に血糊ついてるぞ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 千葉はハッとして両手で顔を押さえた。手の平に血糊がついているのを確認して納得したように言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA6}「そうか。佐倉さんはそれで気絶したのか。よかった。ぼくは、気絶するほど佐倉さんに嫌われていたのかって不安だったんだ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 千葉は安堵し、胸をなで下ろした。無邪気な男だな、と思った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「とにかく戻ろう。みんなきっと心配してるから」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: おれは理恵の意見に従うと、佐倉を背負って、集合場所である墓地の入り口へと向かった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 無事、脇谷たちと合流したおれたちは、場所を夜店通りにうつしていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: みんなは佐倉が気絶した顛末を聞いて笑っていた。真由美は眉をひそめてそっぽを向いていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA6}「佐倉さん、ごめんなさい。ぼくがもっと気を付けていれば・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 千葉が佐倉に頭を下げた。佐倉は千葉をにらみつけると怒りを爆発させた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「あたりまえよ。だいたい、あなた。背後から声もかけずにいきなり肩を叩くなんて、誰だって驚くにきまってるでしょう？！」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA6}「ごめんなさい」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「謝ってすんでありがたいと思うことだわ。これが、見知らぬ他人だったら訴えてやるところよ！」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 佐倉は激しく千葉を罵った。千葉はひたすら頭を下げ続けていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 脇谷がやってきて、千葉をこずいた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「そう、おまえが全部悪いんだ。おかげで肝試しはメチャクチャ。おれの計画もおしゃかだ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA6}「計画って・・・？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 千葉が無垢な眼差しで見た。脇谷は言葉に詰まって千葉を押さえつけた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「とにかく、おまえが決められたとおり動かねぇから、こんな目に合うんだ。おまえにも同じ思いを味合わせてやる」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 脇谷は千葉の頭をこぶしで押さえつけた。”うめぼし”の刑だった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: ２人のやりとりに、皆がいっせいに笑った。理恵も笑った。佐倉だけがむすっとしていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵と視線があった。彼女はやさしく微笑んでおれを見ていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵がとなりに来て、皆に気付かれないように手を握ってきた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 脇谷が千葉にヘッドロックをかましているのが見えた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: おれは微笑する理恵を見つめながら、彼女の手をやさしく握りかえした。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 夏休みが終わり、新学期に入って最初のホームルーム。議題は体育祭。種目ごとのメンバーの割り振りが行われていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: おれたちは、そうした進行を半ば無視するかっこうで、世間話、特に夏休み後に様子が急変した女の子たちの話題に夢中になっていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA5}「田村、見た？伊藤さんのカッコ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA4}「いいや。なんで？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA5}「なんか、あいつさぁ、すんごいことになってきてんよ。化粧とか」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「地味な女だったのによぉ。別人だな、ありゃ。親はなんにも言わねぇのかよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 伊藤という女の子を見た。脱色した髪、ピアス、ぎこちない感じの化粧。全身で休み前とは違った自己を主張している。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「ありゃ、なんかあったな、間違いないねぇ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA5}「やったんだろ。一夏の経験というやつ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA4}「海でナンパされたんだよ、きっと。そのまま勢いで車の中で」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「ストレートだな」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA5}「ふんと、女ってばラクだと思わん？露出度高いかっこでフラフラしてりゃ、勝手に男がよってくんだかんよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA4}「男だってラクだろ？お金持って風俗に行くだけだもん」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA5}「そりゃそうだけどさ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「だけどよぉ、なんでやっただけで人格まで変わるんだよ？そんなに人生変えるほどのものかよ？やるってことがよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA5}「少女は、今、女へと変わるって感じ？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA4}「どうでもいいけどね、べつに。ところで、決めなくていいの、体育祭の出場種目？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: クラス委員が、出場する種目の希望をつのり、決定した種目の参加者の名前を黒板に書きこんでいた。人気のあるものはすでに埋まっていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「脇谷、決めないのか？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「ああ？ほっとけ、ほっとけ。運動部の連中にとっちゃ、年に１度の晴れ舞台だろ？奴らに勝手に張り切らせときゃいいんだよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「でも、長距離走なんかやりたくないだろ？はやく決めないと、そんなのしかなくなるぜ？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「む。それもそうだな。どうだ、玉入れなんかよ？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「悪くないな。だけど、もう決まっちゃったよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「なに？はええな。じゃあ、綱引きは？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「締め切った」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「障害物競争なんて、どうだ？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「目立ちたいのか？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「いや。・・・待てよ、もし、みっともねぇ姿をさらして、理恵さんに見られちまったら・・・。だめだ。それはまずいぜ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA4}「個人より集団競技のほうがいいんじゃないかな。そういう視点で考えると」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: しばらく考えていると、藤田という男がやって来て、言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA7}「{X90}くん、まだ種目決めてないんだろう？ミニサッカーに出ないか？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 笑みをたやさない感じのいい男で、サッカー部員だということは知っていた。話したことはほとんどなかった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 彼はミニサッカーに出場したいのだが、メンバーが揃わないのだ、と説明した。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA7}「フットサルみたいなもんなんだ。１チーム５人。ルールはちょっと違って、キックインじゃない。ゴールはハンドボールで使うやつだって」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA7}「出てみないか？脇谷くんもどう？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「どうすんだ、{X92}？おれは、べつに構わないぜ？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: サッカーと聞いて、躊躇した。中学を卒業してから、もう２度とサッカーにとりくむつもりはなかった。あまりいい思い出ではない。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 迷っていると、藤田が微笑しながら、言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA7}「頼むよ、{X90}くん。ほかに出たい種目もないんだろう？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 彼の軽い口調を聞いて、自分は身構えすぎていたのかもしれない、と思った。これは体育祭の競技で、ただの遊びにすぎない。ＯＫした。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA7}「ありがとう、{X90}くん。脇谷くんは？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「ああ。出るよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA7}「じゃあ、あと２人だな。中野くん、田村くん、どう？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA5}「いいんでねぇの、別に。サッカー嫌いじゃねぇしね」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA4}「そういうことなら、ぼくも参加しないわけにはいかないね」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA7}「よし、決まった」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 藤田はうれしそうに黒板の前にいるクラス委員長のところへ歩いていった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「ミニサッカーか。{X92}、おまえ活躍できそうじゃねぇかよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「遊びだろう？そんなに一生懸命やるつもりはないよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「とかいってよぉ、いいとこ見せたいんじゃねぇのか？へへへ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 藤田が戻ってきて、決定した、と教えてくれた。脇谷が、またおれをからかいだした。あまり気分のいいものではなかった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: なにげなく壁ぎわを見た。千葉が机に屈みこんで、なにか熱心にノートに書きつけていた。声をかけた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「千葉、なんに出るのか決めた？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 不意に声をかけられて、びくっと体を震わせた。ノートを抱えるようにして隠した。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 怯えたような目でおれを見た。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「見たって、そのノートのこと？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA6}「ぼくが”彩波”描いてるの見てたんだろう？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 見ていない、と答えたが、信用しようとしなかった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA6}「ぼくは見られることが嫌なんじゃないんだ。ただ、黙って見られるのが、嫌なんだ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 訴えるような口調で言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA6}「{X92}くんも、”彩波”が好きなのかい？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「なんだ、彩波って？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA6}「{X92}くん、彩波も知らないの！？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 信じられないという表情でおれを見た。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA6}「いいかい？彩波っていうのは・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 長い話になりそうな予感がしたので、遮って話題を変えた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「それより、体育祭だよ。種目決めないのか？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA6}「いいよ。そんなのなんだって・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 虚ろな表情で言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA6}「どうせ、ぼく出ないから」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「つまり、休むってこと？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA6}「そうだよ・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 消え入りそうな声で言った。千葉は体育というものを嫌っているのだ。彼が体育の授業で笑われてばかりなのを考えれば、それも無理はないな、と思った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA6}「{X92}くん、間違ってると思わないか？体力で人間の優劣を決めるなんて」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA6}「ぼくはみんなに笑いものにされるんだ。ただ運動が苦手だ、っていうだけで。体育祭なんて、この世からなくなればいいんだ・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 沈みこんだ千葉を見て、話しかけたのは失敗だったな、と思った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 廊下の壁にもたれかかっていると、職員室のドアが開いて、脇谷がいまいましそうな顔で出てきた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「おう、待たせたな」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 不機嫌そうに、たった今終わったばかりの教師とのやりとりについて話しだした。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「ぐだぐだと２０分近くも話しやがって・・・。おまえは何て答えたんだ？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「専門学校に行くとか、適当に言っておいたよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「そうか。おれもそんなこと言っておいたらよかったぜ。くそ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: ホームルームの後、おれと脇谷は職員室に呼び出された。進路についての話だった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: おれと脇谷は、クラスでもまれな進路を決定していない人間だった。担任の教師が気をもんで、おれたち２人を呼び出すことがあり、そのたびに落胆を繰り返していた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「おまえは家業を継ぐのかって言われたからよ、違うって言ったんだよ。そしたらよ、なんで進路を決めようとしないんだって、大きな声で言われてよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「おれは、まだ、これだってことが見つからないんです、って言ったよ。そしたら、あの野郎なんて言ったと思う？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「世の中を甘くみるな、だとよ。おまえも言われたか？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「似たようなことは」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「余計なお世話だってんだよ。おれの人生じゃねぇか。いちいち他人に口出しされたくねぇよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「それによ、そんなに安直に決められることじゃねぇだろう。なぁ？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: うなずいたが、教師の言うことも理解できた。おれ自身、進路を決めようとしないのは、迷っているからではなく、単に決めたくないだけなのではないだろうか。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: だが、卒業したら？いやでも決めないわけにはいかない。そして、それは、そんなに先のことではない。わずか半年後のことだ。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 憂さ晴しに担任の外見面での欠陥について話しながら歩いていると、２年の教室の前にさしかかった。教室に女の子の人だかりができていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 女の子はさかんになにか話しながら、教室の中を見ていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「なんだ、ありゃ？誰か死んだのか？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 興味をかきたてられて、脇谷は女の子たちの背中ごしに中を覗いた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「なにか見えるか？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「なんか女の子に取り囲まれてる奴がいるな。今日はバレンタイン・デーじゃねぇよな」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: よく見えるように数歩動いた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「男だ。なんかアイドルみてぇな奴だ。にやにやしてんぜ。へ。ふぬけた面だぜ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 集まっている女の子の層は幅広く、１年生から３年生までいろいろなクラスからやってきていた。それぞれが数人のグループで見物していた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「しかしよ、妙だと思わねぇか？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「だってよ、前にこんな光景を見たことなかったろう？それが、急にこんなことになってるんだからよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 言われてみれば、そのとおりだった。女の子が詰めかけるほど人気のある男子の話など聞いたことがない。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「あいつ、前からいたのかなぁ。{X92}、知ってるか？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 不意に横から佐倉の声がした。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「川久保宏くんよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「川久保ぉ？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「２学期から転校してきたのよ。あなたたちは知らないでしょうけど、女の子の間ではもう有名人よ、彼」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「ふうん。転校生か」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「佐倉さんは、ここで何してるの？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「もちろん川久保くんを見に来たのよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 年下の男の子を見物しにくるというのは、彼女には不似合いな気がした。驚いて彼女を見ていると、視線に気がついて言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「あら、私だってかわいい男の子は好きよ。何かおかしい？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9C}「わぁ。慎悟くんみたい。かっこいいねぇ。足ながーい。背も１８０以上あるよぉ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 佐倉と一緒に見物に来ていたともみが見とれていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「へっ。あんな奴、どこがいいんだか」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「ひがみは見苦しいわよ。素直に認めることができないの？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 脇谷がおもしろくなさそうに川久保を見た。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「彼、人気が出て当然ね。知ってる？ファンクラブつくろうって言ってる子たちもいるのよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 意地の悪い笑みを浮かべて、脇谷を見た。脇谷は、なにか言いたそうにしていたが、黙っていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: おれも興味をそそられて川久保を見た。ハンサムだが気取ったところがまるでなく、陽気そのものだった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 彼の人懐っこい笑顔を見て、女の子たちが夢中になる理由がわかった気がした。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 手の届かない存在ではなく、かといって、どこにでもいるような男の子でもない。ちょうどギリギリ手が届きそうに思えるところが人気の秘密なのかもしれない。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 彼が、まわりの女の子たちに何か言って、席を立ち上がるのが見えた。女の子たちは彼と一緒に歩きだし、やがて、教室を出ようとした。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XB2}「ねぇ、これから部活なんだよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 困ったように女の子たちに言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XBC}「見たいの。見ちゃだめ？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XBC}「私も見たいー」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XB2}「そんな面白いもんじゃないよ？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XBC}「えー、そんなことないー」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 川久保が廊下を歩いていくと、女の子がぞろぞろとついていった。入り口に立っていた女の子たちも、後に続いた。取材陣を引きつれた芸能人そのものだった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 脇谷が不快そうにその様子を見つめていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「あんな奴が同じクラスにいたら、どうする？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「おれだったら、きっと、いじめるぜ・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 少しの間、脇谷は川久保の背中を眺めていた。突然、愉快そうな表情になって言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「あいつ、部活とか言ってたな」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「ちょっと見物してみねぇか？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「だってよ、{X92}、あいつ、ルックスはまぁまぁかもしんねぇけどよ。運動はどうなんだ？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「わからないな」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「あいつ、見に来て欲しくなさそうだったじゃねぇか。ということはだ、きっと下手だぜ。へへへ。あんなに人気があってもスポーツは下手。けっさくじゃねぇかよ」
