strings.jp: そして４月から大学を休学することもわかっている、と思った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: やがて、日が暮れて、さらに夜になった。理恵の門限を考えると、そろそろ帰らなければならない。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: しかし、お互い”帰ろう”という言葉を恐れているかのように、黙っていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: ７時になると、これ以上デートを引き伸ばすのは無理だ、と感じた。立ち上がって、帰ろう、と言うと、理恵が無言でうなずいた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 駅へ向かっている間、理恵はずっとうつむいていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「どうしてうまくいかなかったんだろうね・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 佐倉が中心となった理恵の父親のクライアントを変える作戦のことを言っているのだ、とわかるまで１秒とかからなかった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 佐倉の計画は成功した。しかし、その結果が無意味だと誰が予想できただろう。理恵のお父さんのクライアントは変更されたが、仕事の内容は同じだった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: どうして同じ仕事内容でフリーの編集者と契約することになったのか、理恵にも佐倉にもわからなかった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「わからない」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 力なく言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「あの占いのとおりになる運命だったのかな・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 静かな声で言った。口調に、悲しみというよりは、あきらめが表れていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 違う、と言いたかった。しかし、そう言ったからといって何になるのだ。もはやどうすることもできない。理恵はオーストラリアに行く。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: お互い何も話さないまま、帰りの電車に乗った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 自分たちの降りる駅に着くまで、１時間もかからなかった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 駅のホームに降り立つと、後は徒歩でお互いの家へ歩くだけだ。それには２０分もかからない。おれは理恵といる時間を少しでも引き伸ばしたかった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「理恵、もうちょっと、ここにいないか？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 彼女がうなずき、２人でホームのベンチに座った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 風が冷たかった。このところ、日が落ちると、急に温度が下がるようになった。まもなく冬がやってくる。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 目の前を、どこかで休日を過ごした家族連れや、スポーツバッグを持った学生の集団、２０くらいのカップルといった人たちが通り過ぎていった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: おれと理恵は、お互いの手を握り、人々が歩くのを眺めていた。そのうちに理恵が言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「ねぇ・・・、私がオーストラリアに行ったら、電話してくれる？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: もちろんだ、と答えた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「週に１回は電話で話そうね。電話代が高いから、２人でかわりばんこにかけあおう？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: うなずいて言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「それに、手紙も」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 次の電車がホームに停車して、乗客を吐き出すと、走り去っていった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「卒業したら、旅費を貯めて、オーストラリアまで会いに行くよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵が微笑んでおれを見た。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「うん。待ってるよ・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 彼女の無気力な言い方から、今の時点では、おれがオーストラリアにやって来るのは、いつになるかもわからない遠い先のことだ、と思っているのは明らかだった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 実際、そうなのかもしれない。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「必ず行く」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 電車がホームに入ってきた。２人で降りてくる乗客を見ていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 寒さのために理恵がかすかに震えた。理恵が体をすりよせた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: これまで、おれにとって、理恵はあまりに身近な存在であり、ごく自然に彼女に電話をし、週末を彼女と過ごしていた。それは習慣であり、日常だった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 脇谷に頼まれて、理恵を遊園地に誘うために、偶然を装って公園で会った時のことについて考えた。彼女と海にいった時のこと、体育祭の時のことについて考えた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: おれは理恵を愛している。彼女なしの生活について考えてみたことはなく、そんな時が来ると本気で思ったこともない。彼女の声。笑顔。それらを見ることができなくなる。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 彼女は、１年間、オーストラリアで暮らす。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「オーストラリアに行ったら、私、毎日寝る前に必ず{X92}くんのこと考えるよ。だから、{X92}くんも、私のことを考えて」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「そうするよ。でも、時差を考えないと、すれ違ってしまうんじゃないかな？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「大丈夫。オーストラリアと日本は時差はほとんどないから」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「正確に同じ時間にしよう。完全な時差を調べておくよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵が笑った。おれもつられて笑った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵の笑い声が聞き取れないほど小さくなった。うつむいたまま、小さく肩を震わせていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 不意に顔をあげると、声をつまらせて言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「{X92}くん、私、やっぱり、・・・{X92}くんと離れたくない・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 瞳が涙で光っていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: おれは何も言うことができずに、彼女を見つめた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: こういう時、自分は何と言葉をかければいいのだろう。何もしてやれないことがわかっていながら。おれは無力だった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 警笛が鳴って、また次の電車が入ってきた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵が立ち上がって言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: おれはうなずいて立ち上がった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 突然、自分の無力さに対する怒りがこみあげてきた。本当に自分にはどうすることもできないのか？ただ黙って彼女を見送ることしかできないのか？
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 冗談ではない。このまま理恵を行かせてたまるか、と思った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: おれは彼女の手を掴んで言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 彼女の手を引いて、入ってきた電車に乗った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「理恵、どこか・・・、２人でどこかに行かないか？どこかほかの場所で２人で暮らさないか？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「学校は辞めればいい。おれは働くよ。おれと同い年で働いているやつなんていくらでもいる。大丈夫。きっと、やっていける」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵は驚きのあまり目を丸くして突っ立っていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「２人で、どこかで暮らそう。いっしょに新しい生活を始めよう」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「理恵の両親には心配をかけることになるけど、それは、いつか説明すればいい。きっと、わかってもらえるよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「理恵、お願いだ。おれといっしょに来てくれ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 祈るような気持ちで言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵は何も言わずに、おれの肩に頭をのせた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: おれは彼女をやさしく抱いた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 発車を告げるベルが鳴り、ドアが閉まった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 電車に乗ったが、どこにも行くあてがなかった。数時間、電車が終点から終点へと往復を繰り返す間、おれと理恵はぼんやりと椅子に腰かけていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 乗客が、家族連れやサラリーマンから、酔っ払って寝ている中年男性やどこかで遊んできたカップルへと変わり、車内の人数が減っていった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 電車が終点に着いた。車内のアナウンスでこれが終電車だとわかった。ドアが開き、乗客が降りた。車内を車掌が点検してまわっていた。酔っ払いの肩をゆすっていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「降りよう」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵の手を引いて、ホームへ出た。もう始発まで電車がない。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「どこかに泊まろう」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: ホームを歩きながら、所持金を調べた。４千円しかなかった。これでは、ホテルに泊まることはできそうもない。沈んだ気分で理恵にそのことを話した。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「私、６千円持ってるから、出しあえば泊まれるよ？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 確かに泊まることはできる。だが、その後はどうするのだ？残った金額でどうやって過ごせばいい？
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「理恵・・・、それじゃあ泊まった後にお金が残らない」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「それなら、私、べつにどこでもいいよ。駅で寝てもいい。{X92}くんといっしょなら、どこでもいいよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵がゆっくりと言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: おれは、強引に理恵を連れ出しても、自分には何もできないのだ、と思い知らされないわけにはいかなかった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 人生が宙に浮いているような気がした。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: ２人でベンチに座り、途方に暮れていると、目の前で女性が立ち止まった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XB0}「理恵ちゃん・・・？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵が顔をあげて女性を見た。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XB0}「どうしたの、理恵ちゃん？もう終電終わっちゃったわよ？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: わが目を疑うような表情で、理恵とおれを見ていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XB0}「それも、こんなところで。これからどうするの？お父さんは知ってるの、理恵ちゃんがここにいること？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵が口をつぐんでいた。おれも黙っていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XB0}「彼氏も・・・、こんなところにいて何をしているの？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「べつに何も・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 実際、何もできないでいて、座っているのだ。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 岡さんは、理恵とおれの様子から、何かトラブルのようなものを感じ取って、思案していた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XB0}「ね、ここは寒いわ。私の家にいらっしゃい。行くところもないんでしょう？電車もなくなっちゃったし」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 躊躇していると、理恵の手を掴んで立たせた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XB0}「冷たい・・・。もう少ししたら駅も閉まっちゃうわよ。ほら、彼氏も」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵が困ったような表情でおれを見た。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: ここで断ったら、一晩中、理恵に寒い思いをさせることになる。気がすすまなかったが、立ち上がった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XB0}「それでいいわ。行きましょう。私のマンション、歩いて１５分だから。着いたら、温かいものでも作ってあげるわ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 岡さんは、自分の部屋におれたちを入れると、すぐに理恵の家に電話した。理恵が心配そうに岡さんが話すのを聞いていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XB0}「ええ、ええ。はい。・・・そうなんです。すいません、連絡が遅れてしまって。はい」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XB0}「・・・理恵ちゃんはもう寝てしまいました。１日ドライブに付き合わせてしまったので、疲れちゃったみたいで」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XB0}「ほんとにご心配をおかけして、すいません。もっと早く電話しようと思っていたんですが、携帯を会社に忘れてしまって・・・はい」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 岡さんの受け答えから、理恵の両親が相当に心配していたことがわかった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XB0}「ええ。明日の朝、ここから直接学校に行ってもらいますので・・・。はい。それでは・・・。夜分遅く申し訳ありませんでした。はい。失礼します」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 電話を切ると、ふうっとため息をついて、理恵を見た。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XB0}「お父さん出かけられてるみたいで、お母さんにお話したわ。ずいぶん心配されていたわよ。理恵ちゃんのお友だちにも電話されてたみたい」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 岡さんは、その場で今日１日理恵とドライブしていたという話を考え出して、巧みに理恵の母親に信用させることに成功した。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「ごめんなさい・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵が沈んだ表情でうつむいた。両親を心配させてしまったことにショックを受けていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XB0}「ううん。責めてるんじゃないの。理恵ちゃんも、理由があってのことだと思うし」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XB0}「私も高校生の頃、無断外泊をしたことがあるの。その時は、親がカンカンになって、３カ月外出を許してもらえなくなったわ。理恵ちゃんがそうなったら気の毒だから」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: そう言って笑った。理恵を元気づけようとし、気遣っているのがわかった。湯が沸いて、ヤカンが音をたてた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XB0}「でも、びっくりしたわよ・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: カップに湯を注ぎながら言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XB0}「今、ちょうど年末進行でしょ？だから、日曜だけど会社に行って、終電で帰ってきたところだったのよ。そしたら、ホームに理恵ちゃんがいるんだもの」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XB0}「こんなはずれの駅だから、遊びに来たわけじゃなさそうだし、２人とも何か思いつめたような顔をしてたから、これはなにかあったんだなって思って・・・。さ、コーヒーよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: マグカップを理恵とおれに手渡した。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XB0}「飲みなさい。あったまるわよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵とおれがコーヒーによって冷えた体に温かみを取り戻すのを待って、岡さんが言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XB0}「駅で見たあなたたち、まるで、駆け落ちしようとするカップルみたいだったわ・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: おれは、はっとして岡さんを見た。おれの表情から、岡さんは、その印象が的外れなものではないことを理解したようだった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XB0}「そうなの・・・？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 困惑しておれを見た。おれは視線をそらした。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: おれと理恵がほとんど何もしゃべろうとしないので、岡さんは困ったようにため息をついた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XB0}「ね、理恵ちゃん、私を信用してもらえないかな？きっと、何か考えてあげられると思うの。話してくれない？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: おれのほうに向き直って言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XB0}「彼氏も。このままじゃ、よくないと思うの。理恵ちゃんにとって」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 彼女の言うとおりであることを認めないわけにはいかなかった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XB0}「さ、話して・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: それからしばらくして、非常な努力によって、岡さんは理恵の口を開かせた。理恵が話しだすと、おれも口を開かざるをえなかった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 岡さんに、理恵のお父さんが帰って来た時のことから話し始めた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: オーストラリア行きを知ったこと、佐倉が岡さんへ会いにいったこと、パソコン通信を使ってフリーの編集者に接触したこと、それが岡さんの編集部にいた高市という女性だったことを話した。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 岡さんは時おり質問をはさみながら、話を聞いていた。特に、佐倉が情報収集のために編集部に入りこんでいたということを聞くと、信じられないという表情で絶句していた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: すべてを聞くと、岡さんは、少しの間、真剣な表情になって考えこんでいた。やがて、思いやりに満ちた笑みをうかべ、言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XB0}「大丈夫。何も心配しなくていいわ。私がなんとかしてあげる」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 驚いて岡さんを見た。優しい表情の中に自信が感じられた。気休めではなく、なにかできる確信があるのだ。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XB0}「理恵ちゃんがオーストラリアに行かなければ、いいんでしょう？まかせておいて」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵とおれが同時にうなずいた。理恵がすがるような目で岡さんを見た。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「岡さん、ほんとう・・・？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 岡さんはにっこり笑ってうなずいた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XB0}「だから、心配しないで、明日はお家に帰りなさい。さ、そろそろ寝ましょう？私、もう眠くて死にそうなのよ・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 大きくあくびをした。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 岡さんが明かりを消し、横になったが、おれも理恵も緊張のために眠ることができなかった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《水曜日の午前中。高市は”ＥＱ”編集部を訪問した。理恵の父親との企画について、編集長に会うために来ていた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAA}「おはようございます、浜松さん」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《編集長は、高市を見ると、ついてくるように言って、先に立って歩きだした。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAA}「浜松さん、どこへ行くんです？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X83}【浜松編集長】{X82}「会議室だよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《２人は、廊下を横ぎり、会議室のドアを開けた。会議室の中には、すでに２人の人間が座っていた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAA}「え？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X83}【浜松編集長】{X82}「この人たちを知っているね？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《編集長が部屋の中にいる人間を手で示して言った。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《もちろん、高市は２人を知っていた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XB0}「おはよう、高市さん。元気でやってる？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《岡と河合和正が軽く会釈した。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAA}「ちょっと、浜松さん、これは、どういう・・・？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《高市がしどろもどろになって言った。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X83}【浜松編集長】{X82}「岡くんから、私のところに河合さんのことで連絡があってね。そのことで、河合さんにも連絡をとったら、全員で話しあうのがベストだろうということになった」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《編集長が高市を見て言った。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X83}【浜松編集長】{X82}「私は、きみから、河合さんが岡さんとの仕事をする気がなく、きみと仕事をしたいという申し出があって、その話を信じた」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X83}【浜松編集長】{X82}「だから、きみの持ちこんだ河合さんの仕事にゴーを出した」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X83}【浜松編集長】{X82}「高市くん、きみが私に言った話は本当かね？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAA}「本当です」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA3}「それは違う・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《和正が口をはさもうとしたが、浜松編集長が制止するように手を振った。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X83}【浜松編集長】{X82}「次に、高市くん、きみはこの件については、河合さんの要望であって、きみはそれに応えたのだ、と言ったね？トラブルの心配はない、と？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAA}「はい」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《編集長は向き直って、和正を見て言った。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X83}【浜松編集長】{X82}「では、河合さん、あなたは、どうして岡くんとの仕事を蹴って、高市くんと仕事をしたい、と思ったのですか？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA3}「それは、まず最初に岡さんから電話があって、留守電に、結婚退職するというメッセージが入っていて・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X83}【浜松編集長】{X82}「ちょっと待ってください。岡くん、河合さんにそんな電話をしたのか？それに、そもそも、きみは結婚退職をしたの？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XB0}「電話はしていませんし、結婚する予定もありません。だから、退職する予定もありません」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X83}【浜松編集長】{X82}「不思議な話だ・・・。すいません、河合さん、続けてください」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA3}「それで、私は、電話で、新しい編集者の人が仕事を引き継ぐと聞いて、打ち合わせに行くことになりました」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X83}【浜松編集長】{X82}「岡くんが退職すると聞いて、自分から仕事先を探しましたか？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA3}「いいえ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X83}【浜松編集長】{X82}「高市くん、きみはどうやって河合さんからコンタクトを受けたの？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《今度は高市を見て言った。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAA}「それは、ニセティ、・・・パソコン通信の掲示板で、河合さんが仕事を探していると書かれているのを見て・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《編集長が遮って和正に言った。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X83}【浜松編集長】{X82}「河合さん、あなたはパソコン通信で、仕事を探しましたか？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《和正が首を振った。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA3}「私はパソコンは持っていない。使ったこともない」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAA}「でも、秘書の方が・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA3}「私に秘書はいない」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《編集長が頭をかいた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X83}【浜松編集長】{X82}「また不思議なこともあったもんだ・・・。いないはずの秘書がパソコン通信で、河合さんが頼んでもいないのに、仕事を探した・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《高市ははっきりと狼狽して編集長を見た。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAA}「浜松さん、これは、なにかの間違いです」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X83}【浜松編集長】{X82}「そう。間違いとしか言いようがないね」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《微笑して言った。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X83}【浜松編集長】{X82}「河合さん、喫茶店で高市くんに会って、どうして契約することにしたんですか？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA3}「それは、電話で高市さんが岡さんの仕事を引き継ぐと聞いていたからです」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X83}【浜松編集長】{X82}「では、もし岡くんが結婚退職した、という話を聞かなかったら、高市くんと仕事をする契約をしましたか？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X83}【浜松編集長】{X82}「岡くんと契約した？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA3}「はい。岡さんとは付き合いも長いし、いつも楽しく仕事をさせてもらっている。今後も岡さんと仕事を続けたいと思っています」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《浜松編集長が腕組みした。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X83}【浜松編集長】{X82}「河合さん、それでは、岡くんが結婚退職しない、ということを知った今では、岡くんと仕事がしたいんですか？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA3}「はい」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X83}【浜松編集長】{X82}「岡くん、きみは、河合さんと仕事を続けたい？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XB0}「もちろんですわ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X83}【浜松編集長】{X82}「そうなると、・・・きみの話はいささか不自然だな、高市くん」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAA}「でも、確かに・・・、私は・・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X83}【浜松編集長】{X82}「私は、こう結論せざるをえない。きみが河合さんを騙して、強引に契約させ、岡くんのところから仕事を横取りした」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAA}「違います！」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X83}【浜松編集長】{X82}「証明できるかね？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAA}「パソコン通信のログ、・・・記録があります」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X83}【浜松編集長】{X82}「河合さんの秘書が書いたというメールのことかね？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAA}「そうです」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X83}【浜松編集長】{X82}「しかし、河合さんには秘書などいない。そんなものは証拠にはならないよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《高市は目を丸くしたまま、呆然として突っ立っていた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X83}【浜松編集長】{X82}「いいかい、高市くん・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《首を振りながら言った。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X83}【浜松編集長】{X82}「フェアな競争なら大いにやるが、だまし討ちはいけないよ。引き抜きがいけない、と言っているのではないよ。ただ今回のきみのやり方は、詐欺のようなものだ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAA}「違い・・・ます・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X83}【浜松編集長】{X82}「きみの話と河合さんの話はあまりにも噛み合っていない。これをどう説明するね？しかも、河合さんは岡くんと仕事がしたい、と言っているのに、だ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X83}【浜松編集長】{X82}「私だって、引き抜きをやったことはあるよ。だけどね、引き抜く相手を騙したことはない」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X83}【浜松編集長】{X82}「そんなことをしたら、信頼関係もなにもなくなってしまう。仕事どころではなくなってしまうよ。私はそんな状態でする仕事がいいものになるとは思えない」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X83}【浜松編集長】{X82}「いったんはゴーを出したが、・・・高市くん、今回の河合さんとの仕事の件は、たった今、白紙にさせてもらう。契約は無効だ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《高市が震えだした。今にもヒステリーを起こしそうになっていた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAA}「そんな。・・・おかしい。こんなのって。そうか・・・、あなたがた、グルでしょ？私を陥れようとして・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X83}【浜松編集長】{X82}「なんとでも言いたまえ。とにかく、この件はこれで終わりだ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《高市の顔がひきつった。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAA}「おまえら、訴えてやる！」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X83}【浜松編集長】{X82}「どうぞ、ご自由に」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《高市はドアを叩きつけるように閉めると、足早に歩き去った。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《編集長が笑い、岡と和正もつられて笑った。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XB0}「浜松さん、どうもすみません。ご迷惑をおかけしてしまって・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《岡が頭をさげた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X83}【浜松編集長】{X82}「かまわないよ。かわいい後輩のためだからな。河合さんも、今回は災難でしたね」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA3}「まだキツネにつままれたみたいですよ・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《和正が苦笑した。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X83}【浜松編集長】{X82}「ま、なんにせよ、これで一件落着ですね。どうです？これから昼メシでも？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《夜。和正から、オーストラリアの仕事はなくなり、日本で仕事することになった、というニュースを聞くと、理恵は飛び上がって喜んだ。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「お父さん、それ、ほんとうなの！？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA3}「うん。また、岡さんと仕事をすることになって、・・・あの結婚退職するって話はイタズラだったみたいでね、それで今度の仕事は岡さんの意向で、国内に変更になったんだよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《岡が約束を守ったことを知って、理恵は顔をほころばせた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「よかったぁ・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《和正が顔を曇らせた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA3}「本当はオーストラリアに行きたくなかったのか？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《理恵が遠慮がちにうなずいた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA3}「父さんといっしょに暮らしたくなかったのか？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《和正は気の毒なくらい弱々しい表情になった。理恵がびっくりして言った。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「違うよ。お父さんとは、いっしょにいたいよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA3}「それなら、どうしてオーストラリアに行きたくなかったんだい？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「それは、・・・友だちと別れたくなかったから」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《少し間をおいて、和正が恐る恐るという感じで言った。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA3}「この前うちに来ていた、何といったかな・・・、{X90}くん、と？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《理恵が恥ずかしそうに小さくうなずいた。和正は、絶望したような表情になって、理恵の部屋から頼りない足取りで出ていった。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《美奈代は、和正ががっくりと肩を落としてテーブルに座ったのを見て、びっくりしていた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《和正が声をつまらせて言った。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9E}「理恵が、どうかしたの？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《美奈代は和正を気遣って、横に座り、背中を撫でてやった。和正がちらっと美奈代を見た。優しく微笑んでいる美奈代の顔を見ると、肩を震わせて言った。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA3}「理恵に、彼氏が・・・。理恵はオーストラリアに行きたくなかったんだ。彼氏と離れたくなかったから・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《涙ぐんでいた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA3}「り、理恵は・・・、まだ１８なのに・・・。彼氏が・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《和正は美奈代の胸に抱きついて泣いた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《美奈代は困ったように微笑して、和正をそっと抱きしめた。。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9E}「べつに、いても不思議じゃないでしょ？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《和正が訴えるような目で言った。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA3}「まだ早すぎる・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9E}「そんなことはないわ。だって、あなたが私にプロポーズした時、私は１８だったじゃない？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《和正は、納得がいかない、という表情で首を振った。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《それ以上は言葉にならなかった。和正が美奈代の胸で泣き始めた。美奈代は和正の背中をやさしく叩いた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 金曜日の放課後。おれは理恵といっしょにバーで岡さんに会った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵が岡さんにお礼を言おうと提案し、おれもそれに賛成したからだった。理恵が岡さんに電話すると、忙しい中、快く出向いてもらうことができた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵とおれが心から礼を言うと、岡さんが微笑んで言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XB0}「本当はもったいなかったのよね、オーストラリアの企画。作家さんもすごく乗り気だったし、私としても気に入ってた企画だったから」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「すみません・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵が恐縮しているのを見て、くっくっと笑って言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XB0}「でも、しょうがないわ。理恵ちゃんとその彼氏のためだもの。仕事ではマイナスだけど、代わりにいいものが見れたからよしとしなきゃ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「なんですか、代わりって？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XB0}「理恵ちゃんの笑顔よ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵が恥ずかしそうにうつむいた。岡さんはテーブルで頬杖をついて微笑していた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XB0}「やっぱり理恵ちゃんには笑顔が一番似合うわ。ほんとにかわいい。私が男だったら、絶対ほっとかないわ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 岡さんが明るい大きな声で笑った。それから、タバコに火をつけ、気持ちよさそうに煙を吐き出した。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「ほんとうに、ありがとうございました」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XB0}「ほんとだわ。もう２度とこんなのはごめんよ。キャリアに響くわ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: また楽しそうに笑った。岡さんはしばし理恵とおれを見ていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XB0}「でも、本当、２人がうらやましいわ・・・。私も、学生時代にそんな恋がしてみたかったな・・・。きっと、私の人生も変わっていたかもね」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵が困惑したように首を振っていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XB0}「さてと、そろそろ仕事に行かないと」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: タバコを灰皿に押しつけた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「すいません。忙しいのに、来てもらったりして・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XB0}「いいのよ。あ、・・・そうだわ。由美ちゃん。・・・じゃないのよね、真由美ちゃんのことだけど」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「なんですか？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XB0}「よろしく言っておいてね。手伝ってもらって助かったって。卒業したら、今度は正式にうちで働いてって伝えておいて」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: おれは岡さんと握手した。岡さんが言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XB0}「きみも幸せものだね、こんなかわいい彼女を持って。大事にしなきゃダメよ？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 笑ってうなずいた。岡さんの携帯が鳴って、話し始めた。電話の相手に答えながら、手を振って、店を出ていった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 岡さんと別れて、おれは理恵と駅前を歩いた。晴れ晴れとした気分だった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: デパートのそばで、理恵が何かを見つけて立ち止まった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵が指差した先に、路上で営業している占い師がいた。テーブルと椅子はこの前見たものと同じだったが、水晶球はなく、かわりにコンピューターが置いてあった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「マドモワゼル薫子？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 占い師は、確かにマドモワゼル薫子その人だった。ただし、立て看板には、”コンピューター占い”と書いてあった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「行ってみよう」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 戸惑っていた。この前のことが、よほどショックだったのだろう。しかし、もう危機は去った。理恵の手を引いて、占い師のところへ行った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: マドモワゼル薫子に声をかけようとすると、激しい勢いで中年の女性が走ってきて、マドモワゼル薫子に詰め寄った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X83}【中年の女性】{X82}「ちょっと、あんた、どうしてくれんのさ！」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAC}「なんだい、あんた？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: マドモワゼル薫子が迷惑そうに眉をひそめた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X83}【中年の女性】{X82}「なんだい、じゃないよ！あたしは、先週、あんたに言われたとおり馬券を買ったんだよ！１０万もつっこんだんだ。ぜんぶハズレたよ。１０万パーさ。どうしてくれんのよ！」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAC}「覚えがないね・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 首をかしげていたが、本当は心当たりがあるように見えた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X83}【中年の女性】{X82}「あんたが覚えてなくても、あたしは覚えてるよ。あたしの１０万返しとくれよ！」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XAC}「運命は常に変動するんだよ。なにかちょっとしたことで変わるのさ・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X83}【中年の女性】{X82}「ふざけんじゃないよ！そんなのいまさら言われても、困るんだよ。当たらないっていうんなら、最初から言いな！」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 中年女性の剣幕に、薫子は押されぎみで、だんだん声が小さくなっていった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵が思わず吹きだした。おれも笑った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: おれは理恵と手をつないで、気の毒なマドモワゼル薫子に背を向け、歩いていった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 彼女は疲れたように首を振った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「そんなこと、できないよ・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 彼女は電車から降りた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 昼休み。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 化学の授業を終え、脇谷たちと実験室から教室へ戻る途中、購買部に立ち寄った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 購買部は相変わらず盛況だった。おれと脇谷は弁当を持参していたので飲み物だけを、中野はパンを買った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 自動販売機の前に立つと、先頭だったおれがみんなの分をまとめて買うことになった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「中野はＵＣＧだったな」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA5}「サンキュ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「田村は、”ヘーイ、お茶”」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA4}「ありがとう」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「しかし、何だろう、モンドセレクションて」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: おれは中野に缶を手渡し、聞いた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA4}「本当においしいと思ってるの、それ？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 横から田村が中野に怪訝そうな目を向けた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA5}「誰も手を出さぬとこがいいのよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA4}「同じ値段で、もっといいものがあるんじゃないの？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「珍しい趣味ではあるな」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「でもよぉ、おれも子供の頃はコーヒー牛乳好きだったなぁ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 議論を続けながら教室に戻った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA5}「缶コーヒーの醍醐味ってのはさ、コーヒーよりコーヒー飲料のほうにあるわけじゃんな」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 中野がホットドックをかじりながら言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「乳飲料とか？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA5}「そうな。うん」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 田村が、箸を休めて中野を見た。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA4}「・・・その缶一個に、角砂糖が何個入ってるか知ってる？清涼飲料水メーカーに飼いならされた連中の末路を考えてみるといいよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA4}「自律神経失調、糖尿病、２０半ばにして体は中年そのもの。それを尻目に半期１０パーセントの成長を続けるメーカー。ぼくらの生き血をすすって太っていく」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA4}「そういう会社のトップたちは、客から吸い上げた金できっと今日もどこかで愛人にパパって呼ばれてるんだよ。ぼくたちをせせら笑いながらね」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA5}「いいんでねぇの？好きよ、おれ、缶コーヒー。体が蝕まれてく感覚ひっくるめて」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA4}「いい保険会社を探しておいたほうがいいよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA5}「若人は３０以降のことなど考えねえのよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA4}「タウンゼントだってとっくに３０過ぎちゃったけどね」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「タウンゼン・・・？なんだそりゃ？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA4}「ご都合主義者ってこと」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA4}「どうでもいいけどね、別に。それより脇谷、どうするの？クリスマス」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 田村が弁当箱をしまいながら聞いた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「どうするって、おまえ・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA5}「ただ指をくわえてサンタをやり過ごすのかしらん」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 中野は照り焼きチキンロールの袋を開いた。すでに４個目のパンだ。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「ヤバめだな」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA4}「どーもね」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA5}「靴下くらいは吊るしておくつもりよ、おれ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 黙って聞いていた脇谷が、肩をいからせ絞り出すようにして言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「大の男がクリスマスだとう？情けないこったぜ。・・・く、くだらねぇ、どいつもこいつも！」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA4}「それをいったら負けだと思うよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA5}「ジーザスは知らなくても、ケーキはうまいわけよ。レッツ・エンジョイ・クリスマス」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「すでにホテルの予約はいっぱいだろう」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA5}「アフター・スキー。それが本命でしょう」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA4}「ま、相手がいなければ、困ることもないけどね」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「・・・な、なにがクリスマスだ。なにがサンタだ。踊らされてる奴らも気にくわねぇー。なにもかも気にくわねぇーっ。うおお～っ！」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 脇谷が吠えた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「同じクリスマス否定派として申し上げますがね。・・・落ちつけよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 興奮する脇谷をなだめていると、突然、千葉が声をかけてきた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 脇谷は手で千葉をさえぎると、誰に言うでもなく叫んだ。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「やめろ。もうおれの前でクリスマスという単語を口にするなっ！」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 脇谷は説いた。”クリスマス”とは、彼女のいる男が、彼女のいない男を笑うためだけに存在するのだ、と。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「・・・おれは、この歳になってやっとブッダの偉大さがわかった気がするぜ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 後半はヤケになっていた。ブッダがクリスマスの愚かさを説いている姿を連想し、吹き出しそうになった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA4}「確かに、クリスマスをひとりで過ごすってのは、犯罪だといわんばかりだね。現実には」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 田村があいづちをうった。ふと、彼の瞳の奥に、嘲りともとれる輝きを見たような気がした。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「やめろ。彼女のいるやつに、おれの気持ちがわかるはずがねぇ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: すねたように口をとがらせると、脇谷はそっぽを向いた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 田村が微笑し、ため息をついた。その余裕の表情を見て、脇谷は小さく舌打ちをした。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA6}「・・・か、感動したよ。脇谷くんっ！」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 突然、千葉が会話に乱入してきた。瞳を輝かせて千葉が言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA6}「クリスマスにひとりでいるってことは、けっして恥ずかしいことなんかじゃないんだね？！」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「・・・当たり前だろう」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 横目で千葉を見ながら呟いた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA6}「そうか・・・。そう思ってるのはひょっとして、ぼくだけじゃないかって思ってたけど、ああ、やっぱり脇谷くんはすごい人だ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 千葉が興奮しながら、一気にまくしたてた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 脇谷が、戸惑いながら静かに答えた。中野と田村は、不思議そうに顔を見合わせた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 千葉は脇谷の言葉に心底共感を覚えたようだった。興奮し、落ち着きなく脇谷を誉め讃えていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: １人で盛り上がっている千葉に、さっき何を言おうと声をかけたのか気になり、聞いてみた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA6}「それは、もういいんだ。脇谷くんの話を聞いて、ぼくは目が覚めたんだ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 千葉はうれしそうに言った。ますますに気になったので、とりあえず話せ、と命令口調で聞いた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA6}「実は、ぼくのおじさんが、スキー場の近くのホテルを経営しているんだけど・・・昨日、電話がかかってきて聞いたんだ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA6}「クリスマス・イブと、その前の日の２日間、２部屋分、予約していた客がキャンセルしてきたんだ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA6}「それで、よかったら友だちを誘って来ないかって言われて」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA6}「さっき脇谷くんたちの話を聞いていたら、スキーとかホテルとか言ってたから、良かったらどうかなって思ったんだけど・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 千葉が手にした豆乳を飲み一息ついた。おれは脇谷たちを見た。皆、無言で千葉の話に耳を傾けていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA6}「でも、脇谷くんの言うとおり、やっぱり馬鹿馬鹿しいよ。クリスマスだからってどこかに行くなんて。部屋はキャンセルすることにするよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 千葉は言い終わるとその場を去ろうとした。同時に脇谷が立ち上がった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「千葉あっ！」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「おれは・・・おれはサンタクロースを信じる！！」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 脇谷は千葉の手をわし掴みにした。千葉は訳がわからず、棒立ちになった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 脇谷の顔は喜びに満ちていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 夕食をすませ、シャワーを浴びると、部屋に戻って一息ついた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: テレビを見、のんびりとした時間を過ごすと１０時を回っていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 電話を取り、理恵の家の番号を押した。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: しばらく耳元で呼出音が鳴った。１分ほど待ってスイッチを切ろうとすると、相手が出た。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「はい、河合です」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 声で理恵だとわかった。彼女が出てくれて、内心ほっとした。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「こんばんわ。{X92}だけど」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: うわずった声で答えた。なにをそんなに驚いているのか、と不思議に思った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「そうだけど・・・。取り込み中だった、かな？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「ううん。そんな事ないけど」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 言葉を濁していた。興味をそそられて追求してみた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「なに？気になるよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「あの・・・あのね。いま、シャワー浴びてたの・・・だから」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「シャワー？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「タオル一枚なの。だから・・・恥ずかしいかなあって」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「でも、ここからじゃ見えないよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「そうだけどぉ・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 困ったように黙り込んだ。電話の向こうで、理恵が顔を赤くさせている姿を想像し、おかしく思った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「うん。じゃあ、待ってるから着替えて・・・それとも、また電話しようか？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 少し間をおいて理恵が答えた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「私から電話する。１０分ほど待ってて」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 電話をきり、ベッドに横になりながら、だらだらと時を潰した。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: ５分後、電話が鳴った。
