strings.jp: 華奈を見た。やさしい目をして微笑んでいた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XB4}「ウェア・・・買っておいて本当に良かったです」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 両手を広げて立ち上がった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「・・・そうか。そのウェアにも、もう少しいい目を見せてあげないとね」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: おれは立ち上がり、華奈に背を向けて膝をついた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「乗って。ホテルまで送るよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 華奈が瞳を潤ませた。背中に乗ると、耳元で小さくささやいた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XB4}「ありがとう・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 背中ごしに彼女のぬくもりを感じながら、ゆっくりと斜面を滑り出した。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 好調な滑り出しだったが、数１０メートルも進むと、案の定バランスを崩し転んでしまった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「ごめん。最後くらいはと思ったんだけど・・・そうはうまくいかないみたいだ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XB4}「いいえ。楽しいです。・・・ふふっ、ははは」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 雪まみれのまま、２人で笑った。おれは散らばったストックを拾おうと立ち上がった
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 斜面の向こうに人影が見えた。理恵だった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: おれの前まで歩いてきた。理恵は華奈がいることに気付いていないようだった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「ずっと探してたの。{X92}くん・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「あの・・・さっきのことなんだけど・・・私・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: そこまで言いかけると、理恵はようやく華奈の存在に気付いた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 華奈は立ち上がると、おれのウェアの袖を引っ張った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XB4}「{X92}さん。おんぶして下さい。また滑りましょう・・・あれ？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 華奈がおれの背中に飛びついた。肩ごしに理恵の姿を確認すると、目を丸くしておれに聞いた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XB4}「{X92}さんのお友だちですか？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵は華奈を見、それから視線をおれに戻した。疑いの眼差しでおれの顔を睨んだ。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XB4}「初めまして。月島華奈と言います。１４歳です」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 華奈がぺこりと会釈した。理恵はぎこちない笑みを浮かべ、重い声で言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「初めまして。{X92}くんの”友だち”の河合理恵と言います」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 友だちという単語を強調した。理恵は顔を上げると、笑顔のままおれを見た。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「お邪魔だったかしら？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 嫌みっぽく言った。どうやら理恵は、おれが華奈をナンパしたと解釈したようだった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 説明しようとしたが、理恵が先に口を開いた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「{X92}くん。女の子と遊ぶのはいいけど、中学生をこんな時間まで引っ張り回すのはどうかと思うな」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 意地悪く言った。華奈が戸惑った表情でおれを見た。事情を説明しようとしたが、またもや遮られた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「どうやら、{X92}くんはその子と遊んでいるほうが楽しいみたい。お邪魔なようだからこれで失礼するね」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: なぜ、彼女はおれの説明を聞こうとしないのだ。彼女の態度におれは頭に血が昇ってしまった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 去ろうとする理恵の背中に言葉をぶつけた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「理恵だって・・・さっき楽しそうにしていたじゃないかっ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵の足が止まった。ゆっくりと振り向くと、睨みながら早足で近付いてきた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「だからそのことで話をしようと思って来たのに。あの時だって人の話を聞こうとしなかったのは{X92}くんじゃない！？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「それはこっちのセリフだよ。人の話を聞かないで、勝手に怒ってるのはそっちじゃないかっ？！」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: おれは強く言い放った。理恵は怒りをあらわにし、ぶるぶると震えた。おれたちの只ならぬ様子に、華奈はおろおろとしていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「もう・・・いいよっ！{X92}くんなんて・・・ばかあっ！！」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵は帽子を掴むと、近くの木に思いきり投げつけた。帽子が枝に引っかかった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵はそのまま早足で斜面を降りて行った。おれは、その場に立ち尽くし、彼女の後ろ姿を憎々しげに見つめた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 華奈がうろたえた目でおれを見ていた。彼女は去りゆく理恵を見ながら言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XB4}「ご、ごめんなさい。・・・私のせいで・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 華奈がうつむいた。おれは彼女の頭をやさしく撫でた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「華奈ちゃんのせいじゃないよ・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 華奈は小さくうなずいた。さきほどまでの元気は完全に失われてしまった。華奈に申し訳ないと思った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: それにしても、また理恵とケンカになってしまった。しかも、今度は相手を本気で怒らせてしまった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵の去ったほうを見て小さくため息をついた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XB4}「あの・・・追いかけなくていいんですか？・・・私、１人でも戻れますから・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 華奈が言った。だが、この雪の上を、足の不自由な彼女が１人で戻れるとは考えられなかった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「いいんだ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: もとより追いかけるつもりはなかった。おれ自身、頭にきているのは事実だし、今行ったところで、理恵とまともに話せるとは思えなかった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「戻ろう。華奈ちゃん」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 華奈を背負って滑り始めた。しばらくして、華奈がなにかに気付き振り返った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵が投げつけた帽子のことを思い出した。だが、引き返すにはずいぶんと距離が離れてしまった。いまさら戻る気にもならなかった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: おれは独り言のように呟くと、そのまま斜面を滑り降りた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 部屋に戻ってからも、おれはゆううつな気分のままだった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 田村が中心になって、女のことについてみんなが議論しているのを、離れた場所からぼんやりと聞いていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 脇谷は布団から上体を起こして田村の話に耳を傾けていた。足の痛みはだいぶ和らいだらしかった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA4}「つまり女ってものは、心のどこかで自分を支配してくれる存在を常に渇望しているものなんだ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA4}「だから、例え泣いても決して許すな。涙渇れるまで徹底的に罵ってやるんだ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA4}「痛みは歓びとなり、本当に望むものに気付いたとき、彼女はきみだけの奴隷となる」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA4}「女なんてものは、所詮、男の前でよだれを垂らしながら尻を振る淫らな牝ブタ。性奴隷だ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 自分の言ったことがおかしくて田村は笑った。脇谷があっけにとられるなか、壁を背に黙って聞いていた中野が身を乗り出した。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA5}「違う・・・さおりさんは・・・彼女は、そんなんじゃねえ！！」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: テーブルを強く叩いた。みんなが驚いて中野を見た。中野は激しく眉をつり上げていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 昨夜の中野とは様子が違った。彼の顔は真剣そのものだった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 中野の豹変ぶりに、田村が怪訝そうな顔で質問した。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA4}「・・・なにかあったの、中野？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 中野は沈黙したまま腰を下ろした。そして、今日のことを、さおりという女性に会い、彼女に一目惚れしてしまったことを告白した。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「へえ・・・良かったじゃねえか。おまえにも好きな女ができたのか。確かに彼女、結構美人だったしな。そうか、そうか」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「それでそのあとどうなったんだ？告白したのか？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 脇谷が急かすように問いつめた。中野はうつむき答えた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA5}「うんにゃ・・・彼女とはゲレンデで別れてそれっきり。名前しかわからんかった。もう会えるかどうかも・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 思い詰めたように首をうなだれた。中野の様子に脇谷も黙り込んだ。誰もがなにかを考えているように思えた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA4}「そうか・・・ぼくだけじゃないんだな。苦労してるのは」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 全員が一斉に田村を見た。みんな田村は彼女と上手くいっているものと思っていた。田村が慌てて口を塞いだが、遅かった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 田村を問いつめ、彼がまだ彼女とあまり進展していないことを聞き出した。だが、誰もそのことで笑うことはしなかった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: ここにいる全員が、女関係で苦戦しているという意識を共有していた。脇谷が呟いた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「ああ・・・どうしたら友だち以上の関係になれるようになるんだろうか・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: みんなが思案するなか、千葉がぽつりと言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA6}「ぼくなんか・・・口をきいてもらえるだけで幸せだよ・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 脇谷が泣きそうな顔で千葉を見た。全員が千葉に心から同情した。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 中野がカップをテーブルに並べた。無言でウイスキーを注ぐと、カップを高々と掲げた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: みんなもそれぞれカップを手にとり中野に続いた。脇谷が決意を込めた顔で言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「お互いがんばろうぜ！」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 号令とともに一気にアルコールを飲み干した。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 飲み慣れないアルコールのため、千葉は目を回していた。畳の上で伸びている彼をよそに、おれたちはテーブルを囲み会議を行っていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 中野を説得し、さおりに会いに行かせる決心をさせた。だが、問題はこれからだった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA5}「でも、名前しかわかんねぇの。ホテルも、どこに泊まってるのかも知らないし」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: おれも脇谷も、腕組みをして考え込んだ。田村が知恵を出した。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA4}「名前がわかってるんなら、なんとかなると思うよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: みんなが田村に注目した。田村が説明を始めた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA4}「まず、かたっぱしからホテルに電話して、三島さおりさんにつないでくれと言うんだ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA4}「同じ名前の人がいればつないでもらえるし、別人が出たら間違い電話だといって切れば問題ないよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA5}「でも、ホテルの電話番号なんてどうやって調べんのよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA4}「公衆電話に電話帳はつきものだろ。なかったらフロントで借りればいいよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA5}「なるほど」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: さっそく行動に移った。田村と中野は電話をするために部屋を出ていった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: １０分も待たずに２人が帰ってきた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA4}「わかったよ。彼女はここから歩いて５分くらいのところにあるホテルに宿泊してる」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 中野はコートを手にすると、早足でドアに向かった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA5}「じゃあ・・・行ってくんよ、オイラ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「がんばってこいよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA4}「彼女によろしく」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「うまくやれよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: みんなの声援を受けて、中野は部屋を後にした。中野の恋がうまく実ることをみんなが心の中で祈った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「さて、と・・・これからどうするかな」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 脇谷が背伸びしたまま布団に倒れた。田村が腕時計を見た。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA4}「もうすぐパーティーの時間だよ。ほら、食堂でのクリスマス・パーティー」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 脇谷がのそりと起きた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「ああ、そうだった。すっかり忘れてたぜ。今日はイブだったんだ。せっかくだから楽しまないとな」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 布団から出て立ち上がった。ふらふらしているが、どうやら１人で歩くことはできるようだった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「じゃあ、行くか」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 寝ている千葉をたたき起こして、おれたちは食堂へと向かった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: ミラーボールが部屋を照らし出すなか、シャンパンの栓が次々と開けられていった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: クリスマスソングが流れ、ホテルに宿泊している人々が集まって、陽気にグラスを傾けた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 田村が井之上貴久美の隣で、なにか話しかけているのが見えた。だが、貴久美は女の子の輪から抜けようとはしなかった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 田村が気落ちした表情で戻ってきた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA4}「これじゃあ、なんのためのクリスマスなんだか・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: カウンターに肘をついてグラスをあおった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「{X92}。こんなとこでぼさっとしてねぇで、ちょっとおれに付き合ってくれ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 脇谷に手を引かれて女の子のほうへ移動した。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「メリー・クリスマス」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: グラスを片手に脇谷が声を上げた。佐倉と理恵が同時に振り向いた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「メリー・クリスマス。脇谷くん。足、大丈夫？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「平気です。ちゃんと立てるし・・・それより理恵さん。お邪魔してもよろしいでしょうか？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「待ちなさい。あなた、ちょっとここに座りなさい」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 佐倉が隣の椅子を叩いて座るよう指示した。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「なんですか？佐倉さん」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 脇谷が怪訝そうな顔で座った。佐倉はグラスを持て遊びながら、妖しい目つきで脇谷を見た。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「あなた、アルコールは強いほう？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「え。なんですか、いきなり・・・？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「どのくらい飲めるのかって聞いてるの」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 佐倉が詰めよった。頬が桜色に染まっている。少し酔いが回っているように思えた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「そうですね。結構イケるんじゃないかな。ちびちびやるよりは、一気に流し込むほうがどっちかって言うと好きだし」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「吐いたりしない？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「自慢じゃないけど、１度も」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「ＯＫ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 佐倉は、空いていたグラスを脇谷の前に差し出した。シャンパンの瓶を手にすると、グラスになみなみと注いだ。自分のグラスにも注ぎ足した。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「乾杯」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「どういうことですか？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「勝負しましょう。どっちがより多く飲めるか。自信あるんでしょう？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 挑戦的な態度で笑った。どうやら佐倉は、昼間ゲレンデで脇谷に見下されたことが気になっているようだった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「頭以外では負けないって言ったでしょう？証明してもらうわ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「しかし・・・大丈夫なんですか、佐倉さん？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「あら、心配？それとも逃げるつもりかしら？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「・・・そこまで言うなら、受けましょう。でも、知りませんよ？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「二日酔いの薬は持参してるかしら？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X96}「ビニール袋を用意しておいたほうがいいですよ？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: ２人は不敵に笑うと、一気にアルコールを飲み干した。グラスが空になると、間をおかずシャンパンを注ぎ足した。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: おれは理恵の隣に座った。理恵は、おれの存在を無視するように、隣で繰り広げられる酒豪勝負を眺めていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 声をかけると、理恵が振り向いた。うつろな目でおれを見たが、すぐに顔を反らして、一気にシャンパンをあおった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: まだ、怒っているようだった。機嫌をなおすよう努力してみたが、おれが一方的に喋るだけで、彼女は口を開こうとはしなかった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: しかたなく理恵の隣でちびちびとシャンパンをすすった。会話もないまま、おれと理恵は静かにグラスを傾け続けた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: ２人の間にぎすぎすした空気が漂っていた。周囲の人々の楽しそうな声が、別世界の出来事のように感じられた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: ３０分が過ぎた。テーブルが小刻みに揺れ、おれは顔を上げた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 佐倉の横で、うつぶせに倒れている脇谷が目に入った。悩ましい表情を浮かべたまま、いびきをかいて眠っていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「たあいないわね」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 得意そうに脇谷を見おろすと、佐倉はグラスを片手にシャンパンを飲み干した。勝負は佐倉の圧倒的な勝利だった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《中野はさおりが宿泊しているホテルにたどり着いていた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《外は吹雪いていた。中野は体に付いた雪を払い落とし、フロントに向かった。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《しばらくフロントの前で迷っていた。意を決すると、さおりの部屋の番号を言い、つないでもらうように頼んだ。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《しばらくすると、電話を回してくれた。中野は受話器を受け取った。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA5}「さおりさん？・・・おれです。中野です」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《電話の向こうで、驚いたような声がした。中野は、自分がこのホテルのロビーにいると説明した。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《さおりは中野の熱意に困惑していた。しばしの沈黙の後、さおりが言った。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XB3}「・・・帰りなさい」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《電話を切られそうなのを察して、中野がすがるように言った。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA5}「会ってくれるだけでいいんです。おれ、待ってますから・・・待ってますから・・・！」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《数秒の間があって、電話は切れた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《中野はその場に立っていた。しばらくすると、受話器を離しフロントに差し出した。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《ゆっくりロビーを横断し、壁際にあるソファーに座った。中野は肘を着いて待ち続けた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵がグラスを空にするのを隣に座って眺めた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 頬が真っ赤になっている。あれから休む間もなく理恵はシャンパンをあおり続けていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「・・・飲み過ぎだよ、理恵」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: たしなめてみたが、理恵はおれの言葉を無視して、グラスにシャンパンを注いだ。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: おれはため息をつき席を立った。爆睡している脇谷を肩に担ぐと、フラフラしていた千葉を呼び寄せ手伝わせた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「理恵。あんまり飲み過ぎないほうがいいよ・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 背中ごしに言い残した。理恵は黙ったまま答えなかった。おれは、脇谷を担いで部屋に向かった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 廊下を歩きながら、今年は最低のクリスマスだな、と思った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「どうしたの、理恵。・・・酔ったの？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《様子のおかしい理恵を見て、真由美が声をかけた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「もぉぉ～～・・・いいの。{X92}くんなんて・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「・・・なにかあったの？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《理恵は黙ってグラスに口をつけた。真由美が心配そうに見ていると、背後から呼びかけられた。真由美が振り向いた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XB4}「あのぅ・・・{X92}さんの、お友だちですか？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《華奈だった。真由美がうなずくと、華奈は理恵を見て声をかけた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XB4}「こんばんわ、理恵さん。華奈です。・・・あの、{X92}さんは、一緒じゃないんですか？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《理恵がゆっくりと振り向いた。敵意のこもった目で華奈を見た。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「・・・あら、華奈ちゃん。こんばんわぁ。わざわざ{X92}くんに会いに来てくれたんだぁ？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「でも、{X92}くん、どこかに行っちゃったよ。もしかして、華奈ちゃんを探しに行ってたりして？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《ケラケラと笑った。真由美が制すると、理恵は黙ってグラスをあおった。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「で、あいつになにか用なの？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《真由美が説明を求めた。理恵は背中を向けたまま、２人の話に耳を傾けていた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《華奈は言った。自分の足が不自由なことを。それを知った{X92}が、自分のために努力してくれたことを》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《そして、自分のせいで、理恵と{X92}が仲たがいしてしまったことなどを順を追って説明した。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XB4}「私のせいで、こんなことになっちゃって・・・本当にごめんなさい・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「・・・そうだったの」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《真由美は華奈の説明を聞いて、理恵の機嫌が悪い理由を理解した。黙って聞いていた理恵が顔を上げた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「どうしよう・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《宙を見ながら呆然と呟いた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「私・・・知らなかったけど・・・どうしよう。{X92}くんに・・・私、ひどいこと言っちゃった・・・どうしよう・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《理恵がふらふらと立ち上がった。焦点の定まらないまま、周りを見渡した。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「華奈ちゃん・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《華奈が緊張した表情で理恵を見た。理恵がゆっくりと頭を下げた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「ごめんね・・・華奈ちゃん。・・・ごめんね・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《繰り返し謝った。華奈が両手を前に出して、頭を上げるよう頼んだ。理恵は謝り続けた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《理恵が思い出したように頭を上げた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《小さい声だった。真由美が声をかけたが、理恵は１人で食堂を出て行ってしまった。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《真由美は華奈を隣に座らせた。いきさつを話す華奈に、真由美は静かに耳を傾けた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「・・・そう。あいつにも、少しはいいところがあるわけね」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XB4}「はい。{X92}さんは、とってもいい人です」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「駄目よ、華奈ちゃん。恋人をつくるなら、もっといい男を選ばなきゃ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《華奈が無邪気な瞳で真由美を見た。真由美は微笑して、シャンパンの入ったグラスを華奈に差し出した。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「メリー・クリスマス」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《中野はソファーに座りうつむいたまま、さおりが来るのを待っていた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《ロビーに人の姿はほとんどなく、どこからか、陽気に騒ぐ客たちの声がかすかに響いていた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《人が通り過ぎる度に、中野は相手の顔を確認していたが、それもやめてしまった。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《気落ちした表情で、床に視線を落とし首をうなだれていた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《人が近付いてくる足音が聞こえた。中野は顔を上げず目を閉じてうつむいていた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《ごく近くで足音が止まった。中野は目を開けた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《ゆっくりと視線を上へとずらしていった。そこには、彼の待ち望んでいた人物の顔があった。中野は顔を上げた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA5}「さおりさん・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《中野は立ち上がりさおりを見た。さおりは中野を見て困ったように笑った。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《さおりの言葉を聞いたとたん、中野は体を震わせ歓喜した。涙が溢れそうになり、必死にそれを抑えた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《さおりは中野の隣に座った。軽く息を吐いて、中野に座るように目くばせした。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《中野は腰を下ろした。なにか言おうとしたが、緊張して言葉が出てこなかった。さおりが中野を見て言った。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XB3}「・・・外は寒かったでしょう？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XB3}「窓から外を見たわ。結構、吹雪いていたわよ。それなのに・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《中野は緊張のため、あいまいな相づちしか打てなかった。固くなっている中野を、さおりは穏やかな目で見つめた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XB3}「今夜はイブ。最高の夜のはずなのに・・・ふふ、私たち、お互いひとりぼっちね」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《中野がはっとしてさおりを見た。さおりは顔を正面に向け、遠くを見ていた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA5}「ひとりなんかじゃないです・・・！」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《中野は身を乗り出した。さおりは前を向いたまま、寂しそうに笑みを浮かべ、目を伏せた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《静寂が訪れた。お互いなにも喋らず、時間だけが過ぎていった。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《中野は気まずい空気を感じ、さおりに話しかけたが、彼女の気を引くような言葉はなにひとつ出てこなかった。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《次の言葉を考えていると、さおりがようやく重い口を開いた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XB3}「・・・中野くん。あなた、いまいくつ？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XB3}「そう。高校生だったの。・・・てことは、今年で卒業ね」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《中野は、さおりがなにを意図して喋っているのかわからなかった。さおりが言葉を続けた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XB3}「私ね・・・婚約者がいるの・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《中野が目を見開いた。さおりは中野の反応を予期していたのか、驚いたようすもなく喋り続けた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XB3}「でも、彼・・・会社の人事で、海外に転勤することになってしまったの・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XB3}「私は彼に海外転勤をやめてほしいと頼んだわ。仕事をとるか、私をとるか・・・でも、彼は答えなかった・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XB3}「だから、私は賭けに出たの。クリスマス・イブに・・・このホテルにいるから、もし自分を選ぶのなら来てほしい・・・って」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《しばらく間をおいて、言った。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XB3}「でも・・・来なかった」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《中野はさおりを見た。彼女は、魂が抜けたように宙を見つめていた。中野はたまらなくなって立ち上がった。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA5}「おれはっ・・・！」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA5}「おれなら、さおりさんを選ぶっ・・・！たとえ、なにを犠牲にしたって・・・絶対にさおりさんを選びますっ！」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《興奮して言った。さおりが振り向いた。かすかに微笑していたが、その瞳は悲しみに染まったままだった。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《中野は拳を握りしめ、うち震えた。自分の無力さが腹立たしかった。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA5}（どうして・・・どうしておれじゃないんだっ・・・！！）
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《心の中で叫んだ。その男を呪った。だが、それ以上にさおりの悲しむ顔を見るのが辛かった。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《彼女のためになにかしてやりたい。そんな思いが、無意識に中野の口を開かせた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA5}「待ちましょ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《さおりが顔を上げた。中野は自分でも意外だと思えるほど冷静に答えた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA5}「イブに約束してたんでしょう？・・・さおりさん。イブはまだ、終わってないっスよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《時計を見て言った。さおりも顔を向けた。午前０時まで、あと２時間ばかり時間があった。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《中野はソファーに腰を落とし腕を組んだ。さおりは中野の動きを目で追い、そして微笑んだ。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XB3}「ありがとう・・・やさしいのね、中野くん・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA5}「当然っス」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《中野は胸を張ってふんぞり返った。さおりは隣で笑いながら中野を見つめていた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 千葉を先に帰し、おれは泥酔している脇谷を寝かせた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 窓がきしみ、小刻みに震えていた。外は風が強く吹雪いていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 脇谷に毛布をかけ、暖房のスイッチを入れると、おれは食堂へ向かった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 食堂に戻ったら、どうやって理恵と話し合おうかと思案した。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: しかし、今の理恵はまともに話せるような状態ではない。彼女がアルコールにめっぽう弱いことから、今日、話すのは無理なのではないかと、考えた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 食堂に戻り、理恵の座っていた席に向かった。彼女はいなかった。彼女の席には華奈が座っていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XB4}「{X92}さぁん」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 華奈が気付いておれの前に立った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「華奈ちゃん。どうしたの？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 説明を求めるように華奈を見た。向かい側に座っていた佐倉が言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「感謝しなさい。あなたと理恵のために、わざわざ来てくれたのよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 佐倉がいきさつを話した。華奈はおれの周りを、うれしそうに飛び跳ねていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「そうか。・・・ありがとう、華奈ちゃん」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XB4}「いいえ。お役にたててうれしいですぅ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 感謝の意味をこめて、やさしく頭を撫でてあげた。華奈は笑顔で自分の頭に手を乗せた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「・・・ところで、理恵は？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: おれは、周囲を見渡した。佐倉がシャンパンをグラスに注いだ。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「さっき出ていったわ。ずいぶん飲んでたから、どこかで涼んでるんじゃないかしら？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 佐倉がグラスをあおった。彼女のほうが、よほど飲んでいると思われたが、そこにいるのはふだんどおりの佐倉だった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9C}「真由美～～～。隅っこで語りあってないでこっち来なよぉ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 柿沼ともみが佐倉を呼んだ。佐倉は立ち上がると、グラスを持って歩きだした。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「よかったら華奈ちゃんも来てね」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: そう言い残すと、そのままともみのほうへと歩いて行った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「華奈ちゃん。理恵はなにか言ってた？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 華奈に聞いた。少し考えてから華奈が言った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XB4}「ええとぉ・・・とくになにも・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XB4}「あっ。・・・帽子がどうとか言ってましたけど・・・よく聞き取れなかったから・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XB4}「それでふらふらと・・・。でもっ、わかりませんよ。本当に小さい声だったから・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: まさか、理恵は帽子を取りに外へ出たのでは？しかし、外は吹雪いている。正常な人間なら、この吹雪の中、ゲレンデに出ようなどとは思わないはず。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: だが、理恵はアルコールが入っていたし、酒に弱い彼女なら思考が正常に働かず、短絡的に外出した可能性も・・・。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 華奈が不思議そうにおれを見た。おれは、華奈をその場に残し、早足で食堂を出た。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 外は予想以上に吹雪いていた。ナイターから引き上げてくる人々と入れ替わりに、おれはゲレンデへと急いだ。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: アイスバーンと化した斜面と、強いみぞれのために、思うように進めない。視界も、吹き荒れる雪のために、数メートル先までしか確認できない。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 方向を見失わないよう、かすかに見える建物の明かりを頼りに、リフト乗り場の近くまでたどり着いた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵が帽子を投げつけたのはこの辺りだった。理恵の名を叫んだが風の音にかき消された。返事も聞こえなかった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 帽子を投げつけた木を探した。前方に大きな木が見えかくれしていた。それを目指して前進した。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: ようやく木の近くまでたどり着いた。だが、理恵らしき人影は見当たらなかった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 木の周辺を注意深く探した。木の根元に不自然な雪の山を見つけた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: ちょうど、人間が倒れたくらいに盛り上がっていた。急いで雪をかき分けた。理恵が姿を現した。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 反応がなかった。理恵の頬に自分の頬を当てた。彼女の身体は冷えきっていた。揺さぶってみたが起きる気配はなかった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵を抱き起こし背中に乗せた。彼女の手から何かが落ちた。おれがプレゼントした帽子だった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「う、うぅん・・・駄目ぇ・・・返してぇ・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵が耳元で呟いた。どうやら意識はあるようだった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 帽子を拾うと急いでその場を離れた。来るときよりも、吹雪はさらに強くなっていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: とにかく理恵をすぐにでも介抱しなければならない。気はあせるばかりだが、吹雪の中を人を背負って歩くのは容易ではなかった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: リフト乗り場まで下ったところで力尽きた。これ以上進むのは困難だと感じた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 風を凌げる場所を探して辺りを見渡した。見ると、リフト乗り場の近くに小さな小屋を発見した。理恵を背負い小屋に向かった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 従業員専用の休息所のようだった。窓の鍵が開いているのを確認し、急いで中に入った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 小屋に入ると、急いで暖房を入れた。理恵の濡れたウェアを脱がし、近くにあった毛布にくるんだ。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 毛布の上から入念にマッサージした。少しすると、理恵の顔に赤みがさしてきた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: おれは安堵し、理恵を寝かせたまま部屋の中を物色した。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 棚にブランデーを発見し手にとった。これを飲ませれば、さらに暖をとることができる。おれは瓶を持って理恵の側に戻った。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: グラスが見当たらなかったので、口移しで飲ませることにした。ブランデーを口に含むと、理恵の唇に自分の唇を当てブランデーを流し込んだ。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵が咳こんだ。背中を軽くさすってやると、理恵がゆっくりと目を開いた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵は焦点が定まっていなかった。うつろな目でおれの顔を見ていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 軽くうなずいた。理恵は寝ぼけ眼のままにっこりと微笑んだ。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「・・・雪の中で倒れていたんだよ。・・・取りに来たんだろ、帽子？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵がケラケラと笑った。彼女は酔うと笑い上戸になることを思い出した。酔いはまだ醒めていないようだった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 再びブランデーを飲ませた。酔いが醒めていないのなら、せめて眠気を取り払おうと考えた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵はブランデーが苦手だった。何度も咳こむと、ようやく眠気から解放された。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「うん・・・ありがとお・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「ごめん・・・おれのせいだ。理恵をこんな目にあわせてしまって・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「謝るよ。・・・ごめん」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「・・・進路・・・決めてくれた？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「・・・うん、わかってる」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「わかってないよ・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「・・・私は、{X92}くんと・・・いつも一緒にいたい。・・・少しでも多くの時間を・・・{X92}くんと一緒に過ごしたい・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「いつも・・・{X92}くんの近くにいたいの・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵が目を閉じた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵の本音を聞いた気がした。彼女のおれへの想いを改めて感じた。彼女はおれと離れたくない。それは、おれも同じだった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「おれも・・・理恵と一緒にいたい。・・・その時間が減ってしまうのは、おれも望んでない」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 自分の本心に気付いた途端、急速に考えがまとまり、自然と答えが導き出された。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「・・・そうだ。おれは、理恵と同じ大学に行くよ・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「いまから勉強するのは、大変かもしれないけど・・・きっと合格してみせる」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「・・・約束するよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 言い終わると理恵を見た。彼女は、静かに寝息を立てて眠っていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: おれは微笑んだ。外に出ている理恵の肩に毛布をかけてあげた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 今回の約束は、想像以上に困難なものになるかもしれない。だが、やり遂げる。大切な人の想いに報いるために。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵が寝言でおれの名を呼んだ。おれは、やさしく理恵を抱きしめた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《午後１１時３０分。日付はもうすぐ変わろうとしていた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《照明が落とされ、ロマンティックな音楽が流れ出した。恋人たちが、手に手をとって静かに踊りだした。チークダンス・タイムだ。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《暗い部屋の中を、田村は自分の彼女を探し求めていた。壁際によりかかって１人たたずむ井之上貴久美の姿を確認した。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《田村は貴久美の前に立って、懇願するように彼女の目を見つめた。貴久美が苦笑し壁から背を離した。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9D}「情けない顔しないでよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《貴久美が田村の顔をのぞき込んだ。田村は小さくなって彼女を見た。貴久美は子供をあやすように田村の手をとった。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9D}「手、出して」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《田村が目を輝かせた。貴久美の腰に手を回し、はちきれんばかりの笑顔で踊りだした。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《テーブルに肘をついて、真由美はグラスを傾けた。話しかける相手もなく、彼女は暇を持て余していた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《真由美は、隣で座っている千葉を見た。千葉は黙ったままうつむいていた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《視線を戻し、しばし考えたあと、真由美は千葉に声をかけた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「あなたは踊りたくないの？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《千葉は体を震わせおびえた目で真由美を見た。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA6}「でも・・・ぼく、踊る相手もいないし・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《そのまま黙り込んでしまった。千葉は真由美が自分と踊ってくれるとは思っていない。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《真由美は小さくため息をつくと、手にしていたグラスをテーブルに置いた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「どうしてもっていうのなら・・・ちょっとだけ踊ってあげてもいいわよ」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《千葉がびくんと跳ね上がった。目を丸くしてがたがたと震えた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「ただ、これは今日だけの大サービスよ。勘違いしないで」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《真由美が立ち上がった。千葉は瞳を潤ませて真由美に続いた。彼女の手をとり狂喜した。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《真由美は千葉を押し退けた。２０センチほど体を離し、きつい口調で注意した。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「いいっ！？ここがボーダーラインよ。これ以上近寄ったら、その瞬間にやめるわよっ！！」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《千葉は何度もうなずくと、体を離して恍惚とした表情で踊った。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA6}「佐倉さん。ぼく・・・ぼく、一生忘れないよっ！」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9A}「当然でしょう？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《千葉が涙した。真由美は千葉が接近してこないように、警戒しながら踊り続けた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《田村と貴久美は、お互い体を寄せ合って踊っていた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《貴久美の目を見つめ、田村がささやいた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA4}「貴久美は・・・ぼくのことが嫌いなの？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9D}「なんで？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《貴久美が足元を気にしながら聞いた。田村が答えた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA4}「だって・・・ぼくたち、キスもしてない」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《貴久美が顔を上げた。田村はスネたように口をとがらせていた。貴久美が苦笑した。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《貴久美は背伸びをし、田村の背中に手を回した。そして、素早く田村に口づけした。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《田村はあっけにとられていた。貴久美はかかとを落とし、田村をのぞき込んだ。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X9D}「これでいい・・・？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《田村は我に返り、首を左右に振った。今度は自ら貴久美の腰を抱き寄せ、熱くキスをした。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《ロビーの柱時計が、午前０時を告げた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《中野はチャイムが鳴り終わるのを、気まずい顔で聞いていた。ゆっくりとさおりに顔を向けた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《さおりは目を伏せ息を吐いた。笑顔で中野を見た。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XB3}「いいのよ。・・・来るとは思ってなかったし・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《さおりは微笑したまま顔を戻した。中野は何も言えずに、さおりの背中を見つめた。かすかに震えていた。さおりの目には涙が浮かんでいた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA5}「事故かもしれないっスよ・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《さおりは答えなかった。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XA5}「・・・じゃあ、途中で、腹こわしたのかも・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《さおりが震える声で言った。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {XB3}「ありがとう。中野くん・・・」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《中野は、それ以上なにも言えなかった。今の彼女に言葉は無力だ。少し時間がたてば・・・。そう考えた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《静寂が支配する中、ロビーのガラスドアを叩く音が聞こえた。フロントから、従業員が入り口に向かって歩いて行くのが見えた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《さおりが、うなだれたままドアのほうを見た。彼女の目が見開かれた。ゆっくり立ち上がると、無意識に口元を手で押さえた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《従業員がドアの鍵を開けると、雪まみれの背広姿の男が転がりこんだ。男は辺りを見回した。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《男の視線が一点に集中した。さおりは男と視線を合わせると、男のもとへ走り寄った。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《さおりは男の胸に飛び込んだ。男は強くさおりを抱きしめた。お互いなにか言葉を交わしたが、中野には聞こえなかった。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《中野はゆっくりと立ち上がった。無言で歩き出すと、抱き合う２人の横を通り過ぎ、ホテルを出た。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《入り口で立ち止まり空をあおいだ。だが、しばらくすると、コートに体を埋めてその場を歩き去った。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 《吹雪は去り、ホテルの照明に照らされて、小雪が静かに舞っていた。》
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 早朝、こっそりと部屋に帰ってみると、中野と田村の姿がなかった。ひと眠りして目覚めると、いつの間にか２人は帰っていた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: いままでどこにいたのか聞いてみたが、２人とも理由を話そうとはしなかった。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: ただ、中野は気落ちした感じだった。おまけにアルコールの臭いが強かったため、どこかで飲んでいたのだと推測できた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 午前９時。おれたちはそれぞれ荷物をまとめ部屋を後にした。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: ホテルの出口へ向かう途中、飲み物を買っておこうと食堂に寄った。偶然にも理恵がいた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: 理恵も飲み物を買いに来ていた。バッグに缶ジュースを入れ、おれの前まで走ってきた。
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X97}「おはよう。眠れた？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full

strings.jp: {X94}「少し、ね。理恵はどう？」
strings.note: a message: the window 60 cells (letters) by 4 lines; broken between words, a click and a new page when the window is full
